<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>ARISE — Fitness System</title>

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rajdhani:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>

:root {

  --bg: #0a0c10;

  --bg2: #0f1318;

  --bg3: #151b24;

  --bg4: #1c2430;

  --border: rgba(100,160,255,0.12);

  --border2: rgba(100,160,255,0.22);

  --accent: #4f8eff;

  --accent2: #7eb3ff;

  --accent-glow: rgba(79,142,255,0.2);

  --gold: #f0a500;

  --gold2: #ffd166;

  --purple: #8b5cf6;

  --purple2: #a78bfa;

  --green: #10b981;

  --green2: #34d399;

  --red: #ef4444;

  --red2: #f87171;

  --amber: #f59e0b;

  --text: #e8edf5;

  --text2: #9aaabb;

  --text3: #5a6a7a;

  --rank-e: #6b7280; --rank-d: #10b981; --rank-c: #3b82f6; --rank-b: #8b5cf6; --rank-a: #f59e0b; --rank-s: #ef4444;

}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body { height: 100%; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); overflow: hidden; }

.app { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; background: var(--bg); }

/* SCREENS */

.screen { display: none; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }

.screen.active { display: flex; }

/* HEADER */

.topbar { background: var(--bg2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-shrink: 0; }

.topbar-title { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--accent2); text-transform: uppercase; }

.topbar-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.rank-pill { background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; }

/* SCROLL CONTENT */

.scroll { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--border) transparent; }

/* CARDS */

.card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; }

.card-title { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text2); margin-bottom: 10px; }

/* BUTTONS */

.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border2); background: transparent; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: all 0.15s; }

.btn:hover { background: var(--bg3); border-color: var(--accent); }

.btn-primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: white; }

.btn-primary:hover { background: #3a7aee; }

.btn-gold { background: var(--gold); border-color: var(--gold); color: #000; font-weight: 600; }

.btn-sm { padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 12px; }

.btn-full { width: 100%; }

.btn-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border-radius: 8px; }

.btn-with-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

.btn-with-icon .icon-title-slot { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

.btn-with-icon .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

/* NAV */

.nav { background: var(--bg2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; padding: 8px 0 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.nav-btn { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 2px; min-width: 0; color: #e8ecf4; transition: color .18s ease, filter .18s ease; }

.nav-btn:hover { color: #ffffff; }

.nav-btn.active { color: var(--accent2); }

.nav-icon { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.35)); }

.nav-btn.active .nav-icon { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(79,142,255,0.75)); }

.nav-icon .icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke-width: 2; }

.icon { display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; flex-shrink: 0; }

.icon-inline { width: 15px; height: 15px; vertical-align: -3px; margin-right: 4px; }

.icon-btn { width: 16px; height: 16px; vertical-align: -3px; margin-right: 6px; }

.icon-title { width: 20px; height: 20px; vertical-align: -4px; margin-right: 8px; color: var(--accent2); }

.icon-lg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

.nav-label { font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text3); white-space: nowrap; }

.nav-btn.active .nav-label { color: var(--accent2); }

/* BARS */

.bar-wrap { height: 5px; background: var(--bg4); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }

.bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.4s ease; }

/* BADGES */

.badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

/* DIVIDER */

.divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 4px 0; }

/* SECTION LABEL */

.section-label { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text3); margin-bottom: 6px; padding-left: 2px; }

/* INPUTS */

input[type=text], input[type=number], input[type=date], select, textarea {

  background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; color: var(--text); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s;

}

input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

select option { background: var(--bg3); }

textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 80px; }

label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font-weight: 500; }

.form-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; }

.form-row > * { flex: 1; }

.form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }

/* TOGGLE */

.toggle-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.toggle { width: 42px; height: 24px; background: var(--bg4); border-radius: 12px; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; border: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; }

.toggle.on { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }

.toggle::after { content: ''; width: 18px; height: 18px; background: white; border-radius: 50%; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; transition: left 0.2s; }

.toggle.on::after { left: 20px; }

.toggle-label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); }

/* QUEST ITEMS */

.quest-item { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; }

.quest-item:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }

.quest-item.done { opacity: 0.65; }

.quest-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.quest-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.quest-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.3; }

.quest-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); margin-top: 2px; line-height: 1.4; }

.quest-bar { margin-top: 7px; }

.quest-right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.xp-tag { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); }

.check-circle { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--border2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 11px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.check-circle.done { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); color: white; }

/* MILESTONE DROPDOWN */

.milestone-toggle { font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; user-select: none; }

.milestone-toggle .milestone-caret { display: inline-flex; transition: transform .2s ease; }

.milestone-toggle .milestone-caret .icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

.milestone-list { display: none; margin-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 8px; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.milestone-list.open { display: flex; }

.milestone-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); }

.milestone-item.done { color: var(--green2); text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.7; }

.milestone-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border2); flex-shrink: 0; }

.milestone-dot.done { background: var(--green); }

/* HUNTER CARD */

.hunter-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1a2e 0%, #101c30 100%); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0; }

.hunter-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40px; right: -40px; width: 140px; height: 140px; background: var(--accent-glow); border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(28px); opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }

.hunter-card-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

.hunter-name { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1.15; margin-top: 2px; }

.hunter-rank-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(79,142,255,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(79,142,255,0.3); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--accent2); margin-bottom: 8px; white-space: nowrap; }

.hunter-rank-badge .icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

/* STAT GRID */

.stat-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; }

.stat-box { background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 8px; text-align: center; }

.stat-val { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }

.stat-lbl { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); margin-top: 1px; font-weight: 500; }

.stat-delta { font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 600; }

/* ATTRIBUTE BARS */

.attr-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.attr-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); width: 80px; flex-shrink: 0; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

.attr-val { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); width: 28px; text-align: right; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* GOAL CARDS */

.goal-card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; }

.goal-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; }

.goal-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

.goal-pct { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }

.goal-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); margin-top: 6px; }

/* MACROS */

.macro-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.macro-name { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); width: 70px; }

.macro-nums { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); text-align: right; width: 80px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.macro-val { font-weight: 600; }

.calorie-display { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); line-height: 1; }

.calorie-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text3); }

/* MEAL ENTRY */

.meal-entry { background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }

.meal-entry-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }

.meal-entry-macros { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); margin-top: 2px; }

.meal-entry-cal { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); }

/* STREAK */

.streak-wrap { position: relative; padding: 2px 0 6px; }

.streak-rail { position: absolute; left: 6%; right: 6%; top: calc(50% - 2px); height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border), var(--border)); border-radius: 2px; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; }

.streak-rail-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green2), var(--green)); border-radius: 2px; transition: width .45s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16,185,129,0.45); }

.streak-days { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 0 2px; }

.streak-day { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; position: relative; }

.streak-day .d-name { font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text3); text-transform: uppercase; }

.streak-day .d-node { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; background: var(--bg3); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); color: var(--text3); transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; }

.streak-day.hit .d-node { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green2), var(--green)); border-color: var(--green); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,0.45); }

.streak-day.hit .d-name { color: var(--green2); }

.streak-day.miss .d-node { background: var(--bg4); border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text3); opacity: 0.55; }

.streak-day.future .d-node { background: transparent; border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text3); opacity: 0.5; }

.streak-day.today .d-node { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2)); border-color: var(--accent2); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,142,255,0.18), 0 0 14px rgba(79,142,255,0.55); animation: todayPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }

.streak-day.today .d-name { color: var(--accent2); font-weight: 700; }

.streak-day .d-ring { position: absolute; inset: -4px; pointer-events: none; }

.streak-day .d-ring circle { transition: stroke-dasharray .5s ease; }

@keyframes todayPulse { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,142,255,0.18), 0 0 10px rgba(79,142,255,0.35); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(79,142,255,0.10), 0 0 18px rgba(79,142,255,0.7); } }

.streak-day .d-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1; }

/* PENALTY */

.penalty-bar { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.penalty-text { font-size: 12px; color: var(--red2); }

.penalty-text strong { font-weight: 600; }

/* WORKOUT LOG */

.exercise-row { background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; }

.exercise-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.set-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 28px; gap: 5px; align-items: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); }

.set-grid input { padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; }

.set-num { text-align: center; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text3); }

/* TABS */

.tab-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; }

.tab-btn { flex: 1; padding: 7px 4px; background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text2); text-align: center; }

.tab-btn.active { background: rgba(79,142,255,0.15); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent2); }

/* ONBOARDING */

.ob-screen { display: none; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }

.ob-screen.active { display: flex; }

.ob-header { padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg2); flex-shrink: 0; }

.ob-title { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--accent2); }

.ob-subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); margin-top: 2px; }

.ob-step { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; }

.ob-content { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }

.ob-footer { padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--bg2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; }

.step-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }

.step-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border2); transition: background 0.2s; }

.step-dot.active { background: var(--accent); }

/* Starter selection cards on Step 0 */

.starter-card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; position: relative; }

.starter-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent2); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(79, 142, 255, 0.12); }

.starter-card:active { transform: translateY(0); }

.starter-card-icon { margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; }

.starter-card-icon svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }

.starter-card-title { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 6px; }

.starter-card-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.starter-card-meta { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* Path-aware visibility: applied via classes on #onboarding once a path is picked */

#onboarding.is-beginner-path .beginner-hide { display: none !important; }

#onboarding.is-experienced-path .experienced-hide { display: none !important; }

/* Advanced-mode toggle on Profile — when beginnerMode is on, hide advanced fields */

.beginner-mode-on .advanced-only { display: none !important; }

/* Mirror class — content that should ONLY appear in beginner mode (e.g. Coach Tips) */

.beginner-only { display: none !important; }

.beginner-mode-on .beginner-only { display: block !important; }

/* AI QUEST PANEL */

.ai-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1827, #0f1a2e); border: 1px solid rgba(79,142,255,0.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0; }

.ai-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -30px; right: -30px; width: 100px; height: 100px; background: rgba(79,142,255,0.18); border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(24px); pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }

.ai-card-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

.ai-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; }

.ai-card-header .ai-tag { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }

.ai-loading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); }

.ai-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); animation: pulse 1s infinite; }

.ai-dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }

.ai-dot:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

@keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 0.3; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

.ai-content { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); line-height: 1.6; }

.ai-content strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }

/* WORKOUT SPLIT TABLE */

.split-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }

.split-table th { background: var(--bg3); color: var(--text3); padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

.split-table td { padding: 7px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text2); }

.split-table tr:hover td { background: var(--bg3); }

/* MODAL */

.modal-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75); z-index: 100; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; }

.modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }

.modal { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; padding: 20px; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto; }

.modal-title { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

/* NOTIFICATION */

.notif { position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--green); color: var(--green2); padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; z-index: 200; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

.notif.show { opacity: 1; }

/* XP POPUP */

.xp-popup { position: fixed; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); pointer-events: none; z-index: 300; opacity: 0; animation: xpFloat 1.5s forwards; }

@keyframes xpFloat { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-60px); } }

/* COLORS BY TYPE */

.ic-strength { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15); }

.ic-cardio { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); }

.ic-nutrition { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); }

.ic-challenge { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); }

.ic-habit { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15); }

/* SCROLLBAR */

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }

::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border2); border-radius: 2px; }

/* UPLOAD AREA */

.upload-area { border: 2px dashed var(--border2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text3); font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 0.2s; }

.upload-area:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent2); }

.upload-area input { display: none; }

/* WEEK SELECTOR */

.week-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }

.week-label { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text2); }

/* COLLAPSIBLE */

.collapsible-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }

.collapsible-arrow { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); transition: transform 0.2s; }

.collapsible-arrow.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.collapsible-body { display: none; }

.collapsible-body.open { display: block; }

/* PROGRESS RING */

.ring-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

.ring-label { position: absolute; text-align: center; }

/* ADD BUTTON FLOATING */

.fab { position: fixed; bottom: 80px; right: 16px; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); border: none; color: white; font-size: 22px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(79,142,255,0.4); z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 0.15s; }

.fab:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }

.fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

/* FIELD DESCRIPTION */

.field-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); line-height: 1.45; margin: -2px 0 6px; font-style: italic; }

/* DIETARY CHIPS */

.diet-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

.diet-chip { background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; user-select: none; }

.diet-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }

.diet-chip.on { background: rgba(79,142,255,0.15); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent2); font-weight: 600; }

/* MACRO WARNING */

.macro-warning { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--red2); line-height: 1.5; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }

.macro-warning.amber { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.08); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.35); color: var(--amber); }

.macro-warning.green { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.08); border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.35); color: var(--green2); }

.macro-warning strong { font-weight: 700; }

/* AVATAR */

.avatar-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 8px 0; }

.avatar-svg { width: 200px; height: 320px; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 24px rgba(79,142,255,0.2)); }

.avatar-svg-sm { width: 120px; height: 192px; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 12px rgba(79,142,255,0.15)); }

.avatar-stats-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }

.avatar-chip { background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: var(--text2); font-weight: 600; }

.avatar-chip strong { color: var(--text); }

/* ATTRIBUTE ALLOCATOR */

.attr-alloc-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

.attr-alloc-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

.attr-alloc-label { width: 72px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.attr-alloc-bar { flex: 1; height: 6px; background: var(--bg4); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }

.attr-alloc-bar-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width 0.2s; }

.attr-alloc-val { width: 36px; text-align: right; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.attr-alloc-btn { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border2); background: var(--bg3); color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.1s; }

.attr-alloc-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: white; }

.attr-alloc-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }

.attr-alloc-pending { font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent2); font-weight: 600; }

.points-banner { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(240,165,0,0.15), rgba(255,209,102,0.05)); border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

.points-banner-num { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--gold); line-height: 1; }

/* SHOP */

.coin-pill { background: rgba(240,165,0,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--gold); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

.shop-item { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; transition: border-color 0.15s; cursor: pointer; }

.shop-item.owned { border-color: var(--green); }

.shop-item.equipped { border-color: var(--gold); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(240,165,0,0.06), transparent); }

.shop-item:hover:not(.owned):not(.equipped) { border-color: var(--accent); }

.shop-item-icon { font-size: 28px; text-align: center; }

.shop-item-name { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

.shop-item-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); line-height: 1.3; }

.shop-item-price { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); }

.shop-item-tag { font-size: 9px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: inline-block; }

.shop-item-tag.equipped { background: var(--gold); color: #000; }

.shop-item-tag.owned { background: var(--green); color: #000; }

.shop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }

/* GOAL WARNING */

.goal-warning { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.35); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--amber); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; }

/* INVENTORY BUFFS */

.buff-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--bg3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; }

.buff-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

.buff-icon { font-size: 18px; }

.buff-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

.buff-count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); }

</style>

</head>

<body>

<div id="notif" class="notif"></div>

<div id="app" class="app">

<!-- ONBOARDING -->

<div id="onboarding" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;">

  <!-- Step 0: Starter Selection -->

  <div id="ob0" class="ob-screen active">

    <div class="ob-header">

      <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px;" data-label-key="arise_awakening">ARISE SYSTEM — AWAKENING</div>

      <div class="ob-title">CHOOSE YOUR PATH</div>

      <div class="ob-subtitle">How would you like to start?</div>

    </div>

    <div class="ob-content" style="gap:12px;">

      <div class="starter-card" onclick="pickStarterPath('beginner')">

        <div class="starter-card-icon" style="color:var(--green);"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="leaf" style="font-size:28px;"></span></div>

        <div class="starter-card-title">NEW TO FITNESS</div>

        <div class="starter-card-desc">Just starting out — we'll set you up with a smart default program. Takes about a minute. Penalty system stays off so you can build the habit gently.</div>

        <div class="starter-card-meta">~1 minute · 6 questions · auto-recommended split</div>

      </div>

      <div class="starter-card" onclick="pickStarterPath('experienced')">

        <div class="starter-card-icon" style="color:var(--accent2);"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="swords" style="font-size:28px;"></span></div>

        <div class="starter-card-title">EXPERIENCED</div>

        <div class="starter-card-desc">You know your splits, macros, and what you want. Full questionnaire with every override knob — body fat, activity level, dietary preferences, manual macros.</div>

        <div class="starter-card-meta">~3 minutes · full control</div>

      </div>

      <div class="starter-card" onclick="pickStarterPath('returning')">

        <div class="starter-card-icon" style="color:var(--gold);"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="upload" style="font-size:28px;"></span></div>

        <div class="starter-card-title">RETURNING USER</div>

        <div class="starter-card-desc" data-label-key="returning_blurb">Already have an ARISE backup from another device? Import the JSON file and pick up where you left off — quests, training log, and everything else.</div>

        <div class="starter-card-meta">~10 seconds · imports your data</div>

      </div>

      <!-- Cloud sign-in card — only visible when Supabase is configured. Same path as Returning -->

      <div class="starter-card" id="ob0-cloud-signin-card" style="display:none;" onclick="pickStarterPath('cloud-signin')">

        <div class="starter-card-icon" style="color:var(--accent2);"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="upload" style="font-size:28px;"></span></div>

        <div class="starter-card-title">SIGN IN TO CLOUD</div>

        <div class="starter-card-desc">Have an account on another device? Sign in to pull your data from the cloud and continue here. Auto-syncs going forward.</div>

        <div class="starter-card-meta">~30 seconds · email + password</div>

      </div>

      <input type="file" id="ob0-import-input" accept=".json" style="display:none;" onchange="handleReturningImport(this)">

    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Step 1: Welcome -->

  <div id="ob1" class="ob-screen">

    <div class="ob-header">

      <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px;" data-label-key="arise_init">ARISE SYSTEM — INITIALIZATION</div>

      <div class="ob-title">HUNTER PROFILE</div>

      <div class="ob-subtitle">Set your biometrics to begin your awakening</div>

    </div>

    <div class="ob-content">

      <div class="form-group">

        <label data-label-key="hunter_name_label">Hunter Name</label>

        <div class="field-desc">How you'll be addressed by the System. You can change it later.</div>

        <input type="text" id="ob-name" placeholder="Your name" value="">

      </div>

      <div class="form-row">

        <div class="form-group">

          <label>Age</label>

          <input type="number" id="ob-age" placeholder="e.g. 28" min="16" max="80">

        </div>

        <div class="form-group">

          <label>Sex</label>

          <select id="ob-sex">

            <option value="male">Male</option>

            <option value="female">Female</option>

          </select>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="field-desc" style="margin-top:-6px;">Age and sex drive BMR/macro calculations. You'll choose your character look in a later step — independent of this field.</div>

      <div class="form-row">

        <div class="form-group">

          <label>Height</label>

          <input type="text" id="ob-height" placeholder="e.g. 5'11&quot;">

        </div>

        <div class="form-group">

          <label>Weight (lbs)</label>

          <input type="number" id="ob-weight" placeholder="e.g. 196" step="0.1">

        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- BEGINNER-ONLY: friendly Primary Goal picker (replaces the technical goal-type/body-goal pair) -->

      <div class="form-group experienced-hide">

        <label>What's your main goal?</label>

        <div class="field-desc">Pick the one that best matches what you're after. Don't overthink it — you can change this later.</div>

        <select id="ob-primary-goal">

          <option value="lose_fat">Lose fat</option>

          <option value="build_muscle">Build muscle & get stronger</option>

          <option value="get_healthier" selected>Get healthier overall</option>

          <option value="recomp">Lose fat AND gain muscle (recomp)</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-row beginner-hide">

        <div class="form-group">

          <label>Body Fat % <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;font-size:10px;">(optional)</span></label>

          <input type="number" id="ob-bf" placeholder="leave blank to auto-estimate" step="0.1" min="3" max="60">

        </div>

        <div class="form-group">

          <label>Waist (inches)</label>

          <input type="number" id="ob-waist" placeholder="e.g. 34" step="0.1">

        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="field-desc beginner-hide" style="margin-top:-6px;">Don't know your body fat %? Just enter your waist measurement — we'll estimate it for you using the RFM formula. You can refine later from a caliper or DEXA scan.</div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Activity Level</label>

        <div class="field-desc">Outside of training — your baseline daily movement. Sets your TDEE multiplier.</div>

        <select id="ob-activity">

          <option value="sedentary">Sedentary (desk job, little movement)</option>

          <option value="light">Lightly active (1-2 workouts/week)</option>

          <option value="moderate" selected>Moderately active (3-4 workouts/week)</option>

          <option value="active">Very active (5-6 workouts/week)</option>

          <option value="athlete">Athlete (2x daily)</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Body Type Goal</label>

        <div class="field-desc">The end-state aesthetic you're chasing. Influences quest mix and AI-generated milestones.</div>

        <select id="ob-bodygoal">

          <option value="lean">Lean & Athletic</option>

          <option value="muscular">Muscular & Powerful</option>

          <option value="balanced" selected>Balanced (strength + cardio)</option>

          <option value="endurance">Endurance Focused</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Goal Type</label>

        <div class="field-desc">Direction of energy balance. Drives macro logic — cut enforces a safe deficit, recomp holds calories steady with high protein, bulk adds a modest surplus.</div>

        <select id="ob-goal-type">

          <option value="cut" selected>Cut (fat loss, caloric deficit)</option>

          <option value="recomp">Recomp (lose fat + gain muscle, maintenance calories)</option>

          <option value="maintain">Maintain (no change)</option>

          <option value="bulk">Bulk (muscle gain, surplus)</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Training Commitment</label>

        <div class="field-desc">How many training days per week you can realistically hold long-term.</div>

        <select id="ob-commitment">

          <option value="moderate">Moderate (3-4 days/week)</option>

          <option value="high" selected>High (5-6 days/week)</option>

          <option value="elite">Elite (daily + cardio)</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Meal Prep Commitment</label>

        <div class="field-desc">How much of your weekly eating you'll prep in advance. "Weekdays-only" is popular — prep Mon-Fri, eat freely on weekends.</div>

        <select id="ob-mealprep">

          <option value="none">Minimal (eat out mostly)</option>

          <option value="partial">Partial (prep 2-3 meals/week)</option>

          <option value="weekdays" selected>Weekdays only (Mon-Fri prepped, weekends off)</option>

          <option value="full">Full (weekly meal prep, 7 days)</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Meals Per Day</label>

        <div class="field-desc">Your preferred eating cadence — affects how macros are distributed in meal prep templates.</div>

        <select id="ob-meals-per-day">

          <option value="2">2 meals (e.g. OMAD+1, 18:6 fasting)</option>

          <option value="3" selected>3 meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner)</option>

          <option value="4">4 meals (3 + snack / mid-afternoon)</option>

          <option value="5">5 meals (classic bodybuilder split)</option>

          <option value="6">6 meals (high-frequency feeding)</option>

        </select>

      </div>

      <div class="form-group beginner-hide">

        <label>Dietary Preferences</label>

        <div class="field-desc">Tap all that apply. These filter AI-generated meal suggestions and quest nutrition hints.</div>

        <div class="diet-grid" id="ob-diet-grid">

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="none" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">No restrictions</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="vegetarian" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Vegetarian</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="vegan" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Vegan</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="pescatarian" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Pescatarian</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="keto" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Keto / low-carb</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="paleo" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Paleo</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="mediterranean" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Mediterranean</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="high-protein" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">High protein</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="gluten-free" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Gluten-free</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="dairy-free" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Dairy-free</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="halal" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Halal</div>

          <div class="diet-chip" data-v="kosher" onclick="toggleDietChip(this)">Kosher</div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="ob-footer">

      <div class="step-dots" id="ob1-step-dots">

        <div class="step-dot active"></div><div class="step-dot"></div><div class="step-dot"></div><div class="step-dot"></div>

      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

        <button class="btn" onclick="obBack(1)" style="flex:0 0 80px;">← Back</button>

        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" id="ob1-next-btn" onclick="obNext(1)">Next: Set Goals →</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Step 2: Goals -->

  <div id="ob2" class="ob-screen">

    <div class="ob-header">

      <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px;" data-label-key="arise_step2">ARISE SYSTEM — STEP 2 OF 4</div>

      <div class="ob-title">SET YOUR OBJECTIVES</div>

      <div class="ob-subtitle">Goals drive daily quest generation</div>

    </div>

    <div class="ob-content" id="ob-goals-list">

      <div id="ob-goal-entries"></div>

      <button class="btn btn-full" onclick="addGoalEntry()" style="border-style:dashed;margin-top:4px;">+ Add Goal</button>

      <div style="background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);">

        <div style="color:var(--accent2);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:4px;">SYSTEM TIP</div>

        Examples: "Run a 7-minute mile by Dec 2026", "Reach 12% body fat by Aug 2026", "Bench 275 lbs by Jun 2026"

      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="ob-footer">

      <div class="step-dots">

        <div class="step-dot"></div><div class="step-dot active"></div><div class="step-dot"></div><div class="step-dot"></div>

      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

        <button class="btn" onclick="obBack(2)" style="flex:0 0 80px;">← Back</button>

        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" onclick="obNext(2)">Next: Workout Split →</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Step 3: Workout Split -->

  <div id="ob3" class="ob-screen">

    <div class="ob-header">

      <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px;" data-label-key="arise_step3">ARISE SYSTEM — STEP 3 OF 4</div>

      <div class="ob-title">WORKOUT SPLIT</div>

      <div class="ob-subtitle">Define your weekly training schedule</div>

    </div>

    <div class="ob-content">

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:4px;">Assign a workout type to each day of the week.</div>

      <div id="split-days" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;"></div>

      <div class="divider" style="margin:8px 0;"></div>

      <div class="section-label">Upload existing split (optional)</div>

      <label class="upload-area" for="split-upload">

        <div style="margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--accent2);"><span class="icon-lg" data-icon="calendar"></span></div>

        <div>Upload workout split file (CSV or TXT)</div>

        <div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:4px;">or paste your split below</div>

        <input type="file" id="split-upload" accept=".csv,.txt" onchange="handleSplitUpload(this)">

          </div>

        <div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text2);">

          <div>

            <strong style="color:var(--accent2);">Pre-workout (1–3 hrs before):</strong> 30–50g carbs + 20–30g protein, low fat. Oats + whey, rice + chicken, banana + Greek yogurt all work. Avoid heavy fat right before lifting.

          </div>

          <div>

            <strong style="color:var(--green2);">Post-workout (within 2–3 hrs):</strong> 30–50g protein + carbs to replenish glycogen. The "anabolic window" is wider than legend — total daily intake matters more, but earlier is still better.

          </div>

          <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">

            For early-morning training, a protein shake 15–30 min before is enough. For evening sessions, focus on a solid protein-rich dinner after.

          </div>

        </div>

      </details>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="modal-log">

  <div class="modal">

    <div class="modal-title"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="trending"></span>Log Today's Stats</div>

    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;">

      <div class="form-row">

        <div class="form-group"><label>Weight (lbs)</label><input type="number" id="log-weight" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 195.2"></div>

        <div class="form-group"><label>Body Fat % <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;font-size:10px;">(optional — auto-estimated from waist if blank)</span></label><input type="number" id="log-bf" step="0.1" placeholder="leave blank to estimate"></div>

      </div>

      <div class="form-row">

        <div class="form-group"><label>Waist (in)</label><input type="number" id="log-waist" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 34.5"></div>

        <div class="form-group"><label>Hours Slept</label><input type="number" id="log-sleep" step="0.5" placeholder="e.g. 7.5"></div>

      </div>

      <!-- Optional body measurements + photo — collapsed by default to keep the modal short -->

      <details style="background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;">

        <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);user-select:none;">+ Body measurements & progress photo <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;">(optional)</span></summary>

        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;">

          <div class="form-row">

            <div class="form-group"><label style="font-size:11px;">Chest (in)</label><input type="number" id="log-chest" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 42"></div>

            <div class="form-group"><label style="font-size:11px;">Arms (in)</label><input type="number" id="log-arms" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 14.5"></div>

          </div>

          <div class="form-row">

            <div class="form-group"><label style="font-size:11px;">Thighs (in)</label><input type="number" id="log-thighs" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 22"></div>

            <div class="form-group"><label style="font-size:11px;">Hips (in)</label><input type="number" id="log-hips" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 38"></div>

          </div>

          <div class="form-group"><label style="font-size:11px;">Neck (in) <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;">— enables Navy BF%</span></label><input type="number" id="log-neck" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 15"></div>

          <div class="form-group">

            <label style="font-size:11px;">Progress photo <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;">— resized to ~600px on save</span></label>

            <input type="file" id="log-photo" accept="image/*" onchange="onPhotoSelected(this)">

            <div id="log-photo-preview" style="display:none;margin-top:6px;text-align:center;"></div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </details>

      <div class="form-group"><label>Mood / Notes</label><textarea id="log-notes" placeholder="How did you feel today? Any PRs?" style="min-height:60px;"></textarea></div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

        <button class="btn btn-full" onclick="closeModal('modal-log')">Cancel</button>

        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" onclick="saveLog()">Save Entry</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

</div>

            <option value="Fruit">Fruit</option>

            <option value="Dairy">Dairy</option>

            <option value="Fat/Nut">Fat/Nut</option>

            <option value="Legume">Legume</option>

            <option value="Misc">Misc</option>

          </select>

        </div>

        <div id="food-picker-results" style="max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;"></div>

        <div id="food-picker-hint" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">Tip: picking a food fills macros + micros. You can still edit any field after.</div>

      </div>

      <div class="form-row">

        <div class="form-group"><label>Calories</label><input type="number" id="add-meal-cals" placeholder="0"></div>

      <label style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">

          reps × weight · RPE

          <button type="button" id="rpe-help-btn" onclick="toggleRpeHelp(event)" aria-label="What is RPE?" style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text2);font-size:10px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;">?</button>

        </span>

      </label>

      <div id="rpe-help-popover" style="display:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:30px;z-index:50;width:260px;background:#0a0c10;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;">

        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;">

          <strong style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);">RPE — Rate of Perceived Exertion</strong>

          <button type="button" onclick="toggleRpeHelp(event)" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;line-height:1;padding:0;">×</button>

        </div>

        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:6px;">How hard the set felt, on a 0–10 scale.</div>

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:4px 8px;">

          <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">1–2</span><span>Very light · easy, could go all day</span>

          <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">3–4</span><span>Light · moderate effort, can talk easily</span>

          <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">5–6</span><span>Moderate · breathing harder, still in control</span>

          <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">7–8</span><span>Hard · focus required, 2–3 reps left in tank</span>

          <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">9</span><span>Very hard · 1 rep left, near max</span>

          <span style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;">10</span><span>Maximal · could not do another rep</span>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div id="log-ex-sets" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;"></div>

      <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="addSetRow()" style="margin-top:6px;border-style:dashed;width:100%;">+ Add set</button>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="modal-reset-all">

  <div class="modal">

    <div class="modal-title" style="color:var(--red2);"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="alert" style="color:var(--red2);"></span>Reset All Data</div>

    <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:10px;">

      This will <strong style="color:var(--red2);">permanently delete</strong> your profile, goals, quests, training log, nutrition log, stats history, coins, inventory, and saved splits.

    </p>

    <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:14px;">

      You'll be returned to the onboarding screen and will need to set everything up again. This cannot be undone.

      <span style="display:block;margin-top:6px;color:var(--accent2);">Tip: Export a backup first if you want a recovery point.</span>

    </p>

    <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:14px;">

      <label style="color:var(--red2);">Type <strong>RESET</strong> below to confirm</label>

      <input type="text" id="reset-confirm-input" placeholder="RESET" autocomplete="off" oninput="updateResetConfirmState()" style="text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;">

      <div id="reset-confirm-hint" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px;">Confirm phrase must match exactly.</div>

    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

      <button class="btn btn-full" onclick="closeModal('modal-reset-all')">Cancel</button>

      <button class="btn btn-full" id="reset-confirm-btn" disabled onclick="confirmResetAll()" style="color:var(--red2);border-color:var(--red2);opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed;">Delete Everything</button>

    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<!-- Cloud Sync Auth Modal — sign in / sign up for Supabase. Tabs at top toggle the form. -->

<div class="modal-overlay" id="modal-cloud-auth">

  <div class="modal" style="max-width:420px;">

    <div class="modal-title"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="upload"></span>Cloud Sync</div>

    <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:12px;">

      Sign in to sync your data across devices. Free, private, and your data is yours — sign out any time and your local copy stays intact.

    </p>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px;">

      <button class="tab-btn active" id="auth-tab-signin" onclick="setAuthTab('signin')" style="flex:1;font-size:12px;">Sign In</button>

      <button class="tab-btn" id="auth-tab-signup" onclick="setAuthTab('signup')" style="flex:1;font-size:12px;">Create Account</button>

    </div>

    <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:8px;">

      <label style="font-size:11px;">Email</label>

      <input type="email" id="auth-email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com">

    </div>

    <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:10px;">

      <label style="font-size:11px;">Password <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;">(min 6 characters)</span></label>

      <input type="password" id="auth-password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="••••••••">

    </div>

    <div id="auth-error" style="display:none;font-size:11px;color:var(--red2);background:rgba(239,68,68,0.08);border:1px solid var(--red2);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.4;"></div>

    <div id="auth-info" style="display:none;font-size:11px;color:var(--accent2);background:rgba(79,142,255,0.08);border:1px solid var(--accent2);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.4;"></div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

      <button class="btn btn-full" onclick="closeModal('modal-cloud-auth')">Cancel</button>

      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" id="auth-submit-btn" onclick="submitAuthForm()">Sign In</button>

    </div>

    <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5;">

      Your password is hashed and stored by Supabase. Anthropic and ARISE never see it. Row-level security ensures you can only ever see your own data.

    </div>

  </div>

</div>

function iconSvg(name, size=18) {

  const p = ICONS[name];

  if (!p) return '';

  return `<svg class="icon" width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${p}</svg>`;

}

let state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_STATE));

// ===== STORAGE =====

function save() {

  try {

    state.settings = state.settings || {};

    state.settings.lastSync = new Date().toISOString();

    localStorage.setItem('arise_state', JSON.stringify(state));

  } catch(e){}

  // Cloud sync — debounced upsert to Supabase. No-op when not configured / signed-out.

  try { if (typeof cloudSyncOnLocalSave === 'function') cloudSyncOnLocalSave(); } catch(e){}

}

function deepMerge(base, incoming) {

  // Shallow-ish merge keeping nested defaults that incoming lacks

  const out = { ...base };

  for (const k in incoming) {

    if (incoming[k] && typeof incoming[k] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(incoming[k]) && base[k] && typeof base[k] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(base[k])) {

      out[k] = { ...base[k], ...incoming[k] };

    } else {

      out[k] = incoming[k];

    }

  }

  return out;

}

// ===== CROSS-DEVICE MERGE ENGINE =====

// Combines two snapshots of state — typically a local copy and a cloud copy — into a

// single coherent state without losing data when both have been modified between syncs.

//

// Merge strategy by data shape:

//   * Arrays of objects with `id` (workoutLog, goals, savedSplits, savedRecipes,

//     mealPrep, todayMeals, quests): UNION BY ID. If both sides have an entry with

//     the same id, prefer the side whose top-level state.settings.lastSync is newer.

//   * Arrays of objects with `date` only (logs): UNION BY DATE. One entry per date;

//     prefer the side with the more recently saved state.

//   * Object keyed by date (trackerSheets): MERGE BY DATE KEY. Same prefer rule.

//   * Monotonic counters (xp, coins, streak, level): MAX of both sides. These can

//     only go up — taking the max means a workout XP earned on phone never gets

//     erased by a stale laptop sync.

//   * Profile, settings, macros, workoutSplit, equipped, inventory: LAST-WRITE-WINS

//     by lastSync timestamp. These rarely change so simple is fine.

//   * Cumulative stats (state.stats.totalQuestsCompleted, macroStreak): MAX.

//

// Edge cases:

//   * Empty/null state on one side: return the other side as-is.

//   * Equal timestamps: prefer local (the side calling merge usually has just-saved data).

//   * Missing id/date in array entries: kept on whichever side they originated.

function mergeStates(local, remote) {

  // Defensive — either side may be missing entirely on first cloud sync

  if (!local || typeof local !== 'object') return remote;

  if (!remote || typeof remote !== 'object') return local;

  const localTime = (local.settings && local.settings.lastSync) ? new Date(local.settings.lastSync).getTime() : 0;

  const remoteTime = (remote.settings && remote.settings.lastSync) ? new Date(remote.settings.lastSync).getTime() : 0;

  // localNewer: which side wins LWW conflicts. Tie-break favors local because the

  // caller usually just saved on this device — local is the "source of truth right now."

  const localNewer = localTime >= remoteTime;

  const winner = localNewer ? local : remote;

  const loser = localNewer ? remote : local;

  // Start from the LWW-preferred side's scalars/objects, then layer in array unions.

  // For top-level fields where the winner is null/undefined but loser has a value,

  // fall back to loser's value — losing data because of a stale-but-newer timestamp

  // would be the worst possible outcome (e.g., signing in on a device with a fresh

  // localStorage but a much-older cloud row would erase all your data).

  const result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(winner));

  ['profile','workoutSplit','macros','tdee','equipped'].forEach(k => {

    if ((result[k] == null || (typeof result[k] === 'object' && Object.keys(result[k]).length === 0)) && loser[k] != null) {

      result[k] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(loser[k]));

    }

  });

  // ----- Monotonic counters: MAX (these only go up, never down) -----

  const max = (a, b) => Math.max(parseFloat(a) || 0, parseFloat(b) || 0);

  result.xp     = max(local.xp,     remote.xp);

  result.coins  = max(local.coins,  remote.coins);

  result.streak = max(local.streak, remote.streak);

  result.level  = max(local.level,  remote.level);

  // Recompute rank from the merged xp so it stays consistent

  if (typeof getRank === 'function') result.rank = getRank(result.xp);

  // Cumulative stat counters

  if (local.stats || remote.stats) {

    result.stats = result.stats || {};

    result.stats.totalQuestsCompleted = max(local.stats?.totalQuestsCompleted, remote.stats?.totalQuestsCompleted);

    result.stats.macroStreak          = max(local.stats?.macroStreak,          remote.stats?.macroStreak);

    result.stats.anyFullDayCompleted  = !!(local.stats?.anyFullDayCompleted || remote.stats?.anyFullDayCompleted);

    // lastMacroHitDate: take the more recent date

    const ldate = local.stats?.lastMacroHitDate || '';

    const rdate = remote.stats?.lastMacroHitDate || '';

    result.stats.lastMacroHitDate = (ldate > rdate) ? ldate : rdate;

  }

  // ----- Arrays unioned by id -----

  const unionById = (a, b) => {

    const al = Array.isArray(a) ? a : [];

    const bl = Array.isArray(b) ? b : [];

    const map = new Map();

    // Loser-side first, then winner overrides on id collision

    (localNewer ? bl : al).forEach(x => { if (x && x.id != null) map.set(x.id, x); });

    (localNewer ? al : bl).forEach(x => { if (x && x.id != null) map.set(x.id, x); });

    // Preserve entries without an id (rare — can happen for legacy data) by appending

    const noId = [...al, ...bl].filter(x => x && x.id == null);

    return [...map.values(), ...noId];

  };

  ['goals','workoutLog','savedRecipes','savedSplits','mealPrep','todayMeals','quests','blocklist'].forEach(k => {

    if (Array.isArray(local[k]) || Array.isArray(remote[k])) {

      result[k] = unionById(local[k], remote[k]);

    }

  });

  // ----- Logs: union by date (one weight/BF entry per day) -----

  if (Array.isArray(local.logs) || Array.isArray(remote.logs)) {

    const map = new Map();

    const al = local.logs || [];

    const bl = remote.logs || [];

    (localNewer ? bl : al).forEach(x => { if (x && x.date) map.set(x.date, x); });

    (localNewer ? al : bl).forEach(x => { if (x && x.date) map.set(x.date, x); });

    result.logs = [...map.values()].sort((x, y) => (x.date || '').localeCompare(y.date || ''));

  }

  // ----- Tracker sheets: object keyed by date -----

  if (local.trackerSheets || remote.trackerSheets) {

    // Loser-side first, winner overrides on date collision

    result.trackerSheets = localNewer

      ? { ...(remote.trackerSheets || {}), ...(local.trackerSheets || {}) }

      : { ...(local.trackerSheets || {}), ...(remote.trackerSheets || {}) };

  }

  // ----- Inventory: union sets/titles/gear arrays; max for buff counts -----

  if (local.inventory || remote.inventory) {

    const li = local.inventory || {};

    const ri = remote.inventory || {};

    result.inventory = {

      gear: Array.from(new Set([...(li.gear || []), ...(ri.gear || [])])),

      titles: Array.from(new Set([...(li.titles || []), ...(ri.titles || [])])),

      buffs: {},

    };

    const allBuffs = new Set([...Object.keys(li.buffs || {}), ...Object.keys(ri.buffs || {})]);

    allBuffs.forEach(b => {

      result.inventory.buffs[b] = max(li.buffs?.[b], ri.buffs?.[b]);

    });

  }

  return result;

}

// ===== CLOUD SYNC — Supabase integration =====

// Multi-device sync via Supabase Postgres. Each user owns one row in `user_state`

// containing their entire arise_state blob as JSONB. Row-level security on the table

// ensures users can only read/write their own row.

//

// To enable: paste your Supabase project URL + anon key into the constants below,

// then create the user_state table + RLS policy via the SQL provided in

// CLOUD_SYNC_SETUP_SQL (run it in Supabase SQL Editor). Until you do this, the

// cloudSync module quietly stays disabled — the app works exactly as it does today

// (localStorage only).

//

// Architecture decisions:

//   - Last-write-wins by lastSync timestamp at the state level, BUT array unioned

//     by id/date so concurrent writes on two devices don't lose data (mergeStates).

//   - Push debounced 2s after save — keeps API calls cheap during rapid edits.

//   - Pull happens on app boot (after load()) and on explicit "Force pull" button.

//   - Auth via email + password; magic-link is a small swap if you want it later.

//   - Offline-tolerant: if fetch fails, save() still writes to localStorage. Reconnect

//     detection re-pushes when online.

const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://xdgnqdobgmngohtgdodm.supabase.co';      // e.g. https://abcdefgh.supabase.co

const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InhkZ25xZG9iZ21uZ29odGdkb2RtIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzc1NzMxNzgsImV4cCI6MjA5MzE0OTE3OH0.hNgmx1564vTkeLUVu1e27sTP2u31PK2ikScmeVIYOKo';    // long JWT from Settings → API

const CLOUD_SYNC_TABLE = 'user_state';

// SQL the user runs once in Supabase SQL Editor to create the schema + policy.

// Kept here as a constant for visibility — referenced by the setup walkthrough.

const CLOUD_SYNC_SETUP_SQL = `

-- ARISE Fitness System — cloud sync schema. Run this once in your Supabase project's SQL Editor.

-- Single-row-per-user table holding the entire arise_state blob.

create table if not exists public.user_state (

  user_id    uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,

  state      jsonb not null,

  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),

  schema_version int not null default 2

);

-- Row-level security: users can only see and modify their own row. Without this,

-- the anon key (which is published in the client) would let anyone read all data.

alter table public.user_state enable row level security;

create policy "Users can read own state"

  on public.user_state for select

  using (auth.uid() = user_id);

create policy "Users can insert own state"

  on public.user_state for insert

  with check (auth.uid() = user_id);

create policy "Users can update own state"

  on public.user_state for update

  using (auth.uid() = user_id);

create policy "Users can delete own state"

  on public.user_state for delete

  using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Auto-bump updated_at on every write so we can detect freshness.

create or replace function public.touch_user_state_updated_at()

returns trigger as $$

begin

  new.updated_at = now();

  return new;

end;

$$ language plpgsql;

drop trigger if exists trg_user_state_updated_at on public.user_state;

create trigger trg_user_state_updated_at

  before update on public.user_state

  for each row execute function public.touch_user_state_updated_at();

`;

// Module state — the live Supabase client (or null if SDK didn't load / creds missing),

// the current user's session info, and a debounce handle for pushes.

let _supabaseClient = null;

let _cloudUser = null;

let _pushDebounce = null;

let _lastPushAt = null;

let _lastPullAt = null;

let _pendingPush = false;

let _isOnline = (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine !== false);

// Quick guard — true only when SDK loaded AND credentials are non-placeholder

function cloudSyncAvailable() {

  return typeof window !== 'undefined'

    && typeof window.supabase !== 'undefined'

    && SUPABASE_URL && !SUPABASE_URL.includes('YOUR_')

    && SUPABASE_ANON_KEY && !SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.includes('YOUR_');

}

function cloudSyncInit() {

  if (!cloudSyncAvailable()) return false;

  try {

    _supabaseClient = window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {

      auth: { persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true, storageKey: 'arise_supabase_session' },

    });

    _supabaseClient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {

      _cloudUser = session?.user || null;

      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN' && _cloudUser) {

        cloudPullAndMerge().catch(err => console.warn('initial pull failed', err));

      }

      try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

    });

    _supabaseClient.auth.getSession().then(({ data }) => {

      // Don't clobber a user already set by an in-flight SIGNED_IN event during boot

      if (!_cloudUser) _cloudUser = data?.session?.user || null;

      try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

    });

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {

      window.addEventListener('online',  () => { _isOnline = true;  cloudFlushPendingPush(); });

      window.addEventListener('offline', () => { _isOnline = false; });

    }

    return true;

  } catch (e) {

    console.warn('cloudSync init failed:', e.message);

    return false;

  }

}

async function cloudSignUp(email, password) {

  if (!_supabaseClient) throw new Error('Cloud sync not configured');

  const { data, error } = await _supabaseClient.auth.signUp({ email, password });

  if (error) throw error;

  return data;

}

async function cloudSignIn(email, password) {

  if (!_supabaseClient) throw new Error('Cloud sync not configured');

  const { data, error } = await _supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });

  if (error) throw error;

  _cloudUser = data?.user || null;

  return data;

}

async function cloudSignOut() {

  if (!_supabaseClient) return;

  await _supabaseClient.auth.signOut();

  _cloudUser = null;

}

function cloudCurrentUser() { return _cloudUser; }

async function cloudPush() {

  if (!_supabaseClient || !_cloudUser) return null;

  if (!_isOnline) { _pendingPush = true; return null; }

  try {

    const payload = {

      user_id: _cloudUser.id,

      state: state,

      schema_version: state.schemaVersion || CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    };

    const { data, error } = await _supabaseClient

      .from(CLOUD_SYNC_TABLE)

      .upsert(payload, { onConflict: 'user_id' })

      .select('updated_at')

      .single();

    if (error) throw error;

    _lastPushAt = new Date().toISOString();

    state.settings = state.settings || {};

    state.settings.lastCloudSync = _lastPushAt;

    try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

    return data?.updated_at;

  } catch (err) {

    console.warn('cloud push failed:', err.message);

    return null;

  }

}

async function cloudPullRaw() {

  if (!_supabaseClient || !_cloudUser) return null;

  try {

    const { data, error } = await _supabaseClient

      .from(CLOUD_SYNC_TABLE)

      .select('state, updated_at, schema_version')

      .eq('user_id', _cloudUser.id)

      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) throw error;

    return data;

  } catch (err) {

    console.warn('cloud pull failed:', err.message);

    return null;

  }

}

// Pull cloud state, merge with local, save, re-render. Used on sign-in and "Force pull."

async function cloudPullAndMerge() {

  const remote = await cloudPullRaw();

  if (!remote || !remote.state) {

    // No cloud row yet → push local state up to seed the cloud

    await cloudPush();

    return false;

  }

  let remoteState = remote.state;

  if (remote.schema_version && remote.schema_version < CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {

    remoteState = runMigrations(remoteState, remote.schema_version, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION);

  }

  // Capture whether this is the "first sign-in on a fresh device" case BEFORE merging

  const wasOnboarding = !state.profile && !!remoteState.profile;

  state = mergeStates(state, remoteState);

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.lastCloudSync = new Date().toISOString();

  _lastPullAt = state.settings.lastCloudSync;

  save();

  // Push the merged result back so cloud reflects the union

  await cloudPush();

  // If we just pulled a profile onto a fresh device, exit onboarding into the main app

  if (wasOnboarding) {

    try {

      const ob = document.getElementById('onboarding');

      const main = document.getElementById('main-app');

      if (ob)   ob.style.display = 'none';

      if (main) main.style.display = 'flex';

    } catch(e) {}

  }

  try { initApp(); } catch(e) { console.warn('post-merge re-init failed', e); }

  return true;

}

function cloudSyncOnLocalSave() {

  if (!_supabaseClient || !_cloudUser) return;

  if (_pushDebounce) clearTimeout(_pushDebounce);

  _pushDebounce = setTimeout(() => {

    _pushDebounce = null;

    cloudPush();

  }, 2000);

  if (!_isOnline) _pendingPush = true;

}

function cloudFlushPendingPush() {

  if (_pendingPush && _supabaseClient && _cloudUser) {

    _pendingPush = false;

    cloudPush();

  }

}

// ===== AUTH MODAL HANDLERS =====

let _authTab = 'signin';

function openCloudAuthModal() {

  if (!cloudSyncAvailable()) {

    showNotif('Cloud sync isn\'t configured yet. See SETUP for steps.', 'var(--red2)');

    return;

  }

  setAuthTab('signin');

  // Clear stale fields and error/info banners

  ['auth-email','auth-password'].forEach(id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = ''; });

  const err = document.getElementById('auth-error');     if (err) err.style.display = 'none';

  const info = document.getElementById('auth-info');     if (info) info.style.display = 'none';

  openModal('modal-cloud-auth');

  setTimeout(() => { const el = document.getElementById('auth-email'); if (el) el.focus(); }, 80);

}

function setAuthTab(which) {

  _authTab = which;

  const signinBtn = document.getElementById('auth-tab-signin');

  const signupBtn = document.getElementById('auth-tab-signup');

  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('auth-submit-btn');

  if (signinBtn) signinBtn.classList.toggle('active', which === 'signin');

  if (signupBtn) signupBtn.classList.toggle('active', which === 'signup');

  if (submitBtn) submitBtn.textContent = which === 'signin' ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account';

  // Clear messages on tab switch

  const err = document.getElementById('auth-error');     if (err) err.style.display = 'none';

  const info = document.getElementById('auth-info');     if (info) info.style.display = 'none';

}

async function submitAuthForm() {

  const email = (document.getElementById('auth-email')?.value || '').trim();

  const password = document.getElementById('auth-password')?.value || '';

  const errEl = document.getElementById('auth-error');

  const infoEl = document.getElementById('auth-info');

  const showErr = msg => { if (errEl) { errEl.textContent = msg; errEl.style.display = 'block'; } if (infoEl) infoEl.style.display = 'none'; };

  const showInfo = msg => { if (infoEl) { infoEl.textContent = msg; infoEl.style.display = 'block'; } if (errEl) errEl.style.display = 'none'; };

  if (!email || !email.includes('@')) return showErr('Enter a valid email address.');

  if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password must be at least 6 characters.');

  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('auth-submit-btn');

  if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.textContent = 'Working…'; }

  try {

    if (_authTab === 'signup') {

      await cloudSignUp(email, password);

      // Supabase by default sends an email confirmation. The session may or may not

      // be active immediately depending on the project's email-confirm setting.

      showInfo('Account created! If confirmation email is required, check your inbox before signing in.');

      setAuthTab('signin');

    } else {

      await cloudSignIn(email, password);

      closeModal('modal-cloud-auth');

      showNotif('Signed in — syncing your data…', 'var(--accent2)');

      // cloudSyncInit's onAuthStateChange handler fires the pull-and-merge automatically

    }

  } catch (err) {

    showErr(err?.message || 'Sign-in failed. Double-check your email and password.');

  } finally {

    if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.textContent = _authTab === 'signin' ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account'; }

  }

}

// Render the Cloud Account card on Profile. Three states:

//   1) Cloud not configured → show "Cloud sync not configured" with link to setup steps

//   2) Configured but signed out → show "Sign in" CTA + benefits blurb

//   3) Signed in → show email, last sync time, sign out / force pull / delete data buttons

function renderCloudAccountCard() {

  const card = document.getElementById('cloud-account-card');

  if (!card) return;

  if (!cloudSyncAvailable()) {

    card.innerHTML = `

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.5;">

        Cloud sync isn't configured on this build. To enable: paste your Supabase project URL + anon key into the constants near the top of the JS, run the setup SQL once in your Supabase project, then redeploy. Until then, manual backups (below) keep your data safe.

      </div>

    `;

    return;

  }

  const user = cloudCurrentUser();

  if (!user) {

    card.innerHTML = `

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:10px;">

        Sign in to sync across devices. Phone, laptop, friend's PC — everything stays in step. Your data stays private; we use row-level security so only you can read your row.

      </div>

      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full btn-with-icon" onclick="openCloudAuthModal()"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="upload"></span>Sign in / Create account</button>

    `;

    return;

  }

  // Signed-in state

  const lastSync = state.settings && state.settings.lastCloudSync;

  const lastSyncStr = lastSync ? friendlyTimeAgo(lastSync) : 'never';

  // Online/offline indicator

  const online = (typeof _isOnline === 'undefined') ? true : _isOnline;

  const pendingPush = (typeof _pendingPush !== 'undefined') && _pendingPush;

  let statusBadge;

  if (!online) {

    statusBadge = `<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);background:rgba(244,182,63,0.10);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;">⚠ Offline · ${pendingPush ? 'changes queued' : 'will sync when online'}</span>`;

  } else if (pendingPush) {

    statusBadge = `<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--accent2);background:rgba(79,142,255,0.10);border:1px solid var(--accent2);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;">⟳ Syncing…</span>`;

  } else {

    statusBadge = `<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--green2);background:rgba(34,197,94,0.10);border:1px solid var(--green2);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;">✓ Synced · ${lastSyncStr}</span>`;

  }

  card.innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;">

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);min-width:0;">

        <strong style="color:var(--accent2);">Signed in:</strong> ${escapeHtml(user.email || '?')}

      </div>

      ${statusBadge}

    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

      <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="handleForcePullFromCloud()" title="Pull cloud data and merge with local"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="download"></span>Force pull</button>

      <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="handleCloudSignOut()">Sign out</button>

      <button class="btn btn-sm" style="color:var(--red2);border-color:var(--red2);" onclick="handleDeleteCloudData()"><span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="alert"></span>Delete cloud data</button>

    </div>

  `;

}

// Refresh the "last synced X min ago" string every 30s so it stays fresh.

// Cheap — only re-renders the card, not the whole Profile.

let _cloudAccountRefreshTimer = null;

function ensureCloudAccountRefreshTimer() {

  if (_cloudAccountRefreshTimer) return;

  _cloudAccountRefreshTimer = setInterval(() => {

    // Only refresh when Profile is visible (no point burning cycles otherwise)

    const profileScreen = document.getElementById('screen-profile');
