    if (!profileScreen || !profileScreen.classList.contains('active')) return;

    try { renderCloudAccountCard(); } catch(e) {}

  }, 30000);

}

// Friendly relative time formatter — "2 min ago", "3 hours ago", "yesterday", "5 days ago"

function friendlyTimeAgo(iso) {

  if (!iso) return 'never';

  const sec = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 1000));

  if (sec < 30)    return 'just now';

  if (sec < 60)    return `${sec}s ago`;

  if (sec < 3600)  return `${Math.floor(sec/60)} min ago`;

  if (sec < 86400) return `${Math.floor(sec/3600)} hr ago`;

  if (sec < 2*86400) return 'yesterday';

  return `${Math.floor(sec/86400)} days ago`;

}

async function handleCloudSignOut() {

  if (!confirm('Sign out? Your local data stays on this device.')) return;

  await cloudSignOut();

  showNotif('Signed out.', 'var(--text2)');

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

async function handleForcePullFromCloud() {

  if (!confirm('Pull cloud data and merge with local? Local entries are preserved; only conflicts use cloud values where newer.')) return;

  showNotif('Pulling from cloud…', 'var(--accent2)');

  const ok = await cloudPullAndMerge();

  showNotif(ok ? 'Cloud data merged.' : 'No cloud data found — pushed local instead.', ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--gold)');

}

async function handleDeleteCloudData() {

  if (!confirm('Delete your cloud data? Local data on this device is unaffected. This cannot be undone.')) return;

  if (!confirm('Are you SURE? This deletes your account\'s cloud row permanently.')) return;

  const ok = await cloudDeleteData();

  if (ok) showNotif('Cloud data deleted. Local data unchanged.', 'var(--gold)');

  else showNotif('Couldn\'t delete cloud data — try again or sign out and back in.', 'var(--red2)');

}

async function cloudDeleteData() {

  if (!_supabaseClient || !_cloudUser) return false;

  try {

    const { error } = await _supabaseClient.from(CLOUD_SYNC_TABLE).delete().eq('user_id', _cloudUser.id);

    if (error) throw error;

    return true;

  } catch (err) {

    console.warn('cloud delete failed:', err.message);

    return false;

  }

}

function load() {

  try {

    const d = localStorage.getItem('arise_state');

    if (d) {

      const parsed = JSON.parse(d);

      state = deepMerge(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_STATE)), parsed);

      // Backfill any missing fields on a pre-v2 save

      if (!state.attributes) state.attributes = { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

      if (typeof state.coins !== 'number') state.coins = 0;

      if (!state.inventory) state.inventory = { gear: [], buffs: {}, titles: [] };

      if (!Array.isArray(state.inventory.titles)) state.inventory.titles = [];

      if (!state.equipped) state.equipped = { outfit: 'recruit', frame: 'default', title: null };

      if (!Array.isArray(state.activeBuffs)) state.activeBuffs = [];

      if (typeof state.attributePointsPending !== 'number') state.attributePointsPending = 0;

      if (typeof state.level !== 'number') state.level = 1;

      if (!state.stats) state.stats = { totalQuestsCompleted: 0, anyFullDayCompleted: false, macroStreak: 0, lastMacroHitDate: null };

      if (!state.settings) state.settings = {};

      if (typeof state.settings.mealPrepEnabled !== 'boolean') state.settings.mealPrepEnabled = true;

      if (!Array.isArray(state.workoutLog)) state.workoutLog = [];

      if (!Array.isArray(state.blocklist)) state.blocklist = [];

      if (!Array.isArray(state.savedRecipes)) state.savedRecipes = [];

      if (!state.trackerSheets || typeof state.trackerSheets !== 'object') state.trackerSheets = {};

      if (!Array.isArray(state.savedSplits)) state.savedSplits = [];

      if (!state.settings.mealReminders) state.settings.mealReminders = { enabled: false, times: ['08:00', '12:30', '18:30'] };

      if (!Array.isArray(state.settings.mealReminders.times)) state.settings.mealReminders.times = ['08:00', '12:30', '18:30'];

      if (!state.settings.waterReminders) state.settings.waterReminders = { enabled: false, intervalMinutes: 120, lastFiredAt: null };

      if (typeof state.settings.beginnerMode !== 'boolean') state.settings.beginnerMode = false;

      if (typeof state.settings.plainMode !== 'boolean') state.settings.plainMode = false;

      // Avatar backfill — defaults match DEFAULT_STATE.avatar so existing users get a generic

      // character with `customized: false`, which triggers the first-load prompt to personalize.

      if (!state.avatar || typeof state.avatar !== 'object') {

        state.avatar = {

          customized: false,

          bodyType: 'average', skinTone: 'tone3',

          hair: { style: 'short', color: 'brown' },

          face: { shape: 'oval', eyes: 'brown' },

          outfitStyle: 'casual',

          accessories: { glasses: 'none', accent: 'none' },

          module: 'fitness',

        };

      } else {

        // Patch any individual missing fields so a partial save doesn't break rendering

        if (typeof state.avatar.customized !== 'boolean') state.avatar.customized = false;

        if (!state.avatar.bodyType) state.avatar.bodyType = 'average';

        if (!state.avatar.skinTone) state.avatar.skinTone = 'tone3';

        if (!state.avatar.hair || typeof state.avatar.hair !== 'object') state.avatar.hair = { style: 'short', color: 'brown' };

        if (!state.avatar.face || typeof state.avatar.face !== 'object') state.avatar.face = { shape: 'oval', eyes: 'brown' };

        if (!state.avatar.outfitStyle) state.avatar.outfitStyle = 'casual';

        if (!state.avatar.accessories || typeof state.avatar.accessories !== 'object') state.avatar.accessories = { glasses: 'none', accent: 'none' };

        if (!state.avatar.module) state.avatar.module = 'fitness';

      }

    }

  } catch(e){}

}

// ===== RANKS =====

const RANKS = ['E','D','C','B','A','S'];

const RANK_XP = [0, 1000, 3000, 7000, 15000, 30000];

const RANK_COLORS = { E: '#6b7280', D: '#10b981', C: '#3b82f6', B: '#8b5cf6', A: '#f59e0b', S: '#ef4444' };

const RANK_LABELS = { E: 'Rank E', D: 'Rank D', C: 'Rank C', B: 'Rank B', A: 'Rank A', S: 'Rank S' };

function getRank(xp) {

  let r = 'E';

  for (let i = 0; i < RANKS.length; i++) { if (xp >= RANK_XP[i]) r = RANKS[i]; }

  return r;

}

function getNextRankXP(xp) {

  for (let i = 1; i < RANKS.length; i++) { if (xp < RANK_XP[i]) return { rank: RANKS[i], needed: RANK_XP[i], current: RANK_XP[i-1] }; }

  return { rank: 'S', needed: RANK_XP[RANK_XP.length-1], current: RANK_XP[RANK_XP.length-1] };

}

// ===== ONBOARDING =====

let obGoalCount = 0;

function obBack(step) {

  document.getElementById(`ob${step}`).classList.remove('active');

  document.getElementById(`ob${step-1}`).classList.add('active');

  // When returning to Step 0, clear path classes so the user can pick a different path

  if (step - 1 === 0) {

    const onboardingEl = document.getElementById('onboarding');

    onboardingEl.classList.remove('is-beginner-path', 'is-experienced-path');

  }

}

// ===== ONBOARDING PATH ROUTING (Step 0) =====

// User picks one of three paths from Step 0; the choice configures both UI visibility

// (via path classes on #onboarding) and the final completion handler.

function pickStarterPath(path) {

  const onboardingEl = document.getElementById('onboarding');

  // Reset path classes

  onboardingEl.classList.remove('is-beginner-path', 'is-experienced-path');

  if (path === 'beginner') {

    onboardingEl.classList.add('is-beginner-path');

    // Wire ob1's Next button to finish onboarding directly (skip steps 2-4)

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('ob1-next-btn');

    if (nextBtn) {

      nextBtn.textContent = t('arise_begin');

      nextBtn.classList.remove('btn-primary');

      nextBtn.classList.add('btn-gold');

      nextBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'completeOnboardingBeginner()');

    }

    // Single-step flow — show one filled dot

    const dots = document.getElementById('ob1-step-dots');

    if (dots) dots.innerHTML = '<div class="step-dot active"></div>';

    document.getElementById('ob0').classList.remove('active');

    document.getElementById('ob1').classList.add('active');

  } else if (path === 'experienced') {

    onboardingEl.classList.add('is-experienced-path');

    // Restore default Next button

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('ob1-next-btn');

    if (nextBtn) {

      nextBtn.textContent = 'Next: Set Goals →';

      nextBtn.classList.remove('btn-gold');

      nextBtn.classList.add('btn-primary');

      nextBtn.setAttribute('onclick', 'obNext(1)');

    }

    // Default 4-step dots

    const dots = document.getElementById('ob1-step-dots');

    if (dots) dots.innerHTML = '<div class="step-dot active"></div><div class="step-dot"></div><div class="step-dot"></div><div class="step-dot"></div>';

    document.getElementById('ob0').classList.remove('active');

    document.getElementById('ob1').classList.add('active');

  } else if (path === 'returning') {

    // Trigger the file picker on the hidden input. handleReturningImport handles the rest.

    const input = document.getElementById('ob0-import-input');

    if (input) input.click();

  } else if (path === 'cloud-signin') {

    // Cloud sign-in path — open auth modal. On successful sign-in, cloudPullAndMerge

    // fires automatically via onAuthStateChange and reinitializes the app.

    if (typeof openCloudAuthModal === 'function') openCloudAuthModal();

  }

}

// File-input change handler for the Returning User card. Reuses the standard

// importBackup() flow which itself handles validation, migration, and reload.

function handleReturningImport(input) {

  if (!input.files || !input.files[0]) return;

  // Delegate to the existing import flow — it will reload on success.

  importBackup(input);

}

// Beginner-path completion. Reads the minimum 6 fields and synthesizes sensible

// defaults for everything the experienced path would have asked. Goals get one

// auto-generated objective based on primary goal. Workout split is auto-recommended

// from profile + goal. Penalty mode is OFF by default to keep beginners encouraged.

function completeOnboardingBeginner() {

  const name = (document.getElementById('ob-name').value || '').trim() || t('default_user_name');

  const age = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-age').value) || 28;

  const sex = document.getElementById('ob-sex').value || 'male';

  const heightStr = document.getElementById('ob-height').value || '';

  const heightIn = parseHeightInches(heightStr);

  const weight = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-weight').value) || 0;

  const primary = document.getElementById('ob-primary-goal').value || 'get_healthier';

  if (!weight) { showNotif('Enter your weight'); return; }

  if (!heightStr) { showNotif('Enter your height'); return; }

  // Map primary goal → goalType + bodyGoal + an auto-generated objective.

  const PRIMARY_MAP = {

    lose_fat:      { goalType: 'cut',      bodyGoal: 'lean',     activity: 'moderate', goalName: 'Lose 10 lbs',                  current: weight + ' lbs',     target: (weight - 10) + ' lbs',  cat: 'body' },

    build_muscle:  { goalType: 'bulk',     bodyGoal: 'muscular', activity: 'moderate', goalName: 'Gain 5 lbs of lean mass',      current: weight + ' lbs',     target: (weight + 5) + ' lbs',   cat: 'body' },

    get_healthier: { goalType: 'maintain', bodyGoal: 'balanced', activity: 'light',    goalName: 'Train 3+ days/week for 8 weeks', current: '0 weeks',         target: '8 weeks',               cat: 'habit' },

    recomp:        { goalType: 'maintain', bodyGoal: 'balanced', activity: 'moderate', goalName: 'Recomp: stronger, leaner',     current: 'starting point',     target: '2% body fat down',      cat: 'body' },

  };

  const map = PRIMARY_MAP[primary] || PRIMARY_MAP.get_healthier;

  // Build profile

  state.profile = {

    name, age, sex,

    height: heightStr,

    heightIn,

    weight,

    bf: 0,           // skipped — beginner doesn't know; can compute Navy later if waist is added

    waist: 0,

    activity: map.activity,

    bodyGoal: map.bodyGoal,

    commitment: 'moderate',

    mealPrep: 'partial',

    mealsPerDay: 3,

    dietaryPrefs: [],

    goalType: map.goalType,

    splitNotes: '',

    createdAt: todayStr()

  };

  // Auto-generated single goal (90-day deadline)

  const deadline = new Date();

  deadline.setDate(deadline.getDate() + 90);

  const goalDate = deadline.toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const goal = {

    id: Date.now() + Math.random(),

    name: map.goalName, cat: map.cat,

    current: map.current, target: map.target,

    date: goalDate, progress: 0,

    milestones: [],

  };

  if (typeof generateMilestonesForGoal === 'function') goal.milestones = generateMilestonesForGoal(goal);

  if (typeof checkGoalFeasibility === 'function') goal.feasibility = checkGoalFeasibility(goal);

  state.goals = [goal];

  // Compute macros from profile (BF=0 means computeMacros uses LBM with bf=0 ⇒ LBM=weight, slight overestimate; acceptable for beginners and they can refine later)

  const r = computeMacros({ weight, bf: 20, heightIn, age, sex, activity: map.activity, goalType: map.goalType });

  state.tdee = r.tdee;

  state.macros = { calories: r.cals, protein: r.protein, carbs: r.carbs, fat: r.fat };

  // Auto-recommend split if recommender is available, else fall back to default

  if (typeof recommendSplit === 'function') {

    try {

      const rec = recommendSplit(state.profile, state.goals);

      if (rec && rec.split) state.workoutSplit = rec.split;

    } catch(e) { /* keep default */ }

  }

  // Starter progression bonuses (mirrors completeOnboarding)

  state.xp = 0; state.rank = 'E'; state.streak = 0;

  state.level = 1;

  state.coins = 100;

  // Attribute fields zeroed but no pending points granted — UI was retired with avatar

  state.attributes = { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

  state.attributePointsPending = 0;

  state.logs = [{ date: todayStr(), weight, bf: 0, waist: 0, sleep: 0, notes: 'Starting stats (beginner mode)' }];

  // Beginner-specific settings: keep penalties off so they can build the habit gently

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.beginnerMode = true;

  state.settings.penaltyMode = false;

  state.settings.adaptiveMacros = true;

  save();

  launchApp();

}

function addGoalEntry(pre = {}) {

  obGoalCount++;

  const id = `goal-entry-${obGoalCount}`;

  const div = document.createElement('div');

  div.id = id;

  div.style.cssText = 'background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;';

  div.innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--accent2);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:600;">OBJECTIVE ${obGoalCount}</div>

      <button onclick="document.getElementById('${id}').remove()" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:2px;">${iconSvg('close', 16)}</button>

    </div>

    <input type="text" placeholder="Goal name (e.g. Run a 7-minute mile)" value="${pre.name||''}">

    <select>

      <option value="endurance" ${pre.cat==='endurance'?'selected':''}>Endurance / Cardio</option>

      <option value="strength" ${pre.cat==='strength'?'selected':''}>Strength</option>

      <option value="body" ${pre.cat==='body'?'selected':''}>Body Composition</option>

      <option value="habit" ${pre.cat==='habit'?'selected':''}>Habit / Lifestyle</option>

      <option value="custom">Custom</option>

    </select>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

      <input type="text" placeholder="Current (e.g. 9:30/mi)" value="${pre.current||''}">

      <input type="text" placeholder="Target (e.g. 7:00/mi)" value="${pre.target||''}">

    </div>

    <input type="date" value="${pre.date||''}">

    <input type="text" placeholder="Milestones (comma-separated)" value="${pre.milestones||''}">

  `;

  document.getElementById('ob-goal-entries').appendChild(div);

}

function obNext(step) {

  if (step === 1) {

    const name = document.getElementById('ob-name').value.trim();

    if (!name) { showNotif('Enter your hunter name'); return; }

  }

  if (step === 2) {

    const goals = collectObGoals();

    if (goals.length === 0) { showNotif('Add at least one goal'); return; }

  }

  document.getElementById(`ob${step}`).classList.remove('active');

  if (step === 3) { buildSplitDays(); calcMacros(); }

  document.getElementById(`ob${step+1}`).classList.add('active');

}

function collectObGoals() {

  const entries = document.querySelectorAll('#ob-goal-entries > div');

  const goals = [];

  entries.forEach(div => {

    const inputs = div.querySelectorAll('input, select');

    const name = inputs[0].value.trim();

    if (!name) return;

    goals.push({

      id: Date.now() + Math.random(),

      name, cat: inputs[1].value,

      current: inputs[2].value, target: inputs[3].value,

      date: inputs[4].value, progress: 0,

      milestones: (inputs[5].value || '').split(',').filter(m=>m.trim()).map(m => ({ text: m.trim(), done: false }))

    });

  });

  return goals;

}

function buildSplitDays() {

  const days = ['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'];

  const types = ['Upper Push','Upper Pull','Lower Body','Full Body','Flexibility / Cardio','Yoga','Pilates','HIIT','Mobility','Steady-State Cardio','Sport / Recreation','Rest'];

  const wrap = document.getElementById('split-days');

  wrap.innerHTML = '';

  days.forEach(day => {

    const row = document.createElement('div');

    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;';

    const dayName = document.createElement('div');

    dayName.style.cssText = 'width:90px;font-size:13px;font-family:"Rajdhani",sans-serif;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);flex-shrink:0;';

    dayName.textContent = day;

    const sel = document.createElement('select');

    sel.style.flex = '1';

    sel.id = `split-${day}`;

    types.forEach(t => {

      const opt = document.createElement('option');

      opt.value = t; opt.textContent = t;

      if (state.workoutSplit[day] === t) opt.selected = true;

      sel.appendChild(opt);

    });

    row.appendChild(dayName); row.appendChild(sel);

    wrap.appendChild(row);

  });

}

// Parse height in inches — accepts "5'11"", "71", "5 11", "5-11"

// ===== BODY FAT % AUTO-ESTIMATORS =====

// Used when the user leaves BF% blank but provides enough biometric data for a

// reasonable estimate. Two methods supported:

//   1. Relative Fat Mass (RFM, Woolcott 2018) — needs ONLY height + waist + sex.

//      Validated against DEXA; typically within 3% of true BF for general population.

//   2. Navy method — needs height + waist + neck (men) or +hip (women). Slightly

//      more accurate when measurements are taken cleanly, but requires more inputs.

//

// We prefer RFM because most users only have a tape measure and a scale. Navy is

// available as a more-precise alternative once we add neck/hip capture in onboarding.

function estimateBFRelativeFatMass(heightIn, waistIn, sex) {

  const h = parseFloat(heightIn) || 0;

  const w = parseFloat(waistIn) || 0;

  if (h <= 0 || w <= 0) return 0;

  // Woolcott formula:  RFM = 64 - 20·(height/waist) for men, 76 - 20·(height/waist) for women.

  const base = (sex === 'female') ? 76 : 64;

  const rfm = base - 20 * (h / w);

  // Clamp to plausible range (essential fat ~3% in lean men, ~10% in lean women;

  // morbid obesity tops out around 60%).

  return Math.max(3, Math.min(60, +rfm.toFixed(1)));

}

function estimateBFNavy(heightIn, waistIn, neckIn, hipIn, sex) {

  const h = parseFloat(heightIn) || 0;

  const w = parseFloat(waistIn) || 0;

  const n = parseFloat(neckIn) || 0;

  if (h <= 0 || w <= 0 || n <= 0) return 0;

  let bf;

  if (sex === 'female') {

    const hip = parseFloat(hipIn) || 0;

    if (hip <= 0) return 0; // Women's Navy formula requires hip

    bf = 163.205 * Math.log10(w + hip - n) - 97.684 * Math.log10(h) - 78.387;

  } else {

    bf = 86.010 * Math.log10(w - n) - 70.041 * Math.log10(h) + 36.76;

  }

  return Math.max(3, Math.min(60, +bf.toFixed(1)));

}

// Resolver — picks the best estimate from whatever inputs we have. Returns 0 if

// we don't have enough to make any estimate. Caller should treat 0 as "skip".

function autoEstimateBF(opts) {

  const heightIn = opts.heightIn || (state.profile && state.profile.heightIn) || 0;

  const waistIn = opts.waistIn || 0;

  const sex = opts.sex || (state.profile && state.profile.sex) || 'male';

  if (heightIn <= 0 || waistIn <= 0) return 0;

  // Prefer Navy when neck (and hip for women) are provided

  if (opts.neckIn) {

    const navyResult = estimateBFNavy(heightIn, waistIn, opts.neckIn, opts.hipIn, sex);

    if (navyResult > 0) return navyResult;

  }

  return estimateBFRelativeFatMass(heightIn, waistIn, sex);

}

function parseHeightInches(s) {

  if (!s) return 71;

  s = String(s).trim();

  const m = s.match(/^\s*(\d+)\s*['\s\-]\s*(\d+)/);

  if (m) return parseInt(m[1]) * 12 + parseInt(m[2]);

  const n = parseFloat(s);

  return isFinite(n) ? (n < 12 ? n * 12 : n) : 71;

}

// Returns { tdee, bmr, lbm, cals, protein, carbs, fat, paceLbsPerWeek, deficit }

function computeMacros(opts) {

  const w = opts.weight || 196;

  const bf = opts.bf || 23;

  const heightIn = opts.heightIn || 71;

  const age = opts.age || 28;

  const sex = opts.sex || 'male';

  const activity = opts.activity || 'moderate';

  const goalType = opts.goalType || 'cut';

  const lbm = w * (1 - bf / 100);

  // Mifflin-St Jeor (accurate — was using Harris-Benedict before)

  const wKg = w * 0.453592;

  const hCm = heightIn * 2.54;

  const bmr = sex === 'female'

    ? 10 * wKg + 6.25 * hCm - 5 * age - 161

    : 10 * wKg + 6.25 * hCm - 5 * age + 5;

  const actMul = { sedentary: 1.2, light: 1.375, moderate: 1.55, active: 1.725, athlete: 1.9 };

  const tdee = Math.round(bmr * (actMul[activity] || 1.55));

  // SAFE DEFICIT / SURPLUS LOGIC

  // Cut: 300-400 kcal/day deficit → 0.5-0.75 lbs/week loss

  // Bulk: 200-300 kcal/day surplus → 0.3-0.5 lbs/week gain

  // Recomp: maintenance calories with high protein — drives muscle gain & fat loss simultaneously

  // Maintain: ±0

  let deficit = 0;

  let cals;

  if (goalType === 'cut') {

    deficit = Math.min(400, Math.max(300, Math.round(tdee * 0.15))); // ~15% scales with size, capped 300-400

    cals = tdee - deficit;

  } else if (goalType === 'bulk') {

    deficit = -Math.min(300, Math.max(200, Math.round(tdee * 0.10)));

    cals = tdee - deficit;

  } else {

    // Recomp + maintain: calories at TDEE

    cals = tdee;

  }

  // Protein: bumped for cuts (preserve muscle) and recomp (drive muscle gain in deficit-equivalent muscle state).

  let proteinPerLb;

  if (goalType === 'cut')        proteinPerLb = 1.1;

  else if (goalType === 'recomp') proteinPerLb = 1.2;  // highest — recomp lives or dies on protein

  else                            proteinPerLb = 1.0;

  const protein = Math.round(lbm * proteinPerLb);

  // Fat: 25% of cals, with floor of 0.3g/lb bodyweight

  const fat = Math.max(Math.round(w * 0.3), Math.round(cals * 0.25 / 9));

  const carbs = Math.max(50, Math.round((cals - protein * 4 - fat * 9) / 4));

  const paceLbsPerWeek = deficit ? +(deficit * 7 / 3500).toFixed(2) : 0; // positive = loss

  return { tdee, bmr: Math.round(bmr), lbm: +lbm.toFixed(1), cals, protein, carbs, fat, paceLbsPerWeek, deficit };

}

function calcMacros() {

  const w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-weight').value) || 196;

  let bf = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-bf').value);

  const heightIn = parseHeightInches(document.getElementById('ob-height').value);

  const age = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-age').value) || 28;

  const sex = document.getElementById('ob-sex').value;

  const activity = document.getElementById('ob-activity').value;

  const goalType = document.getElementById('ob-goal-type')?.value || 'cut';

  // Auto-estimate BF% from waist when user left it blank but provided a waist measurement.

  // Falls back to 23% only when neither is available.

  if (!bf) {

    const waistVal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-waist')?.value) || 0;

    if (waistVal > 0 && heightIn > 0) {

      bf = autoEstimateBF({ heightIn, waistIn: waistVal, sex });

    }

    if (!bf) bf = 23;

  }

  const r = computeMacros({ weight: w, bf, heightIn, age, sex, activity, goalType });

  if (document.getElementById('calc-cals')) {

    document.getElementById('calc-cals').textContent = r.cals.toLocaleString();

    document.getElementById('calc-prot').textContent = r.protein + 'g';

    document.getElementById('calc-carbs').textContent = r.carbs + 'g';

    document.getElementById('calc-fat').textContent = r.fat + 'g';

    document.getElementById('calc-tdee-line').textContent = `TDEE: ${r.tdee.toLocaleString()} kcal · LBM: ${r.lbm} lbs`;

    let paceTxt = 'Maintenance — body recomp';

    if (r.paceLbsPerWeek > 0) paceTxt = `Target pace: ~${r.paceLbsPerWeek} lbs/week loss (safe muscle-sparing deficit)`;

    else if (r.paceLbsPerWeek < 0) paceTxt = `Target pace: ~${Math.abs(r.paceLbsPerWeek)} lbs/week lean gain`;

    document.getElementById('calc-pace-line').textContent = paceTxt;

  }

  state.tdee = r.tdee;

  state.macros = { calories: r.cals, protein: r.protein, carbs: r.carbs, fat: r.fat };

  return r;

}

// Live validation for manual overrides in onboarding step 4

function validateOverride() {

  const cal = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-cals').value);

  const prot = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-prot').value);

  const tdee = state.tdee || 0;

  const wEl = document.getElementById('override-warning');

  if (!wEl) return;

  const warnings = [];

  if (cal) {

    if (cal < 1200) warnings.push(`<strong>${cal} kcal is below 1,200.</strong> Sustained intake this low risks metabolic slowdown, muscle loss, and hormonal disruption. Strongly reconsider.`);

    if (tdee && (tdee - cal) > 600) warnings.push(`<strong>Deficit of ${tdee - cal} kcal is aggressive.</strong> More than 600 kcal below TDEE (${tdee}) typically causes rebound weight gain and strength loss. Recommended cap is a 400 kcal deficit.`);

    if (tdee && (cal - tdee) > 700) warnings.push(`<strong>Surplus of ${cal - tdee} kcal is excessive.</strong> Over 500 kcal above TDEE mostly adds fat, not muscle. 200–300 kcal above TDEE is plenty for lean gains.`);

  }

  if (prot) {

    const w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-weight').value) || 196;

    if (prot < w * 0.6) warnings.push(`<strong>Protein under 0.6 g/lb bodyweight.</strong> You'll lose muscle on a cut. Aim for 0.8–1.1 g/lb.`);

    if (prot > w * 1.5) warnings.push(`<strong>Protein over 1.5 g/lb.</strong> Not harmful but not more effective — costs more, fills you up, and crowds out carbs/fat.`);

  }

  if (warnings.length) {

    wEl.style.display = 'block';

    wEl.innerHTML = warnings.map(t => `<div class="macro-warning" style="margin-bottom:6px;">${iconSvg('alert',16)}<span>${t}</span></div>`).join('');

  } else {

    wEl.style.display = 'none';

    wEl.innerHTML = '';

  }

}

// Dietary-preference chip toggler

function toggleDietChip(el) {

  // If "none" is selected, clear everything else

  if (el.dataset.v === 'none') {

    document.querySelectorAll('#ob-diet-grid .diet-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('on'));

    el.classList.add('on');

    return;

  }

  // If any other is selected, clear "none"

  const noneChip = document.querySelector('#ob-diet-grid .diet-chip[data-v="none"]');

  if (noneChip) noneChip.classList.remove('on');

  el.classList.toggle('on');

}

function getSelectedDiets() {

  return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#ob-diet-grid .diet-chip.on')).map(c => c.dataset.v);

}

function completeOnboarding() {

  const name = document.getElementById('ob-name').value.trim() || t('default_user_name');

  const goals = collectObGoals();

  const days = ['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'];

  const split = {};

  days.forEach(d => { const el = document.getElementById(`split-${d}`); if(el) split[d] = el.value; });

  const obCals = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-cals').value) || state.macros.calories;

  const obProt = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-prot').value) || state.macros.protein;

  const obCarbs = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-carbs').value) || state.macros.carbs;

  const obFat = parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-fat').value) || state.macros.fat;

  // BF% — explicit value wins; otherwise auto-estimate from waist + height + sex via

  // RFM. Final fallback is the legacy default (23%) only when we have nothing to work with.

  const obSex = document.getElementById('ob-sex').value;

  const obHeightIn = parseHeightInches(document.getElementById('ob-height').value);

  const obWaist = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-waist').value) || 0;

  let obBF = parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-bf').value);

  if (!obBF && obWaist > 0 && obHeightIn > 0) {

    obBF = autoEstimateBF({ heightIn: obHeightIn, waistIn: obWaist, sex: obSex });

  }

  if (!obBF) obBF = 23;

  state.profile = {

    name, age: parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-age').value) || 28,

    sex: obSex,

    height: document.getElementById('ob-height').value,

    heightIn: obHeightIn,

    weight: parseFloat(document.getElementById('ob-weight').value) || 196,

    bf: obBF,

    waist: obWaist,

    activity: document.getElementById('ob-activity').value,

    bodyGoal: document.getElementById('ob-bodygoal').value,

    commitment: document.getElementById('ob-commitment').value,

    mealPrep: document.getElementById('ob-mealprep').value,

    mealsPerDay: parseInt(document.getElementById('ob-meals-per-day').value) || 3,

    dietaryPrefs: getSelectedDiets(),

    goalType: document.getElementById('ob-goal-type').value,

    splitNotes: document.getElementById('split-notes').value,

    createdAt: todayStr()

  };

  state.goals = goals.map(g => ({ ...g, milestones: g.milestones.length ? g.milestones : generateMilestonesForGoal(g) }));

  // Run feasibility check on each goal

  state.goals.forEach(g => { g.feasibility = checkGoalFeasibility(g); });

  state.workoutSplit = Object.keys(split).length ? split : state.workoutSplit;

  state.macros = { calories: obCals, protein: obProt, carbs: obCarbs, fat: obFat };

  state.xp = 0; state.rank = 'E'; state.streak = 0;

  state.level = 1;

  state.coins = 100; // Starter coin bonus

  // Attributes zeroed but no pending points — UI was retired with avatar

  state.attributes = { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

  state.attributePointsPending = 0;

  state.logs = [{ date: todayStr(), weight: state.profile.weight, bf: state.profile.bf, waist: state.profile.waist, sleep: 0, notes: 'Starting stats' }];

  state.settings.adaptiveMacros = document.getElementById('adaptive-toggle').classList.contains('on');

  state.settings.beginnerMode = false; // experienced path: full feature surface

  save();

  launchApp();

}

function launchApp() {

  document.getElementById('onboarding').style.display = 'none';

  document.getElementById('main-app').style.display = 'flex';

  initApp();

}

// ===== HELPERS =====

function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]; }

function dayOfWeek() { return ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][new Date().getDay()]; }

function showNotif(msg, color = 'var(--green)') {

  const n = document.getElementById('notif');

  n.textContent = msg; n.style.borderColor = color; n.style.color = color;

  n.classList.add('show'); setTimeout(() => n.classList.remove('show'), 2500);

}

// ===== REMINDERS — meal + water =====

// Browser Notifications when granted, in-app toast otherwise. The scheduler runs

// every 60s while the page is open. We track per-time firing on `_remindersFiredToday`

// so the same time slot can't fire twice if the user leaves the tab open.

let _remindersFiredToday = { date: null, mealTimes: {}, waterAt: null };

// Request notification permission. Called from "Test notification" button so it

// happens in response to a user gesture (browsers require this for the prompt).

async function requestNotificationPermission() {

  if (!('Notification' in window)) {

    showNotif('This browser does not support notifications.', 'var(--red2)');

    return 'unsupported';

  }

  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') return 'granted';

  if (Notification.permission === 'denied') {

    showNotif('Notifications are blocked. Enable them in your browser settings.', 'var(--red2)');

    return 'denied';

  }

  try {

    const result = await Notification.requestPermission();

    return result;

  } catch(e) { return 'denied'; }

}

// Fire a reminder via the best available channel. Title is the chip headline,

// body is the supporting message. Always also shows the in-app toast so the

// user sees something even if the browser blocked notifications.

function fireReminder(title, body) {

  // Browser notification — only when granted, otherwise the call would throw

  if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {

    try {

      new Notification(title, { body, icon: undefined, silent: false });

    } catch(e) { /* some browsers throw on background tabs — ignore */ }

  }

  // Always toast so the user sees it when the tab is foregrounded

  showNotif(`🔔 ${title} — ${body}`);

}

// Compare clock-time strings like "08:00" to the current local time. Returns

// true if `hhmm` is within the same minute as now (or at most 1 min stale,

// since the scheduler ticks every 60s and may miss the exact minute).

function reminderTimeMatchesNow(hhmm) {

  const now = new Date();

  const [h, m] = (hhmm || '').split(':').map(s => parseInt(s, 10));

  if (Number.isNaN(h) || Number.isNaN(m)) return false;

  return now.getHours() === h && now.getMinutes() === m;

}

// One scheduler tick — called every 60s. Cheap & idempotent.

function checkReminders() {

  const today = todayStr();

  if (_remindersFiredToday.date !== today) {

    _remindersFiredToday = { date: today, mealTimes: {}, waterAt: null };

  }

  const meal = state.settings?.mealReminders;

  if (meal && meal.enabled && Array.isArray(meal.times)) {

    meal.times.forEach(t => {

      if (reminderTimeMatchesNow(t) && !_remindersFiredToday.mealTimes[t]) {

        _remindersFiredToday.mealTimes[t] = true;

        fireReminder('Meal time', `Time to eat. Log it on the Nutrition tab.`);

      }

    });

  }

  const water = state.settings?.waterReminders;

  if (water && water.enabled) {

    const interval = Math.max(15, water.intervalMinutes || 120);

    const now = Date.now();

    const last = _remindersFiredToday.waterAt

      || (water.lastFiredAt ? new Date(water.lastFiredAt).getTime() : 0);

    if (now - last >= interval * 60 * 1000) {

      _remindersFiredToday.waterAt = now;

      water.lastFiredAt = new Date(now).toISOString();

      save();

      fireReminder('Hydration check', `Drink ~16oz now. Aim for 128oz today.`);

    }

  }

}

let _reminderInterval = null;

function startReminders() {

  if (_reminderInterval) clearInterval(_reminderInterval);

  // Tick once immediately so a same-minute fire doesn't wait up to 60s

  checkReminders();

  _reminderInterval = setInterval(checkReminders, 60000);

}

// "Test notification" button — also triggers the permission flow so the user can

// verify it works without waiting for an actual scheduled time.

async function testReminderNotification() {

  const result = await requestNotificationPermission();

  if (result === 'granted') {

    fireReminder(t('arise_test_notif'), 'Notifications are working. Real reminders will fire at scheduled times.');

  } else if (result === 'default') {

    showNotif('Permission dismissed — try again to enable.', 'var(--gold)');

  }

}

// UI helpers — called from the Profile screen settings card. Each mutates state

// then re-renders so the checkboxes/inputs stay in sync.

function toggleMealReminders() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.mealReminders = state.settings.mealReminders || { enabled: false, times: ['08:00','12:30','18:30'] };

  state.settings.mealReminders.enabled = !state.settings.mealReminders.enabled;

  save();

  if (state.settings.mealReminders.enabled) requestNotificationPermission();

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function toggleWaterReminders() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.waterReminders = state.settings.waterReminders || { enabled: false, intervalMinutes: 120, lastFiredAt: null };

  state.settings.waterReminders.enabled = !state.settings.waterReminders.enabled;

  // Reset last-fired so the cycle restarts from "now" rather than firing immediately

  state.settings.waterReminders.lastFiredAt = new Date().toISOString();

  _remindersFiredToday.waterAt = Date.now();

  save();

  if (state.settings.waterReminders.enabled) requestNotificationPermission();

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function addMealReminderTime() {

  const v = prompt('Add a meal time (24-hour, e.g. 14:30):', '15:00');

  if (!v) return;

  if (!/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(v.trim())) { showNotif('Format must be HH:MM', 'var(--red2)'); return; }

  state.settings.mealReminders.times = state.settings.mealReminders.times || [];

  state.settings.mealReminders.times.push(v.trim());

  state.settings.mealReminders.times.sort();

  save();

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function removeMealReminderTime(idx) {

  state.settings.mealReminders.times.splice(idx, 1);

  save();

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function setWaterInterval(minutes) {

  const v = parseInt(minutes, 10);

  if (Number.isNaN(v) || v < 15) return;

  state.settings.waterReminders.intervalMinutes = v;

  save();

}

function showXP(amount, el) {

  const p = document.createElement('div');

  p.className = 'xp-popup'; p.textContent = '+' + amount + ' XP';

  const rect = (el||document.body).getBoundingClientRect();

  p.style.cssText = `left:${rect.left + rect.width/2}px;top:${rect.top}px;transform:translateX(-50%);`;

  document.body.appendChild(p);

  setTimeout(() => p.remove(), 1600);

}

function closeModal(id) {

  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('open');

  if (id === 'modal-log-exercise') {

    const pop = document.getElementById('rpe-help-popover');

    if (pop) pop.style.display = 'none';

  }

}

function openModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.add('open'); }

function openLogModal() { openModal('modal-log'); }

function openAddGoalModal(goalId) {

  const titleEl = document.getElementById('goal-modal-title-text');

  const saveBtn = document.getElementById('goal-modal-save-btn');

  const idEl = document.getElementById('goal-modal-edit-id');

  const nameEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-name');

  const catEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-cat');

  const curEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-current');

  const tgtEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-target');

  const dateEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-date');

  const pctEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-pct');

  const milEl = document.getElementById('new-goal-milestones');

  if (goalId != null && goalId !== '') {

    const g = state.goals.find(x => x.id == goalId);

    if (!g) { showNotif('Goal not found'); return; }

    idEl.value = String(g.id);

    titleEl.textContent = 'Edit Goal';

    saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Changes';

    nameEl.value = g.name || '';

    catEl.value = g.cat || 'endurance';

    curEl.value = g.current || '';

    tgtEl.value = g.target || '';

    dateEl.value = g.date || '';

    pctEl.value = (g.progress != null) ? g.progress : '';

    // Show manual milestones (don't echo auto ones — they'll regen if target/current/date change)

    const manual = (g.milestones || []).filter(m => !m.auto).map(m => m.text);

    milEl.value = manual.join(', ');

    milEl.placeholder = 'Manual milestones only — auto-generated ones refresh automatically';

  } else {

    idEl.value = '';

    titleEl.textContent = 'Add New Goal';

    saveBtn.textContent = 'Add Goal';

    nameEl.value = '';

    catEl.value = 'endurance';

    curEl.value = '';

    tgtEl.value = '';

    dateEl.value = '';

    pctEl.value = '';

    milEl.value = '';

    milEl.placeholder = 'Run first sub-8 mile, Complete 5 interval sessions, Run sub-7:30...';

  }

  openModal('modal-add-goal');

}

function openAddMealModal(type) {

  document.getElementById('meal-modal-type').value = type;

  document.getElementById('meal-modal-title').textContent = type === 'swap' ? '↔ Substitute Meal' : '+ Log Additional Food';

  ['add-meal-name','add-meal-cals','add-meal-prot','add-meal-carbs','add-meal-fat','add-meal-ingredients'].forEach(id => {

    const el = document.getElementById(id);

    if (el) el.value = '';

  });

  const chk = document.getElementById('add-meal-save-recipe');

  if (chk) chk.checked = false;

  // Reset micros buffer + summary panel + food picker state on every open

  const microHidden = document.getElementById('add-meal-micros-data');

  if (microHidden) microHidden.value = '';

  const microSum = document.getElementById('add-meal-micro-summary');

  if (microSum) { microSum.style.display = 'none'; microSum.innerHTML = ''; }

  const picker = document.getElementById('food-picker-panel');

  if (picker) picker.style.display = 'none';

  // Always reset to Library tab so each fresh meal logging session starts in offline mode

  _foodSourceTab = 'library';

  const libBtn = document.getElementById('food-tab-library');

  const webBtn = document.getElementById('food-tab-web');

  if (libBtn) libBtn.classList.add('active');

  if (webBtn) webBtn.classList.remove('active');

  _lastWebResults = [];

  const search = document.getElementById('food-picker-search');

  if (search) search.value = '';

  const cat = document.getElementById('food-picker-cat');

  if (cat) cat.value = '';

  const lbl = document.getElementById('food-picker-toggle-label');

  if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'Pick from food library';

  openModal('modal-add-meal');

}

// Prefill Add Meal modal from a saved recipe or suggestion

function openAddMealFromRecipe(recipe, type = 'extra') {

  openAddMealModal(type);

  document.getElementById('add-meal-name').value = recipe.label || recipe.name || '';

  document.getElementById('add-meal-cals').value = recipe.cals || 0;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-prot').value = recipe.prot || 0;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-carbs').value = recipe.carbs || 0;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-fat').value = recipe.fat || 0;

  const ingrStr = Array.isArray(recipe.ingredients) ? recipe.ingredients.join(', ') : (recipe.ingredients || '');

  document.getElementById('add-meal-ingredients').value = ingrStr;

  // Carry through micro profile if the recipe has one (set by food-library pick at original log time)

  if (recipe.micros && typeof recipe.micros === 'object') {

    const hidden = document.getElementById('add-meal-micros-data');

    if (hidden) hidden.value = JSON.stringify(recipe.micros);

    renderMealMicroSummary(recipe.micros);

  }

}

function openMealPrepModal() { openModal('modal-meal-prep'); }

function openGenerateModal() { openModal('modal-generate'); }

// ===== FOOD LIBRARY PICKER (inside Add Meal modal) =====

// Toggles the inline picker panel and renders the food list on first open.

function toggleFoodPicker() {

  const panel = document.getElementById('food-picker-panel');

  if (!panel) return;

  const isOpen = panel.style.display !== 'none' && panel.style.display !== '';

  panel.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'flex';

  const lbl = document.getElementById('food-picker-toggle-label');

  if (lbl) lbl.textContent = isOpen ? 'Pick from food library' : 'Hide food library';

  if (!isOpen) renderFoodPicker();

}

// Render the food list filtered by search query + category. Each row has a

// "Use" button that fills the modal's macro fields and stashes the micro profile.

function renderFoodPicker() {

  const out = document.getElementById('food-picker-results');

  if (!out) return;

  const q = (document.getElementById('food-picker-search') || {}).value || '';

  const cat = (document.getElementById('food-picker-cat') || {}).value || '';

  const ql = q.trim().toLowerCase();

  const list = FOOD_LIBRARY.filter(f =>

    (!cat || f.cat === cat) &&

    (!ql || f.name.toLowerCase().includes(ql))

  );

  if (!list.length) {

    out.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px;">No foods match. Try a different search or clear the filter.</div>';

    return;

  }

  out.innerHTML = list.map(f => `

    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;">

      <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">

        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;">${escapeHtml(f.name)}</div>

        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">${escapeHtml(f.serving)} · ${f.cals} cal · P${f.p} / C${f.c} / F${f.f}</div>

      </div>

      <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;" onclick="useFoodFromLibrary('${f.id}')">Use</button>

    </div>

  `).join('');

}

// ===== OPEN FOOD FACTS — UNLIMITED FOOD SEARCH =====

// Open Food Facts is a free, public, ~3M-product database with permissive CORS.

// Endpoint: https://world.openfoodfacts.org/api/v2/search?search_terms=<q>&fields=...

// Per-100g nutrients live in `nutriments` object. We ignore products without minimum

// macro data (calories + protein + carbs + fat) since they'd require manual completion.

//

// Module-scoped state for the picker:

//   _foodSourceTab — 'library' or 'web' (which tab is active)

//   _webSearchDebounce — timeout id for debounced fetches

//   _lastWebResults — cached API response so click-to-use doesn't re-fetch

let _foodSourceTab = 'library';

let _webSearchDebounce = null;

let _lastWebResults = [];

function setFoodSourceTab(tab) {

  _foodSourceTab = tab;

  const libBtn = document.getElementById('food-tab-library');

  const webBtn = document.getElementById('food-tab-web');

  const search = document.getElementById('food-picker-search');

  const cat = document.getElementById('food-picker-cat');

  const hint = document.getElementById('food-picker-hint');

  if (libBtn) libBtn.classList.toggle('active', tab === 'library');

  if (webBtn) webBtn.classList.toggle('active', tab === 'web');

  // Category dropdown is library-only — disable when in web mode (OFF doesn't expose

  // these categories cleanly enough to be worth wiring through).

  if (cat) cat.style.display = tab === 'library' ? '' : 'none';

  if (search) search.placeholder = tab === 'library' ? 'Search foods...' : 'Search any brand or food (e.g. "chobani strawberry yogurt")';

  if (hint) {

    hint.textContent = tab === 'library'

      ? 'Tip: picking a food fills macros + micros. You can still edit any field after.'

      : 'Search any food in the global Open Food Facts database. Per-serving values shown when available; otherwise per-100g.';

  }

  // Re-render with the active source

  if (tab === 'library') renderFoodPicker();

  else triggerWebSearch();

}

function onFoodPickerSearchInput() {

  if (_foodSourceTab === 'library') {

    renderFoodPicker();

  } else {

    // Debounce so we don't hammer the API on every keystroke

    if (_webSearchDebounce) clearTimeout(_webSearchDebounce);

    _webSearchDebounce = setTimeout(triggerWebSearch, 380);

  }

}

// Map an Open Food Facts product into our local food shape so the rest of the UI

// (renderer, useFoodFromLibrary, micros summary) doesn't have to special-case it.

// Prefers per-serving values when both serving_size and per-serving nutriments exist;

// otherwise falls back to per-100g (which is OFF's universal denominator).

function offProductToFood(product) {

  if (!product) return null;

  const n = product.nutriments || {};

  // Pick a sensible name: brand + product name, falling back to either alone

  const brand = (product.brands || '').split(',')[0].trim();

  const productName = (product.product_name || product.product_name_en || '').trim();

  const name = [brand, productName].filter(Boolean).join(' — ') || productName || 'Unknown product';

  // Try per-serving first

  const servingQty = parseFloat(product.serving_quantity);

  let cals, p, c, f;

  let serving;

  if (n['energy-kcal_serving'] != null && n.proteins_serving != null && n.carbohydrates_serving != null && n.fat_serving != null) {

    cals = Math.round(n['energy-kcal_serving']);

    p = Math.round(n.proteins_serving);

    c = Math.round(n.carbohydrates_serving);

    f = Math.round(n.fat_serving);

    serving = product.serving_size || (servingQty ? `${servingQty}g` : '1 serving');

  } else if (n['energy-kcal_100g'] != null && n.proteins_100g != null && n.carbohydrates_100g != null && n.fat_100g != null) {

    cals = Math.round(n['energy-kcal_100g']);

    p = Math.round(n.proteins_100g);

    c = Math.round(n.carbohydrates_100g);

    f = Math.round(n.fat_100g);

    serving = '100g';

  } else {

    return null; // skip incomplete products

  }

  // Sanity guard — drop anything with absurd values that suggest bad data entry

  if (cals < 0 || cals > 1500 || p < 0 || p > 200 || c < 0 || c > 200 || f < 0 || f > 200) return null;

  // Build a minimal micros object from what OFF provides (if anything)

  const micros = {};

  if (n.fiber_100g != null || n.fiber_serving != null) micros.fiber = Math.round((n.fiber_serving != null ? n.fiber_serving : n.fiber_100g) * 10) / 10;

  if (n.sugars_serving != null || n.sugars_100g != null) micros.sugar = Math.round((n.sugars_serving != null ? n.sugars_serving : n.sugars_100g) * 10) / 10;

  if (n.sodium_serving != null || n.sodium_100g != null) micros.sodium = Math.round((n.sodium_serving != null ? n.sodium_serving : n.sodium_100g) * 1000); // g -> mg

  return { id: 'off_' + (product.code || Math.random()), name, serving, cals, p, c, f, m: micros, _source: 'openfoodfacts' };

}

async function triggerWebSearch() {

  const out = document.getElementById('food-picker-results');

  if (!out) return;

  const q = (document.getElementById('food-picker-search') || {}).value || '';

  const ql = q.trim();

  if (ql.length < 2) {

    out.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px;">Type at least 2 characters to search the global food database.</div>';

    return;

  }

  out.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px;">Searching Open Food Facts…</div>';

  try {

    const fields = 'product_name,product_name_en,brands,nutriments,serving_quantity,serving_size,code';

    const url = `https://world.openfoodfacts.org/api/v2/search?search_terms=${encodeURIComponent(ql)}&fields=${fields}&page_size=20`;

    const resp = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'ARISE-Fitness-System/1.0 (personal)' } });

    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Search failed: ' + resp.status);

    const data = await resp.json();

    const products = (data.products || []).map(offProductToFood).filter(Boolean);

    _lastWebResults = products;

    if (!products.length) {

      out.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px;">No matches with complete nutrition data. Try a more specific search, or fall back to the Library tab.</div>';

      return;

    }

    out.innerHTML = products.map((f, i) => `

      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;">

        <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">

          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${escapeHtml(f.name)}</div>

          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">${escapeHtml(f.serving)} · ${f.cals} cal · P${f.p} / C${f.c} / F${f.f}</div>

        </div>

        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;flex-shrink:0;" onclick="useFoodFromWeb(${i})">Use</button>

      </div>

    `).join('');

  } catch (err) {

    console.warn('OFF search failed', err);

    out.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--red2);text-align:center;padding:12px;">Couldn't reach the food database. Check your internet — or use the Library tab for offline search.</div>`;

  }

}

function useFoodFromWeb(idx) {

  const f = _lastWebResults[idx];

  if (!f) return;

  const nameEl = document.getElementById('add-meal-name');

  if (nameEl && !nameEl.value.trim()) nameEl.value = f.name;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-cals').value  = f.cals;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-prot').value  = f.p;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-carbs').value = f.c;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-fat').value   = f.f;

  const hidden = document.getElementById('add-meal-micros-data');

  if (hidden) hidden.value = JSON.stringify(f.m || {});

  if (f.m && Object.keys(f.m).length) renderMealMicroSummary(f.m);

  showNotif(`Picked ${f.name.length > 30 ? f.name.slice(0,30) + '…' : f.name}`);

  // Auto-collapse picker

  const panel = document.getElementById('food-picker-panel');

  if (panel) panel.style.display = 'none';

  const lbl = document.getElementById('food-picker-toggle-label');

  if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'Pick from food library';

}

// Apply a library pick to the open modal: fill macros, replace micros buffer,

// and show the summary panel. Name is only auto-filled if the user hasn't typed one.

function useFoodFromLibrary(id) {

  const f = foodById(id);

  if (!f) return;

  const nameEl = document.getElementById('add-meal-name');

  if (nameEl && !nameEl.value.trim()) nameEl.value = f.name;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-cals').value  = f.cals;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-prot').value  = f.p;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-carbs').value = f.c;

  document.getElementById('add-meal-fat').value   = f.f;

  const hidden = document.getElementById('add-meal-micros-data');

  if (hidden) hidden.value = JSON.stringify(f.m);

  renderMealMicroSummary(f.m);

  showNotif(`Picked ${f.name}`);

  // Auto-collapse the picker so the user can review and hit Log It

  const panel = document.getElementById('food-picker-panel');

  if (panel) panel.style.display = 'none';

  const lbl = document.getElementById('food-picker-toggle-label');

  if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'Pick from food library';

}

// Render the small "Micros included" caption under the macro inputs so the

// user sees that the pick brought in micronutrient data.

function renderMealMicroSummary(m) {

  const sum = document.getElementById('add-meal-micro-summary');

  if (!sum || !m) return;

  // Surface the 3-4 most prominent micros (highest % of RDA) so the user knows

  // why this food matters beyond just macros.

  const ranked = MICRO_KEYS

    .map(k => ({ k, v: m[k] || 0, rda: MICRO_RDA[k].target, label: MICRO_RDA[k].label, unit: MICRO_RDA[k].unit, ceiling: MICRO_RDA[k].ceiling }))

    .filter(x => !x.ceiling && x.v > 0)

    .map(x => ({ ...x, pct: (x.v / x.rda) * 100 }))

    .sort((a, b) => b.pct - a.pct)

    .slice(0, 3);

  const tags = ranked.length

    ? ranked.map(x => `<span style="color:var(--green);">${escapeHtml(x.label)} ${x.v}${x.unit}</span>`).join(' · ')

    : '<span style="color:var(--text3);">no notable micros</span>';

  sum.style.display = 'block';

  sum.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--accent2);font-weight:600;">Micros included:</span> ${tags}`;

}

// Minimal HTML escape for picker output (food names are clean today, but this

// keeps us safe if user-provided overrides ever flow through here).

function escapeHtml(s) {

  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));

}

// ===== INIT =====

function hydrateIcons(root = document) {

  root.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn[data-nav-icon]').forEach(btn => {

    const name = btn.getAttribute('data-nav-icon');

    const slot = btn.querySelector('.nav-icon');

    if (slot && name) slot.innerHTML = iconSvg(name, 20);

  });

  root.querySelectorAll('[data-icon]').forEach(el => {

    const name = el.getAttribute('data-icon');

    const size = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-icon-size')) || (el.classList.contains('icon-title-slot') ? 20 : 16);

    // Add classifier class if not present

    if (!el.classList.contains('icon-inline') && !el.classList.contains('icon-title-slot') && !el.classList.contains('icon-lg')) {

      el.classList.add('icon-title-slot');

    }

    el.innerHTML = iconSvg(name, size);

    el.removeAttribute('data-icon'); // prevent re-hydration

  });

}

// Back-compat alias

function hydrateNavIcons() { hydrateIcons(); }

// Style icon-title-slot spans (used inline within .modal-title, section headers, etc.)

(function addIconTitleCss(){

  if (document.getElementById('icon-title-css')) return;

  const s = document.createElement('style');

  s.id = 'icon-title-css';

  s.textContent = '.icon-title-slot{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;vertical-align:-4px;margin-right:8px;color:var(--accent2);} .icon-title-slot svg{width:20px;height:20px;}';

  document.head.appendChild(s);

})();

function initApp() {

  hydrateIcons();

  applyBeginnerModeClass();

  applyPlainModeLabels();

  renderStats(); renderGoals(); renderQuests(); renderNutrition(); renderProfile(); renderShop();

  renderTrainingLog();

  renderExerciseProgression();

  checkPenalty();

  checkLevelUp();

  refreshGoalFeasibility();

  startReminders();

  if (!state.aiQuestGenerated || state.questsDate !== todayStr()) {

    generateAIQuest && generateAIQuest();

  }

}

// ===== COACH TIPS — beginner-mode learning content =====

// Curated, rotating tips that help beginners build training literacy. Cycled by the

// user via Next/Previous buttons on the Profile card. Order is intentional —

// foundational concepts first, then progressive overload, then nuance.

const COACH_TIPS = [

  {

    cat: 'Splits',

    title: 'How to pick a workout split',

    body: 'A "split" is just how you divide muscle groups across the week. As a beginner, 3 full-body days/week (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri) outperforms 5 isolated days because you train each muscle more often with shorter recovery. Move to upper/lower or push/pull/legs once you can recover well from full-body days.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Splits',

    title: 'Days vs. types',

    body: 'You can rearrange the days however your schedule demands — what matters is the *total* weekly volume per muscle group, not which day it lands on. If life happens, slide the workout, don\'t skip it.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Effort',

    title: 'What is RPE?',

    body: 'RPE = Rate of Perceived Exertion, scored 1–10. RPE 7 means "could do 3 more reps", RPE 9 means "could do 1 more". Most working sets should land at RPE 7–8. Save RPE 9–10 for the last set of a movement, not every set — high RPE every session is a fast track to burnout and injury.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Progress',

    title: 'Progressive overload, simply',

    body: 'To get stronger or build muscle, the body needs a gradually increasing demand. Each week, try one of: +5 lbs on a lift, +1 rep at the same weight, +1 set, or improved form/tempo. Tracking sets in the Tracker is how you spot stagnation early.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Recovery',

    title: 'Sleep is a training input',

    body: 'Muscle adapts during recovery, not during the workout itself. Less than 6 hours of sleep cuts protein synthesis and slashes RPE accuracy — heavy days feel heavier, and you\'re more injury-prone. Log sleep on the Stats screen and watch the correlation with your lifts.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Recovery',

    title: 'When to deload',

    body: 'Every 4–8 weeks of consistent training, take a deload week — same exercises, ~60% of your usual weight, RPE 5–6. It feels lazy. It isn\'t. Deloads let connective tissue catch up to muscle, and you almost always come back hitting PRs.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Goals',

    title: 'Set goals you can measure',

    body: 'Vague goals stall. "Get stronger" is vague. "Squat 185 lbs for 5 reps by Aug 1" is measurable. Use the Sample Goals library on the Goals screen to see what beginner/intermediate/advanced targets look like in each category.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Nutrition',

    title: 'Protein anchors muscle gain',

    body: 'Aim for ~0.8–1.0 g of protein per lb of bodyweight (or per lb of lean mass if you know your body fat). It\'s the single most-impactful nutrition lever for fat loss *and* muscle gain — without enough, neither happens.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Nutrition',

    title: 'Calories before macros',

    body: 'Macros only matter once your total calories are in the right ballpark. If you\'re cutting, you need a deficit; bulking, a surplus. The app calculates both from your stats. Trust the number for two weeks before tweaking.',

  },

  {

    cat: 'Mindset',

    title: 'Consistency > intensity',

You\'ll unlock body fat tracking, commitment scaling, custom meal-prep, and the full goal type picker. You can switch back any time.',

// Cycle index for which tip is shown — persisted to state so it doesn't reset on reload.

function renderCoachTips() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('coach-tips-slot');

  if (!slot) return;

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  const idx = (typeof state.settings.coachTipIndex === 'number')

    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(state.settings.coachTipIndex, COACH_TIPS.length - 1))

    : 0;

  const tip = COACH_TIPS[idx];

  const total = COACH_TIPS.length;

  slot.innerHTML = `

    <div class="card" style="padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--accent2);background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(79,142,255,0.06), rgba(79,142,255,0.02));">

      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">

        <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:var(--accent2);text-transform:uppercase;">${tip.cat}</span>

        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">Tip ${idx + 1} of ${total}</span>

      </div>

      <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text1);margin-bottom:8px;">${tip.title}</div>

      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:12px;">${tip.body}</div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

        <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="cycleCoachTip(-1)" style="font-size:11px;flex:1;">← Previous</button>

        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="cycleCoachTip(1)" style="font-size:11px;flex:1;">Next tip →</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  `;

}

function cycleCoachTip(dir) {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  const cur = (typeof state.settings.coachTipIndex === 'number') ? state.settings.coachTipIndex : 0;

  const total = COACH_TIPS.length;

  // Wrap around so users can keep cycling indefinitely

  state.settings.coachTipIndex = ((cur + dir) % total + total) % total;

  save();

  renderCoachTips();

}

// Modal state — which level + category tab is currently active. Module-scoped so it

// persists while the modal is open but resets cleanly each time the modal opens.

let _sampleGoalsLevel = 'beginner';

let _sampleGoalsCategory = 'all';

function openSampleGoalsModal() {

  // Default the level tab to match the user's mode — beginners see beginner goals

  // first, advanced users see intermediate goals first (a more challenging starting view).

  _sampleGoalsLevel = (state.settings?.beginnerMode === true) ? 'beginner' : 'intermediate';

  _sampleGoalsCategory = 'all';

  // Sync the tab UI

  document.querySelectorAll('#sample-goals-level-tabs .tab-btn').forEach(b => {

    b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.level === _sampleGoalsLevel);

  });

  document.querySelectorAll('#sample-goals-cat-tabs .tab-btn').forEach(b => {

    b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.cat === _sampleGoalsCategory);

  });

  renderSampleGoalsList();

  openModal('modal-sample-goals');

}

function setSampleGoalsLevel(level) {

  _sampleGoalsLevel = level;

  document.querySelectorAll('#sample-goals-level-tabs .tab-btn').forEach(b => {

    b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.level === level);

  });

  renderSampleGoalsList();

}

function setSampleGoalsCategory(cat) {

  _sampleGoalsCategory = cat;

  document.querySelectorAll('#sample-goals-cat-tabs .tab-btn').forEach(b => {

    b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.cat === cat);

  });

  renderSampleGoalsList();

}

function renderSampleGoalsList() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('sample-goals-list');

  if (!slot) return;

  const pool = SAMPLE_GOALS[_sampleGoalsLevel] || [];

  const filtered = (_sampleGoalsCategory === 'all')

    ? pool

    : pool.filter(g => g.cat === _sampleGoalsCategory);

  if (!filtered.length) {

    slot.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;">No samples in this category at this level. Try another tab.</div>`;

    return;

  }

  const catLabel = { strength: 'STRENGTH', 'fat-loss': 'FAT LOSS', endurance: 'ENDURANCE', muscle: 'MUSCLE', mobility: 'MOBILITY', habit: 'HABIT' };

  const catColor = { strength: 'var(--red2)', 'fat-loss': 'var(--gold)', endurance: 'var(--accent2)', muscle: 'var(--accent2)', mobility: 'var(--green2)', habit: 'var(--text2)' };

  slot.innerHTML = filtered.map((g, i) => {

    const color = catColor[g.cat] || 'var(--text2)';

    return `

      <div class="card" style="padding:10px;margin-bottom:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s ease;" onclick="addSampleGoal('${_sampleGoalsLevel}', ${pool.indexOf(g)})" onmouseover="this.style.borderColor='${color}'" onmouseout="this.style.borderColor='var(--border)'">

        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;">

          <div style="flex:1;">

            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">

              <span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:${color};">${catLabel[g.cat] || g.cat.toUpperCase()}</span>

            </div>

            <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);">${g.name}</div>

            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.45;">${g.desc}</div>

            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:4px;">

              <span style="color:var(--text3);">From:</span> ${g.current} <span style="color:var(--text3);">→</span> <strong>${g.target}</strong>

            </div>

          </div>

          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" style="font-size:10px;flex-shrink:0;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addSampleGoal('${_sampleGoalsLevel}', ${pool.indexOf(g)})">+ Add</button>

        </div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).join('');

}

// ===== GRADUATION PROMPT =====

// Surfaces a one-time CTA on Profile when the beginner has been active long enough

// to start graduating to advanced mode. Criteria: 14+ days since profile.createdAt

// AND 15+ quests completed. Suppressed once user accepts ("graduated") or after a

// "Not yet" defer (re-asks 7 days later). Beginner-only via the .beginner-only wrapper.

const GRAD_CRITERIA = { minDays: 14, minQuests: 15, deferDays: 7 };

function getDaysSinceCreated() {

  const created = state.profile && state.profile.createdAt;

  if (!created) return 0;

  const c = new Date(created + 'T00:00:00');

  const now = new Date();

  const diffMs = now - c;

  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000));

}

function shouldShowGraduationPrompt() {

  // Beginner-mode parent already CSS-gates the slot, but check here anyway so we don't

  // do the work for nothing if mode flips.

  if (!(state.settings && state.settings.beginnerMode === true)) return false;

  if (state.settings.graduationDismissed === true) return false;

  // Honor a deferral window

  if (state.settings.graduationDeferredUntil) {

    const until = new Date(state.settings.graduationDeferredUntil);

    if (!isNaN(until) && until > new Date()) return false;

  }

  const days = getDaysSinceCreated();

  const quests = (state.stats && state.stats.totalQuestsCompleted) || 0;

  return days >= GRAD_CRITERIA.minDays && quests >= GRAD_CRITERIA.minQuests;

}

function renderGraduationPrompt() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('graduation-slot');

  if (!slot) return;

  if (!shouldShowGraduationPrompt()) {

    slot.innerHTML = '';

    return;

  }

  const days = getDaysSinceCreated();

  const quests = (state.stats && state.stats.totalQuestsCompleted) || 0;

  slot.innerHTML = `

    <div class="card" style="padding:16px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(244,182,63,0.10), rgba(244,182,63,0.02));">

      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">

        <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;">${t('hunter_evaluation')}</span>

      </div>

      <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:6px;">Ready to level up?</div>

      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:10px;">

        You've been training for <strong style="color:var(--gold);">${days} days</strong> and completed <strong style="color:var(--gold);">${quests} quests</strong>. You've built the foundation — Beginner Mode has done its job.

      </div>

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:10px;">

        Switching to <strong>Advanced Mode</strong> unlocks: body fat tracking, the full goal-type picker (cut/bulk/maintain), commitment + meal prep customization, dietary preferences, and the explicit macro fields. You can switch back any time.

      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-gold" style="flex:1;" onclick="acceptGraduation()">Graduate to Advanced</button>

        <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="deferGraduation()">Not yet</button>

        <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="dismissGraduationForever()" style="color:var(--text3);" title="Stop asking — I'll switch myself when ready">Don't ask again</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  `;

}

function acceptGraduation() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.beginnerMode = false;

  state.settings.graduationDismissed = true; // never re-prompt; user explicitly graduated

  state.settings.graduatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  applyBeginnerModeClass();

  save();

  showNotif('Welcome to Advanced Mode — full feature set unlocked!', 'var(--gold)');

  // Re-render Profile so the toggle visual flips and beginner-only cards disappear

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function deferGraduation() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  const next = new Date();

  next.setDate(next.getDate() + GRAD_CRITERIA.deferDays);

  state.settings.graduationDeferredUntil = next.toISOString();

  save();

  showNotif(`Got it — we'll ask again in ${GRAD_CRITERIA.deferDays} days`, 'var(--accent2)');

  renderGraduationPrompt();

}

function dismissGraduationForever() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.graduationDismissed = true;

  save();

  showNotif('Graduation prompt disabled. Toggle Beginner Mode in Settings any time.', 'var(--text2)');

  renderGraduationPrompt();

}

// Add the chosen sample to state.goals. Uses the same shape as saveGoal so editing

// + tracker integration just work. Default deadline = today + 90 days.

function addSampleGoal(level, idx) {

  const pool = SAMPLE_GOALS[level] || [];

  const sample = pool[idx];

  if (!sample) return;

  const deadline = new Date();

  deadline.setDate(deadline.getDate() + 90);

  const goal = {

    id: Date.now() + Math.random(),

    name: sample.name,

    cat: sample.cat,

    current: sample.current,

    target: sample.target,

    date: deadline.toISOString().slice(0, 10),

    progress: 0,

    milestones: [],

  };

  state.goals = state.goals || [];

  state.goals.push(goal);

  save();

  showNotif(`Goal added: ${sample.name}`, 'var(--green)');

  // Re-render the goals list if it's mounted; close the modal so user sees the result.

  try { renderGoals(); } catch(e) {}

  closeModal('modal-sample-goals');

}

// Toggle Beginner mode from the Profile settings card. ON hides advanced-only

// fields via the .beginner-mode-on body class; OFF restores the full surface.

// Penalty mode follows beginner mode by default but stays independently

// controllable — toggling beginner mode doesn't override an explicit penalty choice.

function toggleBeginnerMode() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  const next = !state.settings.beginnerMode;

  state.settings.beginnerMode = next;

  applyBeginnerModeClass();

  // Sync the toggle visual

  const t = document.getElementById('beginner-mode-toggle');

  if (t) t.classList.toggle('on', next);

  save();

  showNotif(next ? 'Beginner mode ON — advanced fields hidden' : 'Advanced mode ON — all fields visible', next ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--accent2)');

}

function applyBeginnerModeClass() {

  const on = !!(state.settings && state.settings.beginnerMode);

  document.body.classList.toggle('beginner-mode-on', on);

}

  },

};

// t(key, fallback) — return the right label for current plainMode state.

// Pass `fallback` if the key isn't in LABEL_MAP yet (degrades gracefully during dev).

function t(key, fallback) {

  const entry = LABEL_MAP[key];

  if (!entry) return (fallback != null ? fallback : key);

  const plain = !!(state && state.settings && state.settings.plainMode === true);

  return plain ? entry.plain : entry.themed;

}

// displayTitleName(titleObj) — get the user-facing name for a title achievement,

// honoring plainMode. Use this anywhere the title catalog's `.name` is rendered, so

// "Shadow Monarch" / "The Ascendant" swap to neutral terms in plain mode.

function displayTitleName(titleObj) {

  if (!titleObj) return '';

  // The title's id directly matches a key in LABEL_MAP for the swappable ones.

  // Untracked titles (Macro Monk, etc.) fall through to their canonical name.

  const swap = LABEL_MAP[titleObj.id];

  if (!swap) return titleObj.name;

  const plain = !!(state && state.settings && state.settings.plainMode === true);

  return plain ? swap.plain : swap.themed;

}

// Walk the DOM and update any element with data-label-key="<key>" attribute. Called

// after toggling plainMode + once on app boot. Static HTML uses these attributes

// instead of hard-coded strings so we don't have to wire every label through render code.

function applyPlainModeLabels() {

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-label-key]').forEach(el => {

    const key = el.getAttribute('data-label-key');

    if (!key) return;

    const newText = t(key);

    if (newText === undefined || newText === null) return;

    // Preserve any leading icon span by replacing only trailing text node when present.

    // Simple textContent swap is fine for our cases — none of the tagged elements

    // currently mix children with text in a way that breaks this.

    el.textContent = newText;

  });

  // Document title also reflects mode

  if (document.title) {

    document.title = (state.settings && state.settings.plainMode)

      ? 'Fitness System'

      : 'ARISE — Fitness System';

  }

}

// Toggle handler — flips state.settings.plainMode, applies labels, re-renders.

// Re-rendering Profile + Stats picks up the dynamic label uses (e.g., the rank badge).

function togglePlainMode() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  const next = !state.settings.plainMode;

  state.settings.plainMode = next;

  applyPlainModeLabels();

  // Sync toggle visual

  const toggleEl = document.getElementById('plain-mode-toggle');

  if (toggleEl) toggleEl.classList.toggle('on', next);

  save();

  showNotif(next ? 'Plain Mode ON — neutral labels active' : 'Themed Mode ON — Solo Leveling labels restored', 'var(--accent2)');

  // Re-render dynamic surfaces

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

  try { renderStats(); } catch(e) {}

}

function switchTab(tab) {

  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));

  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));

  const target = document.getElementById('screen-' + tab);

  if (target) target.classList.add('active');

  // find the right nav button

  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => {

    if (b.getAttribute('onclick') && b.getAttribute('onclick').includes(`'${tab}'`)) b.classList.add('active');

  });

  // Render-on-enter: pick up latest state

  try {

    if (tab === 'quests') { renderQuests(); renderTrainingLog(); }

    else if (tab === 'stats') { renderStats(); renderExerciseProgression(); renderWeeklyVolume(); }

    else if (tab === 'goals') { renderGoals(); renderTrackerSheet(); }

    else if (tab === 'tracker') { renderTrackerSheet(); }

    else if (tab === 'nutrition') renderNutrition();

    else if (tab === 'shop') renderShop();

    else if (tab === 'profile') renderProfile();

  } catch (e) { console.warn('Render error for tab', tab, e); }

}

// Per-day mutator — wired to the editable split table dropdowns. Updates one day,

// saves, force-regens quests if today's slot changed, and re-renders.

function setSplitDay(day, value) {

  state.workoutSplit = state.workoutSplit || {};

  const wasToday = (day === dayOfWeek());

  state.workoutSplit[day] = value;

  if (wasToday) {

    // Today's workout type changed — quests must regen

    state.questsDate = null;

    state.questsWorkoutType = null;

    state.quests = [];

  }

  save();

}

// Session flag — when true, the recommender card stays visible even if a split is

// already set. Toggled by the manual "Get a recommendation" button on Profile.

let _profileShowRec = false;

function showRecommenderCard() { _profileShowRec = true; try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {} }
