// ===== SPLIT RECOMMENDER =====

// Derives a 7-day split from profile (bodyGoal, goalType, commitment) + state.goals.

// Signal stack: dominant goal category > bodyGoal > goalType, with commitment scaling

// the number of training days. Pure function — returns { Monday: 'Upper Push', ... }.

const SPLIT_TEMPLATES = {

  // Hypertrophy-focused PPL — twice-through with Sunday rest. For strength/muscular.

  ppl_max: {

    Monday: 'Upper Push', Tuesday: 'Upper Pull', Wednesday: 'Lower Body',

    Thursday: 'Upper Push', Friday: 'Upper Pull', Saturday: 'Lower Body', Sunday: 'Rest'

  },

  // Balanced PPL with active recovery — solid all-rounder.

  ppl_balanced: {

    Monday: 'Upper Push', Tuesday: 'Lower Body', Wednesday: 'Upper Pull',

    Thursday: 'Flexibility / Cardio', Friday: 'Upper Push', Saturday: 'Lower Body', Sunday: 'Rest'

  },

  // Cut-leaning — strength sandwiched with cardio days for energy expenditure.

  lean_cut: {

    Monday: 'Upper Push', Tuesday: 'Flexibility / Cardio', Wednesday: 'Lower Body',

    Thursday: 'Flexibility / Cardio', Friday: 'Upper Pull', Saturday: 'Full Body', Sunday: 'Rest'

  },

  // Endurance-first — strength as accessory work, cardio takes the lead.

  endurance_focus: {

    Monday: 'Flexibility / Cardio', Tuesday: 'Full Body', Wednesday: 'Flexibility / Cardio',

    Thursday: 'Full Body', Friday: 'Flexibility / Cardio', Saturday: 'Full Body', Sunday: 'Rest'

  },

  // 3-day full-body — for users who can only commit 3-4 days/week.

  moderate_3day: {

    Monday: 'Full Body', Tuesday: 'Rest', Wednesday: 'Full Body',

    Thursday: 'Rest', Friday: 'Full Body', Saturday: 'Flexibility / Cardio', Sunday: 'Rest'

  },

  // 4-day upper/lower — moderate commitment with strength bias.

  moderate_4day: {

    Monday: 'Upper Push', Tuesday: 'Lower Body', Wednesday: 'Rest',

    Thursday: 'Upper Pull', Friday: 'Lower Body', Saturday: 'Rest', Sunday: 'Rest'

  },

  // Elite — train every day with one cardio day for active recovery.

  elite_7day: {

    Monday: 'Upper Push', Tuesday: 'Upper Pull', Wednesday: 'Lower Body',

    Thursday: 'Upper Push', Friday: 'Upper Pull', Saturday: 'Lower Body', Sunday: 'Flexibility / Cardio'

  }

};

// Pick the template id that best fits the user's profile + goals.

function pickSplitTemplate(profile, goals) {

  const p = profile || {};

  const gs = goals || [];

  // Tally goal categories for dominant-signal detection

  const cats = {};

  gs.forEach(g => { cats[g.cat] = (cats[g.cat] || 0) + 1; });

  const dominantCat = Object.entries(cats).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0]?.[0];

  const commitment = p.commitment || 'high';

  const bodyGoal = p.bodyGoal || 'balanced';

  const goalType = p.goalType || 'maintain';

  // Step 1: commitment is a hard cap — moderate users can't run a 6-day split

  if (commitment === 'moderate') {

    // 3-4 day templates only. Strength bias → 4-day, otherwise 3-day full-body

    if (dominantCat === 'strength' || bodyGoal === 'muscular') return 'moderate_4day';

    return 'moderate_3day';

  }

  if (commitment === 'elite') {

    return 'elite_7day';

  }

  // Step 2: high commitment (5-6 days) — branch on goal signals

  if (dominantCat === 'endurance' || bodyGoal === 'endurance') return 'endurance_focus';

  if (dominantCat === 'strength' || bodyGoal === 'muscular') return 'ppl_max';

  if (bodyGoal === 'lean' || goalType === 'cut') return 'lean_cut';

  return 'ppl_balanced';

}

// Public entry — returns the recommended split as a {day: workoutType} map plus

// metadata about why it was chosen (for the UI to surface).

function recommendSplit(profile, goals) {

  const id = pickSplitTemplate(profile, goals);

  const template = SPLIT_TEMPLATES[id];

  const reasons = {

    ppl_max: 'Hypertrophy push/pull/legs — strength signal dominant.',

    ppl_balanced: 'Balanced upper/lower split with one active-recovery day.',

    lean_cut: 'Strength + cardio mix optimized for a calorie deficit.',

    endurance_focus: 'Cardio-led with full-body lifts as accessories.',

    moderate_3day: 'Three full-body sessions — fits a 3-day commitment.',

    moderate_4day: 'Upper/lower 4-day split with strength bias.',

    elite_7day: 'Daily training with active recovery on Sunday.'

  };

  return { id, split: { ...template }, reason: reasons[id] || '' };

}

// True if the user has a meaningful split set (not empty, not all "Rest").

function hasUserSplit() {

  const s = state.workoutSplit || {};

  const days = Object.values(s);

  if (!days.length) return false;

  return days.some(v => v && v !== 'Rest');

}

// Apply a recommended split to state and re-render relevant screens.

function applyRecommendedSplit() {

  const rec = recommendSplit(state.profile, state.goals);

  setActiveSplit(rec.split, { source: 'recommended', toast: 'Recommended split applied — quests regenerated.' });

}

// Set state.workoutSplit and force a quest regen so today's quests reflect the new

// day's workout type. Used by the recommender, by Activate-from-library, and any

// other code path that swaps the active split. Preserves completed quests by name

// match — same logic as the existing renderQuests regen path.

function setActiveSplit(splitDays, opts) {

  opts = opts || {};

  state.workoutSplit = { ...splitDays };

  state.questsDate = null;

  state.questsWorkoutType = null;

  state.quests = [];

  save();

  showNotif(opts.toast || 'Split updated — quests regenerated.');

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

  try { renderQuests(); } catch(e) {}

}

// ===== SAVED SPLITS LIBRARY =====

// Save the currently-active workoutSplit as a named preset. Returns the new entry.

function saveCurrentSplitAs(name) {

  const trimmed = (name || '').trim();

  if (!trimmed) { showNotif('Need a name for the preset.'); return null; }

  const existing = (state.savedSplits || []).find(s => s.name.toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase());

  if (existing) {

    if (!confirm(`A preset named "${trimmed}" already exists. Overwrite?`)) return null;

    existing.days = { ...state.workoutSplit };

    existing.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    save();

    showNotif(`Preset "${trimmed}" updated.`);

    return existing;

  }

  const entry = {

    id: 'sp_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),

    name: trimmed,

    days: { ...state.workoutSplit },

    source: 'manual',

    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()

  };

  state.savedSplits = state.savedSplits || [];

  state.savedSplits.push(entry);

  save();

  showNotif(`Preset "${trimmed}" saved.`);

  return entry;

}

// UI handler — prompt the user for a name then save.

function promptSaveCurrentSplit() {

  const name = prompt('Name this split preset:', '');

  if (!name) return;

  saveCurrentSplitAs(name);

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

// Activate a saved split — copies its days into state.workoutSplit and regens.

function activateSavedSplit(splitId) {

  const sp = (state.savedSplits || []).find(s => s.id === splitId);

  if (!sp) return;

  setActiveSplit(sp.days, { toast: `Activated "${sp.name}".` });

}

// Remove a saved split from the library (with confirm).

function deleteSavedSplit(splitId) {

  const sp = (state.savedSplits || []).find(s => s.id === splitId);

  if (!sp) return;

  if (!confirm(`Delete preset "${sp.name}"?`)) return;

  state.savedSplits = state.savedSplits.filter(s => s.id !== splitId);

  save();

  showNotif(`Preset "${sp.name}" deleted.`);

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

// Save a recommended split directly into the library (used by the recommender card).

function saveRecommendedSplit() {

  const rec = recommendSplit(state.profile, state.goals);

  const defaultName = rec.id.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());

  const name = prompt('Name this preset:', defaultName);

  if (!name) return;

  state.savedSplits = state.savedSplits || [];

  state.savedSplits.push({

    id: 'sp_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),

    name: name.trim(),

    days: { ...rec.split },

    source: 'recommended',

    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()

  });

  save();

  showNotif(`Preset "${name.trim()}" saved.`);

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

// ===== SPLIT ANALYZER (tips) =====

// Mild policy — only flag clear mismatches between the split and the user's goals.

// Returns array of { level, message } where level is 'tip' (informational, blue) or

// 'warn' (likely problem, amber). Empty array means the split looks well-aligned.

function analyzeSplit(split, profile, goals) {

  const out = [];

  const days = ['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'];

  const seq = days.map(d => split[d] || 'Rest');

  const isTraining = t => t && t !== 'Rest';

  const trainingCount = seq.filter(isTraining).length;

  const restCount = seq.filter(t => t === 'Rest').length;

  const strengthCount = seq.filter(t => t === 'Upper Push' || t === 'Upper Pull' || t === 'Lower Body' || t === 'Full Body').length;

  const cardioCount = seq.filter(t => t === 'Flexibility / Cardio').length;

  const legCount = seq.filter(t => t === 'Lower Body' || t === 'Full Body').length;

  // Tally goal categories from the goals array

  const cats = {};

  (goals || []).forEach(g => { cats[g.cat] = (cats[g.cat] || 0) + 1; });

  const p = profile || {};

  const commitment = p.commitment || 'high';

  const bodyGoal = p.bodyGoal || 'balanced';

  const goalType = p.goalType || 'maintain';

  const wantsStrength = cats.strength > 0 || bodyGoal === 'muscular';

  const wantsEndurance = cats.endurance > 0 || bodyGoal === 'endurance';

  // 1. Training-day count vs commitment

  const expected = { moderate: [3, 4], high: [5, 6], elite: [6, 7] }[commitment] || [4, 6];

  if (trainingCount < expected[0]) {

    out.push({ level: 'tip', message: `Only ${trainingCount} training days — your "${commitment}" commitment usually targets ${expected[0]}–${expected[1]}.` });

  } else if (trainingCount > expected[1]) {

    out.push({ level: 'warn', message: `${trainingCount} training days exceeds your "${commitment}" commitment (${expected[0]}–${expected[1]}). Risk of burnout.` });

  }

  // 2. Strength signal but few/no strength days

  if (wantsStrength && strengthCount < 3) {

    out.push({ level: 'warn', message: `Strength goal but only ${strengthCount} resistance day${strengthCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}. Aim for 3+.` });

  }

  // 3. Endurance signal but no cardio days

  if (wantsEndurance && cardioCount === 0) {

    out.push({ level: 'warn', message: 'Endurance goal but no cardio days scheduled.' });

  }

  // 4. Cut + zero cardio (mild tip — not strictly required but helps)

  if (goalType === 'cut' && cardioCount === 0 && !wantsEndurance) {

    out.push({ level: 'tip', message: 'On a cut — adding 1 cardio day can help energy expenditure.' });

  }

  // 5. Strength-leaning split missing leg day entirely

  if (wantsStrength && legCount === 0) {

    out.push({ level: 'warn', message: 'No leg or full-body day — strength programming should hit lower body weekly.' });

  }

  // 6. No rest day at all

  if (restCount === 0 && commitment !== 'elite') {

    out.push({ level: 'warn', message: 'No rest day in the week. Recovery suffers and injury risk climbs.' });

  }

  // 7. ≥5 consecutive training days

  let run = 0, maxRun = 0;

  // Treat the week as cyclic so Mon-Sun-Mon stretches count

  const cyclic = seq.concat(seq);

  cyclic.forEach(t => { if (isTraining(t)) { run++; maxRun = Math.max(maxRun, run); } else run = 0; });

  // Cap maxRun at 7 (full week), since a 14-day cyclic count for an all-training week is misleading

  maxRun = Math.min(maxRun, 7);

  if (maxRun >= 5 && commitment !== 'elite') {

    out.push({ level: 'tip', message: `${maxRun} training days in a row without rest — consider inserting a rest or active-recovery day.` });

  }

  // 8. Same lower-body / push / pull twice back-to-back (cyclic check)

  for (let i = 0; i < seq.length; i++) {

    const a = seq[i];

    const b = seq[(i + 1) % seq.length];

    if (a === b && isTraining(a) && a !== 'Flexibility / Cardio' && a !== 'Full Body') {

      out.push({ level: 'tip', message: `${days[i]} → ${days[(i+1)%7]} both target ${a}. Same muscle group on consecutive days limits recovery.` });

      break; // one mention is enough — don't list every collision

    }

  }

  return out;

}

const QUEST_TEMPLATES = {

  ],

// ===== QUEST CONTINUITY — linear progression on compound lifts =====

// The hard-coded QUEST_TEMPLATES describe a generic session. When the user has

// logged a primary compound recently, we enrich the description with a personalized

// progression target ("Bench: last 4×8 @165 — today aim 4×8 @170") so they see

// continuity instead of a fresh-feeling random quest each day.

//

// Mapping: each workout type → its anchor compound. Picked based on what most

// progress-driven programs treat as the "main lift" for that day. We deliberately

// stick to the canonical names so suggestNextLift's history lookup works without

// alias resolution (free-typed names won't get continuity but template-followers will).

const COMPOUND_ANCHORS = {

  'Upper Push': 'Bench Press',

  'Upper Pull': 'Pull-Up',           // falls through to Barbell Row if no pull-up history

  'Lower Body': 'Squat',

  'Full Body':  'Deadlift',          // anchor on the heaviest single lift in a full-body day

};

// Secondary anchor when the primary has no history yet (e.g., user can't pull up so they

// never logged one). Lets continuity kick in for newer lifters working alternate variations.

const COMPOUND_FALLBACKS = {

  'Upper Pull': 'Barbell Row',

  'Full Body':  'Squat',

};

// Returns a continuity hint string for the workout type, or empty string if no

// usable history. Format: "Bench Press · last 4×8 @165 (5d ago) → today aim 4×8 @170"

function buildContinuityHint(workoutType) {

  const anchor = COMPOUND_ANCHORS[workoutType];

  if (!anchor) return '';

  let sug = (typeof suggestNextLift === 'function') ? suggestNextLift(anchor) : null;

  let lift = anchor;

  if (!sug && COMPOUND_FALLBACKS[workoutType]) {

    lift = COMPOUND_FALLBACKS[workoutType];

    sug = suggestNextLift(lift);

  }

  if (!sug) return '';

  // Days-ago helper for human readability

  const lastDate = sug.lastDate ? new Date(sug.lastDate + 'T00:00:00') : null;

  const daysAgo = lastDate ? Math.max(0, Math.round((new Date() - lastDate) / 86400000)) : null;

  const ago = (daysAgo == null) ? '' : daysAgo === 0 ? 'today' : `${daysAgo}d ago`;

  return `${lift} · last ${sug.last}${ago ? ` (${ago})` : ''} → today aim ${sug.nextReps} × ${sug.nextWeight} lbs`;

}

// Bodyweight fallback templates — used when state.settings.vacationMode is true.

// Substitutes barbell/cable lifts with hotel-room-friendly alternatives. XP slightly

// reduced to reflect lower load, but kept close so streaks aren't punished for traveling.

const BODYWEIGHT_QUEST_TEMPLATES = {

  'Upper Push': [

// Three-state vacation mode: 'off' / 'travel' / 'rest'.

//   off    — normal training quests

//   travel — bodyweight substitutions (the legacy "vacationMode" behavior)

//   rest   — skip workout quests entirely; only nutrition + habit + challenge remain

//

// We keep state.settings.vacationMode as a boolean for back-compat with old saves

// and add state.settings.vacationVariant ('travel' | 'rest') alongside. boolean is

// derived: vacationMode = variant === 'travel' || variant === 'rest'.

function setVacationMode(value) {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  if (value === 'off') {

    state.settings.vacationMode = false;

    state.settings.vacationVariant = null;

  } else {

    state.settings.vacationMode = true;

    state.settings.vacationVariant = value; // 'travel' or 'rest'

  }

  // Sync select UI in case this was called programmatically

  const sel = document.getElementById('vacation-select');

  if (sel && sel.value !== value) sel.value = value;

  // Force regen

  state.questsDate = null;

  state.questsWorkoutType = null;

  state.quests = [];

  save();

  const msg = value === 'off'

    ? 'Vacation mode OFF — back to your normal split.'

    : value === 'travel'

      ? 'Travel mode ON — bodyweight quest substitutions active.'

      : 'Rest block ON — workout quests skipped, nutrition unchanged.';

  showNotif(msg);

  try { renderQuests(); } catch(e) {}

}

// Legacy entry point (banner Turn off button still calls this) — maps to setVacationMode.

function toggleVacationMode() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  const isOn = state.settings.vacationMode === true;

  setVacationMode(isOn ? 'off' : 'travel');

}

// MICRONUTRIENT TRACKING — Core 8 micros + adult RDA targets.

// Sodium is shown as a ceiling (less is better); all others are floors (more is better).

// Values are general adult references; users can override via manual entry on individual meals.

  satFat:     { label: 'Saturated Fat', unit: 'g',   target: 22,   ceiling: true  },

  addedSugar: { label: 'Added Sugar',   unit: 'g',   target: 50,   ceiling: true  },

};

const MICRO_KEYS = ['fiber','iron','calcium','magnesium','potassium','sodium','vitC','vitD','vitB12','folate','zinc','omega3','satFat','addedSugar'];

// Dietary-restriction-aware micro flagging. Returns { critical: bool, note: string }

// when a particular micro is a known concern for the user's dietary profile. Used by

// renderMicrosCard to surface a small badge — vegans miss B12, vegetarians often

// underconsume B12 + iron + zinc + omega-3, etc.

const DIETARY_MICRO_FLAGS = {

  vegan: {

    vitB12: { critical: true,  note: 'Vegans must supplement — B12 is essentially absent in plant foods.' },

    iron:   { critical: false, note: 'Plant iron is less bioavailable; pair with vitamin C to absorb more.' },

    zinc:   { critical: false, note: 'Slightly higher needs on plant-only diets due to phytate binding.' },

    omega3: { critical: false, note: 'EPA/DHA from algae oil; ALA from flax/chia/walnuts converts poorly.' },

    vitD:   { critical: false, note: 'Limited plant sources — fortified foods or supplement.' },

    calcium:{ critical: false, note: 'Watch fortified plant milks + tofu set with calcium sulfate.' },

  },

  vegetarian: {

    vitB12: { critical: false, note: 'Eggs + dairy provide B12 but at lower levels than meat.' },

    iron:   { critical: false, note: 'Plant iron is less bioavailable; pair with vitamin C to absorb more.' },

    omega3: { critical: false, note: 'EPA/DHA mainly from fish — consider algae oil or fortified eggs.' },

  },

  pescatarian: {

    iron: { critical: false, note: 'Heme iron from fish helps; red meat-free still warrants attention.' },

  },

  keto: {

    fiber: { critical: false, note: 'Low-carb often means low-fiber — prioritize leafy greens and chia/flax.' },

  },

};

function getDietaryFlag(microKey) {

  const prefs = (state.profile && state.profile.dietaryPrefs) || [];

  for (const pref of prefs) {

    const flags = DIETARY_MICRO_FLAGS[pref];

    if (flags && flags[microKey]) return { ...flags[microKey], pref };

  }

  return null;

}
