  { id:'protein-bar',    name:'Protein Bar (avg)',  cat:'Misc', serving:'1 bar (60g)',cals:220, p:20, c:22, f:7,  m:{fiber:5,iron:4,calcium:200,magnesium:60,potassium:200,sodium:200,vitC:6,vitD:1}},

];

// Helper: get a food entry by id

function foodById(id) { return FOOD_LIBRARY.find(f => f.id === id); }

// Helper: empty micro profile (used for backfill / new meals without micro data)

function emptyMicros() { const m = {}; MICRO_KEYS.forEach(k => m[k] = 0); return m; }

const DAILY_CHALLENGES = [

  { name: '100 Rep Challenge', desc: '100 push-ups anytime today (break into sets)', icon: 'zap', type: 'challenge', xp: 120 },

  { name: 'Mile Time Trial', desc: 'Run 1 mile, log your pace — beat your last time', icon: 'activity', type: 'cardio', xp: 130 },

  { name: 'Plank Hold', desc: 'Accumulate 5 minutes of plank holds', icon: 'hourglass', type: 'challenge', xp: 80 },

  { name: '200 Steps Challenge', desc: '10,000+ steps today', icon: 'footprints', type: 'cardio', xp: 70 },

  { name: 'Cold Finish', desc: 'End your shower with 60s cold water', icon: 'snowflake', type: 'habit', xp: 50 },

  { name: 'No Added Sugar', desc: 'Zero added sugar all day', icon: 'ban', type: 'nutrition', xp: 60 },

  { name: 'Burpee Burnout', desc: '50 burpees for time', icon: 'flame', type: 'challenge', xp: 110 },

];

function renderQuests() {

  const today = todayStr();

  const dow = dayOfWeek();

  const workoutType = state.workoutSplit[dow] || 'Rest';

  const vacationMode = state.settings?.vacationMode === true;

  // Regenerate when day changes OR when the cached split doesn't match the current split

  // OR when vacation mode toggled (which swaps the entire template pool). The

  // questsVacationMode cache key is what catches that last case so we don't strand

  // the user on yesterday's quest set.

  const splitChanged = state.questsWorkoutType !== workoutType;

  const vacationChanged = state.questsVacationMode !== vacationMode;

  if (state.questsDate !== today || splitChanged || vacationChanged) {

    // Preserve any "completed" status on quests that survive the regen (by name match)

    const oldDone = (state.quests || []).filter(q => q.done && q.date === today).map(q => q.name);

    state.questsDate = today;

    state.questsWorkoutType = workoutType;

    state.questsVacationMode = vacationMode;

    const variant = state.settings && state.settings.vacationVariant;

    const isRestBlock = vacationMode && variant === 'rest';

    // Rest block = no workout templates at all. Travel = bodyweight subs. Off = normal.

    const pool = isRestBlock

      ? { [workoutType]: [] } // empty templates → only nutrition/habit/challenge remain

      : (vacationMode ? BODYWEIGHT_QUEST_TEMPLATES : QUEST_TEMPLATES);

    const templates = pool[workoutType] || (isRestBlock ? [] : pool['Rest']);

    // Continuity hint for the day's anchor compound — only computed when not in vacation mode

    // (BW substitutions don't have a continuity story since loads are mostly fixed).

    const continuityHint = vacationMode ? '' : buildContinuityHint(workoutType);

    // Standard quests — first strength entry gets the continuity hint baked into desc.

    // During an active deload week, every strength quest gets a 60%-load reminder.

    const inDeload = (typeof isInActiveDeload === 'function') && isInActiveDeload();

    const quests = templates.map((t, i) => {

      let enrichedDesc = t.desc;

      if (i === 0 && t.type === 'strength' && continuityHint) {

        enrichedDesc = `${enrichedDesc}\n📈 ${continuityHint}`;

      }

      if (t.type === 'strength' && inDeload) {

        enrichedDesc = `${enrichedDesc}\n🪶 Deload week — ~60% of usual load, RPE 5-6.`;

      }

      return { id: Date.now() + i, ...t, desc: enrichedDesc, done: oldDone.includes(t.name), date: today };

    });

    // Nutrition quest

    quests.push({ id: Date.now() + 99, name: 'Hit Macro Targets', desc: `${state.macros.calories} cal · ${state.macros.protein}g protein`, icon: 'salad', type: 'nutrition', xp: 60, done: oldDone.includes('Hit Macro Targets'), date: today });

    // Habit quest

    quests.push({ id: Date.now() + 100, name: 'Hydration Goal', desc: 'Drink 128 oz of water today', icon: 'water', type: 'habit', xp: 40, done: oldDone.includes('Hydration Goal'), date: today });

    // Daily challenge — keep the same one across regens within the same day to avoid surprise

    let challenge = (state.quests || []).find(q => q.type === 'challenge' && q.date === today)

      || DAILY_CHALLENGES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DAILY_CHALLENGES.length)];

    quests.push({ ...challenge, id: Date.now() + 101, done: oldDone.includes(challenge.name), date: today });

    state.quests = quests;

    save();

  }

  const doneCount = state.quests.filter(q => q.done).length;

  const totalXP = state.quests.reduce((a, q) => a + (q.done ? q.xp : 0), 0);

  document.getElementById('quest-date-label').textContent = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'long', month:'short', day:'numeric' }) + ' · ' + (state.workoutSplit[dayOfWeek()] || 'Rest') + (vacationMode ? ' · 🏝 Vacation' : '');

  { const v = document.getElementById('streak-display-value'); if (v) v.textContent = state.streak; }

  document.getElementById('quest-summary').textContent = `${doneCount} of ${state.quests.length} complete · ${totalXP} XP earned today`;

  renderStreakRow();

  const container = document.getElementById('quest-list-container');

  container.innerHTML = '';

  // Vacation mode banner — visible reminder that the quests have been swapped to BW

  if (vacationMode) {

    const banner = document.createElement('div');

    banner.style.cssText = 'background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.10), transparent);border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.5);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;';

    const variant = state.settings && state.settings.vacationVariant;

    const label = variant === 'rest' ? 'REST BLOCK' : 'TRAVEL MODE';

    const subtext = variant === 'rest'

      ? 'workout quests skipped — nutrition + habit + challenge still active.'

      : 'quests are bodyweight-only. Nutrition unchanged.';

    banner.innerHTML = `<div><strong style="color:var(--gold);">${label}</strong> — ${subtext}</div><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="setVacationMode('off')" style="font-size:10px;flex-shrink:0;">Turn off</button>`;

    container.appendChild(banner);

  }

  // Deload banner — either an active-deload reminder or a suggestion to start one.

  if (typeof renderDeloadBanner === 'function') {

    const deloadHtml = renderDeloadBanner();

    if (deloadHtml) {

      const wrap = document.createElement('div');

      wrap.innerHTML = deloadHtml;

      container.appendChild(wrap);

    }

  }

  state.quests.forEach(q => {

    const div = document.createElement('div');

    div.className = 'quest-item' + (q.done ? ' done' : '');

    div.innerHTML = `

      <div class="quest-icon ic-${q.type}">${iconSvg(q.icon, 20)}</div>

      <div class="quest-body">

        <div class="quest-name">${q.name}</div>

        <div class="quest-sub" style="white-space:pre-line;">${q.desc}</div>

        <div class="quest-bar"><div class="bar-wrap"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${q.done?100:0}%;background:${q.done?'var(--green)':'var(--accent)'}"></div></div></div>

      </div>

      <div class="quest-right">

        <div class="check-circle${q.done?' done':''}">${q.done ? iconSvg('check', 14) : ''}</div>

        <div class="xp-tag" style="${q.done?'color:var(--green2)':''}">+${q.xp}</div>

      </div>

    `;

    div.onclick = (e) => { if (!q.done) toggleQuest(q.id, e.currentTarget); };

    container.appendChild(div);

  });

}

// Force regen — used when the user changes their split mid-day or just wants a refresh.

// Wipes today's quests, re-derives from today's split, and re-renders.

function regenerateTodayQuests() {

  state.questsDate = null;

  state.questsWorkoutType = null;

  state.questsVacationMode = null;

  state.quests = [];

  save();

  renderQuests();

  showNotif('Quests regenerated for today\'s split');

}

// Parse a quest desc into individual workoutLog-shaped exercise entries.

// Handles patterns like "Bench Press 4×8, OHP 3×10, Plank 3×45s, Pull-ups 3×max, Squats 3×8-12".

// Each parseable chunk produces one entry with `setCount` empty sets (weight=0) so the user

// can backfill from Tracker. Returns [] when nothing parses.

function parseQuestExercises(desc) {

  if (!desc || typeof desc !== 'string') return [];

  const chunks = desc.split(/[,;]\s*|\s+\+\s+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  // Allow N×R or NxR. R can be: number, "max", a hyphen-range like "8-12", or a duration like "45s".

  // Permit a trailing "/leg" or "/side" annotation that some bodyweight templates use.

  const setRe = /^(.+?)\s+(\d+)\s*[×x]\s*(\d+(?:-\d+)?|max|\d+s)(?:\s*\/\s*\w+)?$/i;

  const entries = [];

  chunks.forEach(chunk => {

    const m = chunk.match(setRe);

    if (!m) return;

    const exercise = m[1].replace(/\s+$/, '').trim();

    if (!exercise) return;

    const setCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, parseInt(m[2], 10))); // sane bounds

    const repsRaw = m[3].toLowerCase();

    let reps = 0;

    if (repsRaw === 'max' || /^\d+s$/.test(repsRaw)) reps = 0;

    else if (repsRaw.includes('-')) reps = parseInt(repsRaw.split('-')[0], 10) || 0;

    else reps = parseInt(repsRaw, 10) || 0;

    const sets = Array(setCount).fill(0).map(() => ({ weight: 0, reps, rpe: null }));

    entries.push({ exercise, sets });

  });

  return entries;

}

// When an exercise-based quest is completed, mirror it into the training log so

// the user gets credit for the work without retyping it in Tracker. Idempotent

// per quest id (replaces any prior 'quest' source entries for the same questId

// on the same day, so re-completing a quest after a regen doesn't pile up).

function logQuestToTrainingLog(q) {

  if (!q) return 0;

  if (q.type !== 'strength' && q.type !== 'cardio') return 0;

  state.workoutLog = state.workoutLog || [];

  const date = todayStr();

  // Idempotent: clear any prior quest-sourced entries for this quest id today

  state.workoutLog = state.workoutLog.filter(e => !(e.source === 'quest' && e.questId === q.id && e.date === date));

  const parsed = parseQuestExercises(q.desc);

  if (parsed.length === 0) {

    // Fallback — single notes-only entry for narrative quests like

    // "Complete all push sets with progressive overload"

    state.workoutLog.push({

      id: Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),

      date, exercise: q.name, sets: [],

      notes: q.desc || '',

      source: 'quest', questId: q.id, questName: q.name,

    });

    return 1;

  }

  parsed.forEach((p, i) => {

    state.workoutLog.push({

      id: Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000) + i,

      date, exercise: p.exercise, sets: p.sets,

      notes: `From quest: ${q.name}`,

      source: 'quest', questId: q.id, questName: q.name,

    });

  });

  return parsed.length;

}

function toggleQuest(id, el) {

  const q = state.quests.find(q => q.id === id);

  if (!q || q.done) return;

  q.done = true;

  // Stats: total quests ever completed (for Relentless title)

  if (!state.stats) state.stats = { totalQuestsCompleted: 0, anyFullDayCompleted: false, macroStreak: 0, lastMacroHitDate: null };

  state.stats.totalQuestsCompleted = (state.stats.totalQuestsCompleted || 0) + 1;

  // Apply 2x buff if active

  const xpAward = consume2xBuffIfActive(q.xp);

  state.xp += xpAward;

  state.rank = getRank(state.xp);

  // Coins: 10-25 per quest based on XP

  const coinAward = Math.max(10, Math.round(q.xp / 5));

  state.coins = (state.coins || 0) + coinAward;

  showXP(xpAward, el);

  // Auto-log exercise quests into the training log (strength + cardio types)

  const logged = logQuestToTrainingLog(q);

  const logSuffix = logged > 0 ? ` · ${logged} exercise${logged===1?'':'s'} logged` : '';

  showNotif(`Quest complete! +${xpAward} XP · +${coinAward} coins${xpAward > q.xp ? ' (2× bonus!)' : ''}${logSuffix}`);

  // Level-up & rank-up bonuses

  checkLevelUp();

  // Check if all done

  if (state.quests.every(q => q.done)) {

    state.streak++;

    state.coins += 50; // bonus for clearing the board

    // Stats: first-ever full-day clear (for First Light title)

    state.stats.anyFullDayCompleted = true;

    setTimeout(() => showNotif('ALL QUESTS COMPLETE! +50 coins · Streak: ' + state.streak, 'var(--gold)'), 500);

  }

  // Evaluate earn-based titles (Relentless, First Light, Iron Will, etc.)

  if (typeof evaluateTitles === 'function') evaluateTitles();

  save();

  renderQuests();

  renderStats();

  renderProfile();

  // Refresh training log + progression so auto-logged quest entries show up immediately

  if (typeof renderTrainingLog === 'function') renderTrainingLog();

  if (typeof renderExerciseProgression === 'function') renderExerciseProgression();

}

function renderStreakRow() {

  const days = ['M','T','W','T','F','S','S'];

  const todayJs = new Date().getDay(); // 0=Sun..6=Sat

  // convert JS day to Mon-start index (0=Mon..6=Sun)

  const todayIdx = todayJs === 0 ? 6 : todayJs - 1;

  const row = document.getElementById('streak-row');

  const rail = document.getElementById('streak-rail-fill');

  if (!row) return;

  row.innerHTML = '';

  // Today completion ratio from quests

  const total = (state.quests || []).length || 0;

  const done = (state.quests || []).filter(q => q.done).length;

  const todayPct = total ? (done / total) : 0;

  // hit days: how many days before today we consider "hit"

  // Use state.streak but cap at todayIdx so we don't highlight today+future

  const hitCount = Math.min(state.streak || 0, todayIdx);

  days.forEach((d, i) => {

    const div = document.createElement('div');

    let cls = 'streak-day';

    let inner = '';

    if (i === todayIdx) {

      cls += ' today';

      // Ring progress

      const r = 16;

      const c = 2 * Math.PI * r;

      const dashLen = c * todayPct;

      inner = `

        <svg class="d-ring" width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 34 34" aria-hidden="true">

          <circle cx="17" cy="17" r="${r}" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" stroke-width="2"/>

          <circle cx="17" cy="17" r="${r}" fill="none" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="${dashLen.toFixed(2)} ${c.toFixed(2)}" transform="rotate(-90 17 17)"/>

        </svg>

        <span class="d-icon">${iconSvg('flame', 14)}</span>`;

    } else if (i < todayIdx) {

      // past day

      if (i >= todayIdx - hitCount) {

        cls += ' hit';

        inner = `<span class="d-icon">${iconSvg('check', 14)}</span>`;

      } else {

        cls += ' miss';

        inner = `<span class="d-icon">${iconSvg('close', 12)}</span>`;

      }

    } else {

      cls += ' future';

      inner = `<span class="d-icon" style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);"></span>`;

    }

    div.className = cls;

    div.innerHTML = `<div class="d-node">${inner}</div><span class="d-name">${d}</span>`;

    row.appendChild(div);

  });

  // Rail fill: from first day to midpoint of "today" node, scaled by (hitCount + todayPct) / 7

  if (rail) {

    const segs = 6; // 7 nodes => 6 gaps

    const pos = hitCount + todayPct; // 0..7

    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pos / segs)) * 100;

    rail.style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + '%';

  }

}

function checkPenalty() {

  const h = new Date().getHours();

  const anyDone = state.quests.some(q => !q.done);

  if (h >= 20 && anyDone && document.getElementById('penalty-bar')) {

    document.getElementById('penalty-bar').style.display = 'flex';

  }

}

// ===== STATS =====

function renderStats() {

  const r = state.rank;

  const color = RANK_COLORS[r];

  const rankBadge = document.getElementById('rank-badge');

  // "Rank E Hunter" → "Rank E" in plain mode (just drop the "Hunter" suffix; rank label preserved)

  const plainOn = !!(state.settings && state.settings.plainMode);

  rankBadge.innerHTML = `${iconSvg('trophy', 14)}${RANK_LABELS[r]}${plainOn ? '' : ' Hunter'}`;

  rankBadge.style.color = color;

  rankBadge.style.borderColor = color + '44';

  rankBadge.style.background = color + '1f';

  document.getElementById('hunter-name-display').textContent = state.profile?.name || t('default_user_name');

  const nxt = getNextRankXP(state.xp);

  const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((state.xp - nxt.current) / (nxt.needed - nxt.current) * 100));

  document.getElementById('xp-sub-label').textContent = `${state.xp} / ${nxt.needed} XP to Rank ${nxt.rank}`;

  document.getElementById('xp-bar').style.width = pct + '%';

  // Body stats

  const latest = state.logs[state.logs.length - 1] || {};

  const first = state.logs[0] || {};

  document.getElementById('s-weight').textContent = latest.weight ? latest.weight + '' : '—';

  document.getElementById('s-bf').textContent = latest.bf ? latest.bf + '%' : '—';

  document.getElementById('s-waist').textContent = latest.waist ? latest.waist + '"' : '—';

  const dw = latest.weight && first.weight ? (latest.weight - first.weight).toFixed(1) : null;

  const dbf = latest.bf && first.bf ? (latest.bf - first.bf).toFixed(1) : null;

  if (dw) { const neg = dw < 0; document.getElementById('d-weight').textContent = (neg?'↓':'+') + Math.abs(dw) + ' lbs'; document.getElementById('d-weight').style.color = neg ? 'var(--green2)' : 'var(--red2)'; }

  if (dbf) { const neg = dbf < 0; document.getElementById('d-bf').textContent = (neg?'↓':'+') + Math.abs(dbf) + '%'; document.getElementById('d-bf').style.color = neg ? 'var(--green2)' : 'var(--red2)'; }

  // Attribute bars retired — UI was tied to the avatar concept. The #attr-bars

  // mount no longer exists, so we just no-op here. State is preserved for back-compat.

  const attrWrap = document.getElementById('attr-bars');

  if (attrWrap) {

    const a = state.attributes || { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

    const xpBonus = Math.floor(state.xp / 300);

    const streakBonus = Math.floor(state.streak / 3);

    const attrs = [

      { key: 'STR', label: 'STR', name: 'Strength', val: Math.min(99, (a.STR||10) + xpBonus), color: 'var(--red2)' },

      { key: 'AGI', label: 'AGI', name: 'Agility', val: Math.min(99, (a.AGI||10) + xpBonus), color: 'var(--green2)' },

      { key: 'VIT', label: 'VIT', name: 'Vitality', val: Math.min(99, (a.VIT||10) + Math.floor(state.xp/200)), color: 'var(--gold)' },

      { key: 'INT', label: 'INT', name: 'Intelligence', val: Math.min(99, (a.INT||10) + streakBonus), color: 'var(--accent2)' },

      { key: 'PER', label: 'PER', name: 'Perception', val: Math.min(99, (a.PER||10) + streakBonus), color: 'var(--purple2)' },

    ];

    attrWrap.innerHTML = '';

    const pending = state.attributePointsPending || 0;

    if (pending > 0) {

      attrWrap.innerHTML = `<div style="background:rgba(240,165,0,0.1);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;"><span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">${iconSvg('zap',14)}<strong>${pending}</strong> attribute point${pending>1?'s':''} ready to allocate</span><button class="btn btn-sm btn-gold" onclick="switchTab('profile')">Allocate</button></div>`;

    }

    attrs.forEach(at => {

      attrWrap.innerHTML += `<div class="attr-row"><div class="attr-name" style="color:${at.color};">${at.label} <span style="color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;">${at.name}</span></div><div class="bar-wrap" style="flex:1;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${at.val}%;background:${at.color};"></div></div><div class="attr-val">${at.val}</div></div>`;

    });

  }

  // History table

  const hist = document.getElementById('history-table');

  const recent = state.logs.slice(-7).reverse();

  if (recent.length === 0) { hist.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:10px;">No entries yet. Log today\'s stats!</div>'; return; }

  hist.innerHTML = `<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;">

    <tr style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">

      <th style="padding:4px;text-align:left;">DATE</th><th style="padding:4px;">WEIGHT</th><th style="padding:4px;">BF%</th><th style="padding:4px;">SLEEP</th>

    </tr>

    ${recent.map(l => `<tr style="border-top:1px solid var(--border);">

      <td style="padding:5px 4px;color:var(--text2);">${l.date||'—'}</td>

      <td style="padding:5px 4px;text-align:center;color:var(--text);">${l.weight||'—'}</td>

      <td style="padding:5px 4px;text-align:center;color:var(--text);">${l.bf||'—'}</td>

      <td style="padding:5px 4px;text-align:center;color:var(--text2);">${l.sleep||'—'}h</td>

    </tr>`).join('')}

  </table>`;

  // Weekly volume rollup is rendered alongside renderStats so the card refreshes

  // whenever stats refreshes (e.g., after logging a new session).

  if (typeof renderWeeklyVolume === 'function') renderWeeklyVolume();

  // Macro suggestion banner — surface adaptive recommendations near the body stats.

  const sugSlot = document.getElementById('macro-suggestion-slot');

  if (sugSlot && typeof renderMacroSuggestionBanner === 'function') {

    sugSlot.innerHTML = renderMacroSuggestionBanner();

  }

  // Body measurements + progress photos — both functions handle empty-state internally.

  if (typeof renderMeasurements === 'function') renderMeasurements();

  if (typeof renderProgressPhotos === 'function') renderProgressPhotos();

}

// ===== PROGRESS PHOTO HANDLER =====

// Reads the file, resizes to max 600px (longest side) at JPEG quality 0.75, returns

// data URL. Module-scoped staging so saveLog can read it without an async chain.

let _pendingPhotoDataUrl = null;

function onPhotoSelected(input) {

  const file = input.files && input.files[0];

  const previewEl = document.getElementById('log-photo-preview');

  if (!file) { _pendingPhotoDataUrl = null; if (previewEl) previewEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }

  const reader = new FileReader();

  reader.onload = (e) => {

    const img = new Image();

    img.onload = () => {

      const maxDim = 600;

      const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(img.width, img.height));

      const w = Math.round(img.width * scale);

      const h = Math.round(img.height * scale);

      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

      canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);

      _pendingPhotoDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.75);

      if (previewEl) {

        previewEl.style.display = 'block';

        previewEl.innerHTML = `<img src="${_pendingPhotoDataUrl}" style="max-width:140px;max-height:140px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);">`;

      }

    };

    img.src = e.target.result;

  };

  reader.readAsDataURL(file);

}

function saveLog() {

  const w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-weight').value);

  let bf = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-bf').value);

  const waist = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-waist').value);

  const sleep = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-sleep').value);

  const notes = document.getElementById('log-notes').value;

  // Optional measurements

  const chest = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-chest')?.value);

  const arms = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-arms')?.value);

  const thighs = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-thighs')?.value);

  const hips = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-hips')?.value);

  const neck = parseFloat(document.getElementById('log-neck')?.value);

  // Build a measurements sub-object only when at least one value present (keeps logs slim)

  const measurements = {};

  if (chest)  measurements.chest = chest;

  if (arms)   measurements.arms = arms;

  if (thighs) measurements.thighs = thighs;

  if (hips)   measurements.hips = hips;

  if (neck)   measurements.neck = neck;

  // Auto-estimate BF% when the user provided waist but skipped BF%. Now we can use Navy

  // when neck is also provided (more accurate); otherwise fall back to RFM (waist-only).

  let bfAutoEstimated = false;

  if (!bf && waist && state.profile?.heightIn) {

    const est = autoEstimateBF({ heightIn: state.profile.heightIn, waistIn: waist, neckIn: neck, hipIn: hips, sex: state.profile.sex });

    if (est > 0) { bf = est; bfAutoEstimated = true; }

  }

  const entry = {

    date: todayStr(),

    weight: w||null, bf: bf||null, waist: waist||null, sleep: sleep||null, notes,

    bfAutoEstimated,

    measurements: Object.keys(measurements).length ? measurements : undefined,

    photo: _pendingPhotoDataUrl || undefined,

  };

  // Remove existing today entry

  state.logs = state.logs.filter(l => l.date !== todayStr());

  state.logs.push(entry);

  state.xp += 25;

  save();

  closeModal('modal-log');

  // Clear staged photo + reset measurement inputs so next open is fresh

  _pendingPhotoDataUrl = null;

  ['log-chest','log-arms','log-thighs','log-hips','log-neck'].forEach(id => {

    const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = '';

  });

  const photoInput = document.getElementById('log-photo');

  if (photoInput) photoInput.value = '';

  const photoPreview = document.getElementById('log-photo-preview');

  if (photoPreview) { photoPreview.style.display = 'none'; photoPreview.innerHTML = ''; }

  if (bfAutoEstimated) {

    showNotif(`Stats logged! BF% auto-estimated at ${bf}% from waist · +25 XP`, 'var(--accent2)');

  } else {

    showNotif('Stats logged! +25 XP');

  }

  renderStats();

  // T6.2: Smart adaptive macros — surface a suggestion banner instead of silent auto-adjust.

  // Banner is rendered on Stats by renderStats() picking up the suggestion from evaluateMacroAdjustment.

}

// ===== BODY MEASUREMENTS + PROGRESS PHOTOS =====

// Surfaces optional log fields (chest/arms/thighs/hips/neck) on Stats. We compute

// "latest minus first" deltas so users see real progress over time, not just current

// snapshots. Empty-state when no logs have measurements yet — keeps Stats uncluttered

// for users who only log weight/BF.

const MEASUREMENT_KEYS = [

  { key: 'chest',  label: 'Chest',  unit: 'in' },

  { key: 'arms',   label: 'Arms',   unit: 'in' },

  { key: 'thighs', label: 'Thighs', unit: 'in' },

  { key: 'hips',   label: 'Hips',   unit: 'in' },

  { key: 'neck',   label: 'Neck',   unit: 'in' },

];

function renderMeasurements() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('measurements-slot');

  if (!slot) return;

  const logs = (state.logs || []).filter(l => l.measurements && Object.keys(l.measurements).length);

  if (!logs.length) { slot.innerHTML = ''; return; }

  // For each measurement, find the latest non-null value and the earliest non-null value

  const summary = MEASUREMENT_KEYS.map(({ key, label, unit }) => {

    const withVal = logs.filter(l => l.measurements && l.measurements[key] != null);

    if (!withVal.length) return null;

    const latest = withVal[withVal.length - 1].measurements[key];

    const first = withVal[0].measurements[key];

    const delta = +(latest - first).toFixed(1);

    const deltaColor = delta > 0 ? 'var(--green2)' : delta < 0 ? 'var(--accent2)' : 'var(--text3)';

    const deltaStr = withVal.length > 1

      ? `<span style="color:${deltaColor};font-size:10px;">${delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${delta} ${unit}</span>`

      : '<span style="color:var(--text3);font-size:10px;">first entry</span>';

    return `

      <div style="background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:8px;text-align:center;">

        <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;color:var(--text);">${latest}<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;"> ${unit}</span></div>

        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;">${label}</div>

        <div style="margin-top:3px;">${deltaStr}</div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).filter(Boolean).join('');

  if (!summary) { slot.innerHTML = ''; return; }

  slot.innerHTML = `

    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:4px;">BODY MEASUREMENTS</div>

    <div class="card" style="padding:8px;">

      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(80px, 1fr));gap:6px;">${summary}</div>

    </div>

  `;

}

function renderProgressPhotos() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('photos-slot');

  if (!slot) return;

  const photos = (state.logs || []).filter(l => l.photo).slice(-12).reverse(); // most recent 12, newest first

  if (!photos.length) { slot.innerHTML = ''; return; }

  slot.innerHTML = `

    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:4px;">PROGRESS PHOTOS</div>

    <div class="card" style="padding:8px;">

      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(80px, 1fr));gap:6px;">

        ${photos.map(l => `

          <div style="position:relative;cursor:pointer;" onclick="openPhotoModal('${l.date}')">

            <img src="${l.photo}" alt="Progress ${l.date}" style="width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);">

            <div style="position:absolute;bottom:2px;left:2px;right:2px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);color:#fff;font-size:9px;text-align:center;padding:1px 2px;border-radius:3px;">${l.date.slice(5)}</div>

          </div>

        `).join('')}

      </div>

    </div>

  `;

}

// Click a thumbnail → full-screen overlay. Reuses a single dynamically-created element.

function openPhotoModal(date) {

  const log = (state.logs || []).find(l => l.date === date && l.photo);

  if (!log) return;

  let overlay = document.getElementById('photo-fullscreen');

  if (!overlay) {

    overlay = document.createElement('div');

    overlay.id = 'photo-fullscreen';

    overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.92);z-index:300;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;padding:20px;';

    overlay.onclick = () => { overlay.style.display = 'none'; };

    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

  }

  overlay.innerHTML = `

    <div style="text-align:center;">

      <img src="${log.photo}" style="max-width:90vw;max-height:80vh;border-radius:8px;">

      <div style="color:#fff;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;">${log.date}${log.weight ? ` · ${log.weight} lbs` : ''}${log.bf ? ` · ${log.bf}% BF` : ''}</div>

      <div style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);font-size:10px;margin-top:4px;">Tap anywhere to close</div>

    </div>

  `;

  overlay.style.display = 'flex';

}

// ===== DELOAD TRACKING & SUGGESTION =====

// A deload is a planned light week (~60% of usual loads, RPE 5-6) every 4-8 weeks

// to let connective tissue catch up to muscle and prevent injury. We auto-suggest

// when the user has been training consistently without one.

//

// Triggers: at least 4 weeks since last deload AND at least 12 logged workout sessions

// in that span (so we don't push a deload on someone barely training).

// Active deload window: 7 days from acceptedAt. Quest descriptions get a deload note.

const DELOAD_MIN_WEEKS = 4;

const DELOAD_MIN_SESSIONS = 12;

const DELOAD_DURATION_DAYS = 7;

function isInActiveDeload() {

  const start = state.settings && state.settings.deloadStartedAt;

  if (!start) return false;

  const days = (Date.now() - new Date(start).getTime()) / 86400000;

  return days >= 0 && days < DELOAD_DURATION_DAYS;

}

function evaluateDeloadSuggestion() {

  if (!state.profile) return null;

  if (isInActiveDeload()) return null;

  // Anchor date: lastDeloadAt OR profile.createdAt (first-time users get suggestion after 4 weeks of training)

  const anchorIso = (state.settings && state.settings.lastDeloadAt) || state.profile.createdAt;

  if (!anchorIso) return null;

  const anchorDate = new Date(anchorIso + (anchorIso.length === 10 ? 'T00:00:00' : ''));

  const weeksSince = (Date.now() - anchorDate.getTime()) / (7 * 86400000);

  if (weeksSince < DELOAD_MIN_WEEKS) return null;

  // Throttle — don't re-suggest after a skip for at least 14 days

  if (state.settings && state.settings.lastDeloadSuggestionAt) {

    const days = (Date.now() - new Date(state.settings.lastDeloadSuggestionAt).getTime()) / 86400000;

    if (days < 14) return null;

  }

  // Count workout sessions in the period (not days — actual lifting volume)

  const sessions = (state.workoutLog || []).filter(e => {

    if (!e.date) return false;

    const d = new Date(e.date + 'T00:00:00');

    return d >= anchorDate && (e.sets || []).some(s => (parseFloat(s.weight) || 0) > 0);

  }).length;

  if (sessions < DELOAD_MIN_SESSIONS) return null;

  return {

    weeksSince: Math.round(weeksSince),

    sessions,

    reason: `You've trained ${sessions} sessions over ${Math.round(weeksSince)} weeks without a deload. A 7-day light week keeps connective tissue healthy and almost always leads to PRs the week after.`,

  };

}

function startDeloadWeek() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.deloadStartedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  state.settings.lastDeloadSuggestionAt = new Date().toISOString();

  save();

  showNotif('Deload week started — 60% load, RPE 5-6 across the board', 'var(--gold)');

  try { renderQuests(); } catch(e) {}

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function skipDeloadSuggestion() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.lastDeloadSuggestionAt = new Date().toISOString();

  save();

  showNotif('Skipped — we\'ll re-check in 2 weeks', 'var(--text2)');

  try { renderQuests(); } catch(e) {}

}

function endDeloadWeekManually() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.lastDeloadAt = new Date().toISOString();

  state.settings.deloadStartedAt = null;

  save();

  showNotif('Deload complete — back to normal loads. Welcome back!', 'var(--green)');

  try { renderQuests(); } catch(e) {}

}

function renderDeloadBanner() {

  // Two banner states: active deload week reminder, or "consider a deload" suggestion

  if (isInActiveDeload()) {

    const start = new Date(state.settings.deloadStartedAt);

    const dayInWeek = Math.floor((Date.now() - start.getTime()) / 86400000) + 1;

    return `

      <div style="background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(244,182,63,0.10), transparent);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;">

        <div><strong style="color:var(--gold);">DELOAD WEEK · DAY ${dayInWeek}/${DELOAD_DURATION_DAYS}</strong> — drop loads to ~60%, target RPE 5-6. Form-focused.</div>

        <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="endDeloadWeekManually()" style="font-size:10px;flex-shrink:0;">End early</button>

      </div>

    `;

  }

  const sug = evaluateDeloadSuggestion();

  if (!sug) return '';

  return `

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:8px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(244,182,63,0.10), rgba(244,182,63,0.02));">

      <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;">Deload Suggestion · ${sug.weeksSince} weeks since last</div>

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:10px;">${sug.reason}</div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">

        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-gold" style="flex:1;" onclick="startDeloadWeek()">Start Deload Week</button>

        <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="skipDeloadSuggestion()">Not now</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  `;

}

// ===== SMART ADAPTIVE MACROS =====

// Replaces the legacy auto-adjust with an evaluation that returns a structured

// suggestion. Caller (Stats banner) decides whether to apply or dismiss. This means

// users see *why* an adjustment is suggested before their macros change.

//

// Returns { shouldAdjust: bool, kcalDelta: number, weeklyChange: number, reason: string,

//           label: string, severity: 'tip'|'warn' } or null if no suggestion.

//

// Triggers:

//   - Need at least 7 days of weight logs (otherwise signal is too noisy)

//   - state.settings.adaptiveMacros must be on

//   - Last suggestion was at least 14 days ago (throttle to avoid macro thrashing)

const ADAPTIVE_THROTTLE_DAYS = 14;

function evaluateMacroAdjustment() {

  if (!state.settings || state.settings.adaptiveMacros !== true) return null;

  if (!state.profile || !state.profile.goalType) return null;

  const logs = (state.logs || []).filter(l => l.weight);

  if (logs.length < 7) return null;

  // Throttle — don't suggest more than once per 14 days

  if (state.settings.lastMacroSuggestionAt) {

    const sinceMs = Date.now() - new Date(state.settings.lastMacroSuggestionAt).getTime();

    if (sinceMs < ADAPTIVE_THROTTLE_DAYS * 86400000) return null;

  }

  // Use up to 14 most-recent weight entries for signal

  const recent = logs.slice(-14);

  const first = recent[0];

  const last = recent[recent.length - 1];

  const days = Math.max(1, (new Date(last.date) - new Date(first.date)) / 86400000);

  if (days < 6) return null; // need a real spread

  const totalChange = last.weight - first.weight;          // positive = gained weight

  const weeklyChange = +(totalChange / days * 7).toFixed(2);

  const goal = state.profile.goalType;

  let kcalDelta = 0;

  let reason = '';

  let severity = 'tip';

  // Expected weekly change ranges per goal type:

  //   cut:     -0.5 to -1.5 lb/wk (lose at sustainable pace, preserving muscle)

  //   bulk:    +0.25 to +0.6 lb/wk (gain mostly muscle, minimal fat)

  //   recomp:  -0.25 to +0.25 lb/wk (basically flat — body composition shifts under the hood)

  //   maintain:-0.25 to +0.25 lb/wk (true maintenance)

  if (goal === 'cut') {

    if (weeklyChange > -0.25) {

      kcalDelta = -100; reason = `Cut goal but losing only ${Math.abs(weeklyChange).toFixed(1)} lb/wk over ${Math.round(days)} days. Drop calories to restart fat loss.`;

      severity = 'tip';

    } else if (weeklyChange < -1.75) {

      kcalDelta = +100; reason = `Cut is moving fast at ${Math.abs(weeklyChange).toFixed(1)} lb/wk — risk of muscle loss. Bump calories slightly to slow it down.`;

      severity = 'warn';

    }

  } else if (goal === 'bulk') {

    if (weeklyChange < 0.1) {

      kcalDelta = +100; reason = `Bulk goal but gaining only ${weeklyChange.toFixed(1)} lb/wk. Add calories to drive growth.`;

      severity = 'tip';

    } else if (weeklyChange > 0.75) {

      kcalDelta = -100; reason = `Bulk is fast at ${weeklyChange.toFixed(1)} lb/wk — most of that is fat. Pull calories back to lean it out.`;

      severity = 'warn';

    }

  } else if (goal === 'recomp') {

    if (weeklyChange > 0.4) {

      kcalDelta = -50; reason = `Recomp drifting up (${weeklyChange.toFixed(1)} lb/wk). Trim calories slightly to stay flat.`;

      severity = 'tip';

    } else if (weeklyChange < -0.4) {

      kcalDelta = +50; reason = `Recomp drifting down (${Math.abs(weeklyChange).toFixed(1)} lb/wk loss). Add a small bump to maintain weight.`;

      severity = 'tip';

    }

  } else if (goal === 'maintain') {

    if (Math.abs(weeklyChange) > 0.5) {

      kcalDelta = weeklyChange > 0 ? -75 : +75;

      reason = `Maintain goal but weight is ${weeklyChange > 0 ? 'creeping up' : 'drifting down'} ${Math.abs(weeklyChange).toFixed(1)} lb/wk. ${kcalDelta > 0 ? 'Add' : 'Trim'} calories to stabilize.`;

      severity = 'tip';

    }

  }

  if (kcalDelta === 0) return null;

  const newCals = Math.max(1200, state.macros.calories + kcalDelta);

  return {

    shouldAdjust: true,

    kcalDelta,

    newCalories: newCals,

    weeklyChange,

    daysObserved: Math.round(days),

    reason,

    severity,

    label: kcalDelta > 0 ? `+${kcalDelta} kcal/day` : `${kcalDelta} kcal/day`,

  };

}

// Apply an adjustment from the banner. Recomputes protein/carbs/fat to match the new

// calorie target using the same proteinPerLb logic as computeMacros.

function applyMacroSuggestion() {

  const sug = evaluateMacroAdjustment();

  if (!sug) return;

  const lbm = state.profile.weight * (1 - (state.profile.bf || 20) / 100);

  state.macros.calories = sug.newCalories;

  // Mirror computeMacros's protein-per-lb logic

  const goal = state.profile.goalType;

  const proteinPerLb = goal === 'cut' ? 1.1 : goal === 'recomp' ? 1.2 : 1.0;

  state.macros.protein = Math.round(lbm * proteinPerLb);

  state.macros.fat = Math.max(Math.round(state.profile.weight * 0.3), Math.round(state.macros.calories * 0.25 / 9));

  state.macros.carbs = Math.max(50, Math.round((state.macros.calories - state.macros.protein * 4 - state.macros.fat * 9) / 4));

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.lastMacroSuggestionAt = new Date().toISOString();

  state.settings.lastMacroSuggestionDelta = sug.kcalDelta;

  save();

  showNotif(`Macros updated: ${sug.label} → ${sug.newCalories} kcal/day`, 'var(--gold)');

  try { renderStats(); } catch(e) {}

  try { renderProfile(); } catch(e) {}

}

function dismissMacroSuggestion() {

  state.settings = state.settings || {};

  state.settings.lastMacroSuggestionAt = new Date().toISOString();

  save();

  showNotif('Suggestion dismissed. We\'ll re-check in 2 weeks.', 'var(--text2)');

  try { renderStats(); } catch(e) {}

}

// Render the suggestion banner on Stats. Returns the HTML string (caller injects).

// Returns empty string when no suggestion is available.

function renderMacroSuggestionBanner() {

  const sug = evaluateMacroAdjustment();

  if (!sug) return '';

  const color = sug.severity === 'warn' ? 'var(--red2)' : 'var(--gold)';

  return `

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:8px;padding:12px;border:1px solid ${color};background:linear-gradient(135deg, ${color}1a, ${color}0a);">

      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">

        <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:${color};text-transform:uppercase;">Macro Suggestion</span>

        <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">${sug.daysObserved}-day trend</span>

      </div>

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px;">${sug.reason}</div>

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:10px;">

        Current: <strong>${state.macros.calories}</strong> kcal/day → Suggested: <strong style="color:${color};">${sug.newCalories}</strong> kcal/day

        <span style="color:var(--text3);">(${sug.label})</span>

      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">

        <button class="btn btn-sm" style="flex:1;color:${color};border-color:${color};" onclick="applyMacroSuggestion()">Apply</button>

        <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="dismissMacroSuggestion()">Not now</button>

      </div>

    </div>

  `;

}

// ===== GOALS =====

function renderGoals() {

  const list = document.getElementById('goals-list');

  if (!list) return;

  // Backfill milestones for any legacy goals that have none AND regenerate any

  // auto milestones from an older schema version (so parser fixes roll forward).

  let backfilled = false;

  state.goals.forEach(g => {

    const ms = g.milestones || [];

    const hasAuto = ms.some(m => m.auto);

    const stale = hasAuto && ms.some(m => m.auto && (m.schemaVersion || 0) < MILESTONE_SCHEMA_VERSION);

    if (!ms.length) {

      g.milestones = generateMilestonesForGoal(g);

      backfilled = true;

    } else if (stale) {

      refreshAutoMilestones(g);

      backfilled = true;

    }

  });

  if (backfilled) save();

  if (state.goals.length === 0) {

    list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text3);font-size:14px;">No goals yet.<br>Add your first objective above.</div>';

    return;

  }

  const cats = [...new Set(state.goals.map(g => g.cat))];

  const catLabels = { endurance: 'ENDURANCE', strength: 'STRENGTH', body: 'BODY COMPOSITION', habit: 'HABIT / LIFESTYLE', custom: 'CUSTOM' };

  list.innerHTML = '';

  cats.forEach(cat => {

    const catGoals = state.goals.filter(g => g.cat === cat);

    const label = document.createElement('div');

    label.className = 'section-label';

    label.textContent = catLabels[cat] || cat.toUpperCase();

    list.appendChild(label);

    catGoals.forEach(goal => {

      const days = goal.date ? Math.max(0, Math.round((new Date(goal.date) - new Date()) / 86400000)) : null;

      const pct = Math.min(100, goal.progress || 0);

      const colors = { endurance: 'var(--purple)', strength: 'var(--red2)', body: 'var(--accent)', habit: 'var(--green)', custom: 'var(--gold)' };

      const color = colors[goal.cat] || 'var(--accent)';

      const milestones = goal.milestones || [];

      const div = document.createElement('div');

      div.className = 'goal-card';

      div.style.marginBottom = '8px';

      div.innerHTML = `

        <div class="goal-header">

          <div>

            <div class="goal-name">${goal.name}</div>

            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${goal.date ? `Target: ${goal.date}${days !== null ? ` · ${days} days left` : ''}` : 'No deadline'}</div>

          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;">

            <div class="goal-pct" style="color:${color};">${pct}%</div>

            <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

              <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();editGoalProgress(${JSON.stringify(goal.id)})" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text3);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;" title="Quick progress update">Progress</button>

              <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();openAddGoalModal(${JSON.stringify(goal.id)})" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--accent2);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;" title="Edit goal details">Edit</button>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div class="bar-wrap" style="height:6px;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${color};"></div></div>

        <div class="goal-meta">

          <span>Current: ${goal.current || '—'}</span>

          <span>Target: ${goal.target || '—'}</span>

        </div>

        ${goal.feasibility && goal.feasibility.level !== 'ok' ? `

        <div class="goal-warning" style="${goal.feasibility.level==='danger'?'background:rgba(239,68,68,0.08);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,0.35);color:var(--red2);':''}">

          <span>${iconSvg(goal.feasibility.level==='danger'?'ban':'alert', 16)}</span>

          <span><strong>${goal.feasibility.level==='danger'?'HIGH RISK PACE':'AGGRESSIVE PACE'}:</strong> ${goal.feasibility.message}</span>

        </div>` : ''}

        ${milestones.length > 0 ? `

        <div class="milestone-toggle" onclick="toggleMilestones(this)">

          <span class="milestone-caret">${iconSvg('chevron', 14)}</span>${milestones.filter(m=>m.done).length}/${milestones.length} milestones${milestones.some(m=>m.auto) ? ' · <span style="color:var(--accent2);">AI-generated</span>' : ''}

          <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);" onclick="event.stopPropagation();regenerateGoalMilestones(${JSON.stringify(goal.id)});" title="Rebuild auto milestones from current/target">↻ regen</span>

        </div>

        <div class="milestone-list">

          ${milestones.map((m, mi) => `

            <div class="milestone-item${m.done?' done':''}${m.recovery?' recovery':''}" onclick="toggleMilestone(${JSON.stringify(goal.id)}, ${mi})">

              <div class="milestone-dot${m.done?' done':''}"></div>

              ${m.recovery?`<span style="color:var(--amber);margin-right:4px;">${iconSvg('zap', 14)}</span>`:''}${m.text}

            </div>

          `).join('')}

        </div>` : ''}

      `;

      list.appendChild(div);

    });

  });

}

function toggleMilestones(el) {

  const list = el.nextElementSibling;

  const wasOpen = list.classList.contains('open');

  list.classList.toggle('open');

  const caret = el.querySelector('.milestone-caret');

  if (caret) caret.style.transform = wasOpen ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(180deg)';

}

function toggleMilestone(goalId, idx) {

  const g = state.goals.find(g => g.id == goalId);

  if (!g) return;

  g.milestones[idx].done = !g.milestones[idx].done;

  if (g.milestones[idx].done) { state.xp += 50; showNotif('Milestone complete! +50 XP'); }

  const donePct = Math.round(g.milestones.filter(m=>m.done).length / g.milestones.length * 100);

  g.progress = Math.max(g.progress || 0, donePct);

  save(); renderGoals(); renderStats();

}

// Rebuilds auto milestones for a single goal. Preserves completed history and

// user-added (non-auto) entries. Exposed to the ↻ regen affordance per-card.

function regenerateGoalMilestones(goalId) {

  const g = state.goals.find(g => g.id == goalId);

  if (!g) return;

  refreshAutoMilestones(g);

  save();

  renderGoals();

  showNotif('Milestones regenerated');

}

function editGoalProgress(goalId) {

  const g = state.goals.find(g => g.id == goalId);

  if (!g) return;

  const pct = prompt(`Update progress % for "${g.name}":`, g.progress || 0);

  if (pct === null) return;

  const curr = prompt('Update current value (e.g. 8:30/mi):', g.current || '');

  g.progress = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseInt(pct) || 0));

  if (curr !== null) g.current = curr;

  save(); renderGoals();

}

function saveNewGoal() {

  const name = document.getElementById('new-goal-name').value.trim();

  if (!name) { showNotif('Enter a goal name'); return; }

  const editId = document.getElementById('goal-modal-edit-id').value;

  const cat = document.getElementById('new-goal-cat').value;

  const current = document.getElementById('new-goal-current').value;

  const target = document.getElementById('new-goal-target').value;

  const date = document.getElementById('new-goal-date').value;

  const pctRaw = document.getElementById('new-goal-pct').value;

  const progress = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseInt(pctRaw) || 0));

  const manualTextArr = (document.getElementById('new-goal-milestones').value || '').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  const manual = manualTextArr.map(t => ({ text: t, done: false }));

  if (editId) {

    // ===== EDIT PATH =====

    const g = state.goals.find(x => x.id == editId);

    if (!g) { showNotif('Goal not found'); return; }

    const prev = { name: g.name, cat: g.cat, current: g.current, target: g.target, date: g.date };

    g.name = name;

    g.cat = cat;

    g.current = current;

    g.target = target;

    g.date = date;

    g.progress = progress;

    // Preserve auto milestones (done state) + merge new manual entries with any kept-done manual ones

    const autoKept = (g.milestones || []).filter(m => m.auto);

    const manualKept = (g.milestones || []).filter(m => !m.auto && m.done);

    const manualKeptTexts = new Set(manualKept.map(m => m.text));

    const newManual = manual.filter(m => !manualKeptTexts.has(m.text));

    g.milestones = [...manualKept, ...newManual, ...autoKept];

    // Refresh auto milestones if anything affecting them changed

    const targetsChanged = prev.current !== current || prev.target !== target || prev.date !== date || prev.cat !== cat || prev.name !== name;

    if (targetsChanged) refreshAutoMilestones(g);

    g.feasibility = checkGoalFeasibility(g);

    save(); closeModal('modal-add-goal'); renderGoals();

    // Clamp warning: if new target is below current and we can parse them, flag it

    const curP = parseGoalValue(current);

    const tgtP = parseGoalValue(target);

    if (curP && tgtP && curP.format === tgtP.format && curP.value > tgtP.value && tgtP.format !== 'pace') {

      showNotif('Saved — note: current exceeds target', 'var(--amber)');

    } else if (g.feasibility?.level === 'danger') {

      showNotif('Saved — pace flagged as risky', 'var(--red2)');

    } else if (g.feasibility?.level === 'warn') {

      showNotif('Saved — aggressive pace', 'var(--amber)');

    } else {

      showNotif('Goal updated');

    }

    return;

  }

  // ===== CREATE PATH =====

  const goal = {

    id: Date.now(), name, cat, current, target, date, progress,

    milestones: manual.length ? manual : [],

    createdAt: todayStr()

  };

  // Auto-generate adaptive milestones if none provided

  if (!goal.milestones.length) goal.milestones = generateMilestonesForGoal(goal);

  goal.feasibility = checkGoalFeasibility(goal);

  state.goals.push(goal);

  save(); closeModal('modal-add-goal'); renderGoals();

  if (goal.feasibility?.level === 'danger') {

    showNotif('Goal added — but pace flagged as risky', 'var(--red2)');

  } else if (goal.feasibility?.level === 'warn') {

    showNotif('Goal added — aggressive pace, check warning', 'var(--amber)');

  } else {

    showNotif('Goal added!');

  }

}

// ===== WORKOUT TRACKER SHEET (printable-style) =====

// Lives on the Goals screen as a second tab. Mirrors the Meal Prep tab pattern.

// One sheet per day, keyed by 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Auto-prefills the 8 exercise rows from

// today's split via EXERCISE_POOLS; remaining rows are blank for ad-hoc lifts.

// "Save Session to Log" pushes filled rows into state.workoutLog with source:'tracker'

// so they show up in Exercise Progression alongside manual log entries.

const TRACKER_ROW_COUNT = 8;

const TRACKER_SET_COUNT = 5;

function switchGoalsTab(tab) {

  ['list','tracker'].forEach(t => {

    const pane = document.getElementById('goals-pane-' + t);

    const btn = document.getElementById('goals-tab-' + t);

    if (pane) pane.style.display = (t === tab) ? 'flex' : 'none';

    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);

  });

  if (tab === 'list') renderGoals();

  if (tab === 'tracker') renderTrackerSheet();

}

// Build a fresh sheet for `date`. The sheet has one muscle group at the top; every

// row's exercise dropdown filters by that single selection. Auto-pick the primary group

// from today's split (e.g. Lower Body → "Legs"); rows start blank so user types/picks each.

function buildEmptyTrackerSheet(date) {

  const dow = (function(d){ return ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][new Date(d + 'T12:00:00').getDay()]; })(date);

  const split = (state.workoutSplit && state.workoutSplit[dow]) || '';

  const rows = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < TRACKER_ROW_COUNT; i++) {

    rows.push({

      exercise: '',

      sets: Array.from({ length: TRACKER_SET_COUNT }, () => ({ weight: '', reps: '' }))

    });

  }

  return {

    date,

    muscleGroup: primaryGroupForSplit(split),  // one group for the whole sheet

    totalTime: '',

    rows,

    cardio: { exercise: '', duration: '', speed: '', distance: '' }

  };

}

function getOrCreateTrackerSheet(date) {

  state.trackerSheets = state.trackerSheets || {};

  if (!state.trackerSheets[date]) {

    state.trackerSheets[date] = buildEmptyTrackerSheet(date);

  }

  const sheet = state.trackerSheets[date];

  // Backfill: older sheets may have a multi-group string like "Chest, Shoulders, Triceps"

  // or per-row groups. Reduce to a single sheet-level value (one of MUSCLE_GROUP_OPTIONS).

  if (sheet.muscleGroup && !MUSCLE_GROUP_OPTIONS.includes(sheet.muscleGroup)) {

    const dow = (function(d){ return ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][new Date(d + 'T12:00:00').getDay()]; })(date);

    const split = (state.workoutSplit && state.workoutSplit[dow]) || '';

    sheet.muscleGroup = primaryGroupForSplit(split);

  }

  // Strip any leftover per-row muscleGroup field — it's no longer used

  if (sheet.rows) sheet.rows.forEach(r => { if ('muscleGroup' in r) delete r.muscleGroup; });

  return sheet;

}

function trackerCellInput(value, classOnce, ph, oninput) {

  return `<input type="text" inputmode="decimal" class="${classOnce}" value="${value || ''}" placeholder="${ph || ''}" oninput="${oninput}" style="width:100%;padding:5px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:11px;text-align:center;">`;

}

function renderTrackerSheet() {

  // Render into both the Goals sub-tab mount AND the new top-level Tracker screen mount.

  // Either may be missing; we just render into whichever is present.

  const wrapGoals = document.getElementById('tracker-sheet');

  const wrapMain = document.getElementById('tracker-sheet-main');

  const wrap = wrapMain || wrapGoals;

  if (!wrap) return;

  const date = todayStr();

  const sheet = getOrCreateTrackerSheet(date);

  const dow = dayOfWeek();

  const split = (state.workoutSplit && state.workoutSplit[dow]) || 'Rest';

  // Build resistance table headers

  const setHeaderRow = `

    <tr style="background:var(--bg2);">

      <th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;font-size:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.6px;border:1px solid var(--border);min-width:110px;">EXERCISE</th>

      ${Array.from({length: TRACKER_SET_COUNT}, (_, i) => `<th colspan="2" style="text-align:center;padding:4px;font-size:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;border:1px solid var(--border);">SET ${i+1}</th>`).join('')}

    </tr>

    <tr style="background:var(--bg2);">

      <th style="border:1px solid var(--border);"></th>

      ${Array.from({length: TRACKER_SET_COUNT}, () => `

        <th style="text-align:center;padding:3px;font-size:9px;color:var(--text3);border:1px solid var(--border);">WT</th>

        <th style="text-align:center;padding:3px;font-size:9px;color:var(--text3);border:1px solid var(--border);">REPS</th>

      `).join('')}

    </tr>

  `;

  // Single shared datalist scoped to the sheet-level muscle group selection.

  const sharedExercises = exercisesForGroup(sheet.muscleGroup || '');

  const dataRows = sheet.rows.map((row, r) => {

    const setCells = row.sets.map((s, si) => `

      <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">${trackerCellInput(s.weight, 'tr-w', '', `updateTrackerSet(${r},${si},'weight',this.value)`)}</td>

      <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">${trackerCellInput(s.reps, 'tr-r', '', `updateTrackerSet(${r},${si},'reps',this.value)`)}</td>

    `).join('');

    return `

      <tr>

        <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">

          <input type="text" list="tracker-ex-list" value="${(row.exercise || '').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}" placeholder="${sheet.muscleGroup ? 'pick ' + sheet.muscleGroup.toLowerCase() + ' exercise' : 'exercise'}" oninput="updateTrackerExercise(${r}, this.value)" style="width:100%;padding:5px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;">

        </td>

        ${setCells}

      </tr>

    `;

  }).join('');

  // Build the muscle group dropdown for the sheet header

  const muscleGroupSelectHtml = MUSCLE_GROUP_OPTIONS.map(g =>

    `<option value="${g}" ${g === (sheet.muscleGroup || '') ? 'selected' : ''}>${g || '— all groups —'}</option>`

  ).join('');

  wrap.innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">

      <div>

        <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;">EXERCISE TRACKER</div>

        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US',{weekday:'long',month:'short',day:'numeric'})} · ${split}</div>

      </div>

      <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="resetTrackerSheet()" title="Wipe today's sheet and re-prefill from your split" style="font-size:10px;">Reset</button>

    </div>

    <div class="card" style="padding:10px;">

      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:8px;">

        <div style="flex:1;min-width:120px;">

          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:3px;">DATE</div>

          <input type="text" value="${sheet.date}" readonly style="width:100%;padding:5px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text2);font-size:12px;">

        </div>

        <div style="flex:1;min-width:120px;">

          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:3px;">TOTAL WORKOUT TIME</div>

          <input type="text" value="${sheet.totalTime || ''}" placeholder="e.g. 60 min" oninput="updateTrackerField('totalTime', this.value)" style="width:100%;padding:5px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;">

        </div>

        <div style="flex:2;min-width:200px;">

          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:3px;">MUSCLE GROUP <span style="color:var(--text3);font-size:9px;font-weight:400;">— filters exercise dropdowns</span></div>

          <select onchange="updateTrackerSheetMuscleGroup(this.value)" style="width:100%;padding:6px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;">

            ${muscleGroupSelectHtml}

          </select>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.6px;margin-bottom:4px;">RESISTANCE TRAINING</div>

      <div style="overflow-x:auto;">

        <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;">

          <thead>${setHeaderRow}</thead>

          <tbody>${dataRows}</tbody>

        </table>

      </div>

      <datalist id="tracker-ex-list">${sharedExercises.map(x => `<option value="${x.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}">`).join('')}</datalist>

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.6px;margin:14px 0 4px;">CARDIO</div>

      <div style="overflow-x:auto;">

        <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;">

          <thead>

            <tr style="background:var(--bg2);">

              <th style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px;text-align:left;font-size:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;">EXERCISE</th>

              <th style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px;font-size:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;">DURATION</th>

              <th style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px;font-size:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;">SPEED</th>

              <th style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px;font-size:10px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;">DISTANCE</th>

            </tr>

          </thead>

          <tbody>

            <tr>

              <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">

                <input type="text" list="tracker-cardio-list" value="${sheet.cardio.exercise || ''}" placeholder="e.g. Treadmill" oninput="updateTrackerCardio('exercise', this.value)" style="width:100%;padding:5px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;">

              </td>

              <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">${trackerCellInput(sheet.cardio.duration, 'cd-d', 'min', "updateTrackerCardio('duration', this.value)")}</td>

              <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">${trackerCellInput(sheet.cardio.speed, 'cd-s', 'mph', "updateTrackerCardio('speed', this.value)")}</td>

              <td style="border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1px;">${trackerCellInput(sheet.cardio.distance, 'cd-x', 'mi', "updateTrackerCardio('distance', this.value)")}</td>

            </tr>

          </tbody>

        </table>

      </div>

      <datalist id="tracker-cardio-list">${CARDIO_POOL.map(x => `<option value="${x}">`).join('')}</datalist>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;">

        <button class="btn btn-full" onclick="renderTrackerSheet()" style="font-size:12px;">Refresh</button>

        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" onclick="commitTrackerToLog()" style="font-size:12px;">${iconSvg('check', 14)} Save Session to Log</button>

      </div>

      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:6px;text-align:center;">

        Edits autosave. Tap <strong>Save Session</strong> to push filled rows to your workout log so they appear in Exercise Progression.

      </div>

    </div>

  `;

  // Mirror the rendered HTML into the secondary mount (the other Tracker location)

  // so both the Goals sub-tab and the top-level Tracker screen stay in sync.

  if (wrapGoals && wrapGoals !== wrap) wrapGoals.innerHTML = wrap.innerHTML;

  if (wrapMain && wrapMain !== wrap) wrapMain.innerHTML = wrap.innerHTML;

}

// --- Tracker mutators (autosave) ---

function _ensureSheet() { return getOrCreateTrackerSheet(todayStr()); }

function updateTrackerField(field, value) {

  const s = _ensureSheet();

  s[field] = value;

  save();

}

function updateTrackerExercise(rowIdx, value) {

  const s = _ensureSheet();

  if (s.rows[rowIdx]) { s.rows[rowIdx].exercise = value; save(); }

}

// Sheet-level muscle group: changing it updates the shared exercise datalist

// for all rows. We keep any exercises already typed (the user can still see

// what they entered) but the dropdown options below now reflect the new group.

function updateTrackerSheetMuscleGroup(value) {

  const s = _ensureSheet();

  s.muscleGroup = value;

  save();

  renderTrackerSheet();

}

function updateTrackerSet(rowIdx, setIdx, kind, value) {

  const s = _ensureSheet();

  if (s.rows[rowIdx] && s.rows[rowIdx].sets[setIdx]) {

    s.rows[rowIdx].sets[setIdx][kind] = value;

    save();

  }

}

function updateTrackerCardio(field, value) {

  const s = _ensureSheet();

  s.cardio[field] = value;

  save();

}

function resetTrackerSheet() {

  if (!confirm("Wipe today's tracker sheet and re-prefill from your split?")) return;

  delete state.trackerSheets[todayStr()];

  save();

  renderTrackerSheet();

  showNotif('Tracker sheet reset');

}

// Push filled rows to state.workoutLog so they show up in Exercise Progression.

// Each row with at least one (weight or reps) entry becomes one log entry.

// If an entry already exists for this date+exercise from the tracker, replace it.

function commitTrackerToLog() {

  const date = todayStr();

  const sheet = state.trackerSheets[date];

  if (!sheet) { showNotif('Nothing to save'); return; }

  let logged = 0, skipped = 0;

  state.workoutLog = state.workoutLog || [];

  sheet.rows.forEach(row => {

    const ex = (row.exercise || '').trim();

    if (!ex) return;

    const sets = row.sets

      .map(s => ({ weight: parseFloat(s.weight) || 0, reps: parseInt(s.reps) || 0, rpe: null }))

      .filter(s => s.weight > 0 || s.reps > 0);

    if (!sets.length) { skipped++; return; }

    state.workoutLog = state.workoutLog.filter(e => !(e.date === date && (e.exercise||'').toLowerCase() === ex.toLowerCase() && e.source === 'tracker'));

    state.workoutLog.push({

      id: Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),

      date, exercise: ex, sets,

      notes: '',

      source: 'tracker'

    });

    logged++;

  });

  // Cardio — also log if filled

  const c = sheet.cardio;

  if (c && c.exercise && (c.duration || c.distance)) {

    state.workoutLog = state.workoutLog.filter(e => !(e.date === date && (e.exercise||'').toLowerCase() === c.exercise.toLowerCase() && e.source === 'tracker'));

    state.workoutLog.push({

      id: Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),

      date, exercise: c.exercise,

      sets: [],

      cardio: { duration: c.duration, speed: c.speed, distance: c.distance },

      notes: '',

      source: 'tracker'

    });

    logged++;

  }

  save();

  if (logged === 0) {

    showNotif('Fill in at least one set first', 'var(--amber)');

  } else {

    showNotif(`${logged} exercise${logged===1?'':'s'} saved to log`);

  }

  if (typeof renderTrainingLog === 'function') renderTrainingLog();

  if (typeof renderExerciseProgression === 'function') renderExerciseProgression();

}
