// Preset quick-add allergens for the avoid list (common intolerances)

const PRESET_ALLERGENS = ['peanuts','tree nuts','dairy','gluten','eggs','soy','shellfish','fish','sesame'];

// Category expansions — when a user blocks a category, match any of these keywords

// in a recipe's ingredient list. Matches are substring, case-insensitive.

const BLOCK_CATEGORIES = {

  'dairy':      ['milk','cheese','yogurt','butter','cream','whey','cottage','parmesan','feta','cheddar','ricotta','mozzarella'],

  'gluten':     ['bread','tortilla','pasta','penne','crouton','wheat','flour','barley','rye','oats','oat'],

  'tree nuts':  ['almond','walnut','cashew','pecan','hazelnut','pistachio','macadamia'],

  'treenuts':   ['almond','walnut','cashew','pecan','hazelnut','pistachio','macadamia'],

  'nuts':       ['almond','walnut','cashew','pecan','hazelnut','pistachio','macadamia','peanut'],

  'shellfish':  ['shrimp','crab','lobster','scallop','clam','mussel','prawn'],

  'fish':       ['salmon','tuna','cod','tilapia','trout','halibut','sardine','mackerel','bass','anchovy'],

  'eggs':       ['egg'],

  'soy':        ['soy','tofu','edamame','tempeh','miso'],

  'peanuts':    ['peanut'],

  'sesame':     ['sesame','tahini'],

};

// Does this recipe contain anything the user wants to avoid? Returns null or { block, matched }.

function recipeBlockedBy(recipe) {

  const list = (state.blocklist || []).map(b => String(b).toLowerCase().trim()).filter(Boolean);

  if (!list.length) return null;

  const ingr = ((recipe && recipe.ingredients) || []).map(i => String(i).toLowerCase());

  if (!ingr.length) return null;

  for (const block of list) {

    const kws = BLOCK_CATEGORIES[block] || [block];

    for (const kw of kws) {

      for (const i of ingr) {

        if (i.includes(kw)) return { block, matched: i };

      }

    }

  }

  return null;

}

// What's left in today's macro budget? Subtracts logged meals + active meal-prep days.

function remainingMacrosToday() {

  const today = todayStr();

  const meals = (state.todayMeals || []).filter(m => m.date === today);

  const totals = meals.reduce((a, m) => ({

    cals:  a.cals  + (m.cals  || 0),

    prot:  a.prot  + (m.prot  || 0),

    carbs: a.carbs + (m.carbs || 0),

    fat:   a.fat   + (m.fat   || 0),

  }), { cals: 0, prot: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 });

  const prepEnabled = !state.settings || state.settings.mealPrepEnabled !== false;

  if (prepEnabled) {

    const dow = (typeof dayOfWeek === 'function' ? dayOfWeek() : '').toLowerCase();

    (state.mealPrep || []).forEach(mp => {

      const d = (mp.days || '').toLowerCase();

      if (d.includes(dow.slice(0,3)) || d.includes('all')) {

        totals.cals += mp.cals||0; totals.prot += mp.prot||0; totals.carbs += mp.carbs||0; totals.fat += mp.fat||0;

      }

    });

  }

  const tgt = state.macros || { calories:2000, protein:150, carbs:200, fat:60 };

  return {

    cals:  Math.max(0, (tgt.calories || 0) - totals.cals),

    prot:  Math.max(0, (tgt.protein  || 0) - totals.prot),

    carbs: Math.max(0, (tgt.carbs    || 0) - totals.carbs),

    fat:   Math.max(0, (tgt.fat      || 0) - totals.fat),

  };

}

// Rank recipes by how well they fill remaining macro budget. Filters out blocked ones.

// Strategy: keep recipes whose cals fit (<=130% of remaining cals if there's headroom

// left), then sort by protein-density so we prioritize hitting the protein floor.

function suggestRecipes(limit = 6) {

  const rem = remainingMacrosToday();

  const pool = RECIPE_BANK.filter(r => !recipeBlockedBy(r));

  let fits = pool;

  if (rem.cals > 150) fits = pool.filter(r => r.cals <= rem.cals * 1.3);

  // If protein is the limiting factor (low remaining protein ratio), sort by protein density.

  // Otherwise sort by calorie fit (closest under-target first).

  const remProtDensity = rem.cals ? rem.prot / rem.cals : 0;

  if (remProtDensity >= 0.08) {

    fits = fits.slice().sort((a,b) => (b.prot / Math.max(1,b.cals)) - (a.prot / Math.max(1,a.cals)));

  } else {

    fits = fits.slice().sort((a,b) => Math.abs(rem.cals - a.cals) - Math.abs(rem.cals - b.cals));

  }

  return fits.slice(0, limit);

}

// --- Blocklist actions ---

function addToBlocklist(valArg) {

  const input = document.getElementById('blocklist-input');

  const raw = valArg != null ? valArg : (input ? input.value : '');

  const entry = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  if (!entry) return;

  state.blocklist = state.blocklist || [];

  if (!state.blocklist.includes(entry)) {

    state.blocklist.push(entry);

    save();

    renderBlocklist();

    renderSavedRecipes();

    renderRecipeSuggestions();

    showNotif(`Avoiding: ${entry}`);

  } else {

    showNotif(`${entry} is already on your avoid list`);

  }

  if (input && valArg == null) input.value = '';

}

function removeFromBlocklist(entry) {

  state.blocklist = (state.blocklist || []).filter(b => b !== entry);

  save(); renderBlocklist(); renderSavedRecipes(); renderRecipeSuggestions();

}

function renderBlocklist() {

  const chips = document.getElementById('blocklist-chips');

  const quick = document.getElementById('blocklist-quick');

  if (!chips || !quick) return;

  const list = state.blocklist || [];

  chips.innerHTML = list.length

    ? list.map(b => `<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.12);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35);border-radius:12px;color:var(--red2);font-size:11px;">${b}<button onclick="removeFromBlocklist(${JSON.stringify(b)})" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--red2);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;line-height:1;padding:0;">×</button></span>`).join('')

    : '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">No allergens or disliked ingredients yet.</div>';

  quick.innerHTML = PRESET_ALLERGENS

    .filter(a => !list.includes(a))

    .map(a => `<button onclick="addToBlocklist(${JSON.stringify(a)})" style="background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;">+ ${a}</button>`)

    .join('') || '<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">All common allergens added.</span>';

}

// --- Saved recipe actions ---

function logSavedRecipe(id) {

  const r = (state.savedRecipes || []).find(x => x.id == id);

  if (!r) return;

  const blocked = recipeBlockedBy(r);

  openAddMealFromRecipe(r, 'extra');

  if (blocked) {

    showNotif(`Heads-up: contains ${blocked.matched} (avoid list)`, 'var(--amber)');

  }

}

function deleteSavedRecipe(id) {

  if (!confirm('Remove this recipe from My Recipes?')) return;

  state.savedRecipes = (state.savedRecipes || []).filter(x => x.id != id);

  save(); renderSavedRecipes(); showNotif('Recipe removed');

}

function renderSavedRecipes() {

  const list = document.getElementById('saved-recipes-list');

  const count = document.getElementById('saved-recipes-count');

  if (!list) return;

  const recipes = state.savedRecipes || [];

  if (count) count.textContent = recipes.length ? `${recipes.length} saved` : '';

  if (!recipes.length) {

    list.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;">No recipes saved yet. Log a meal with "Save to My Recipes" checked to build your library.</div>';

    return;

  }

  list.innerHTML = recipes.map(r => {

    const blocked = recipeBlockedBy(r);

    const warn = blocked ? `<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--red2);padding:1px 6px;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1);border-radius:4px;margin-left:6px;" title="Contains ${blocked.matched}">⚠ ${blocked.block}</span>` : '';

    const ings = r.ingredients || [];

    const ingList = ings.length

      ? `<ul style="margin:6px 0 4px 0;padding-left:14px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.45;">${ings.map(i => `<li>${i}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`

      : '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;">no ingredients listed</div>';

    return `

      <div class="meal-entry" style="align-items:flex-start;">

        <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">

          <div class="meal-entry-name" style="display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">${r.label}${warn}</div>

          ${ingList}

          <div class="meal-entry-macros">P:${r.prot||0}g · C:${r.carbs||0}g · F:${r.fat||0}g</div>

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;">

          <div class="meal-entry-cal">${r.cals||0}</div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">

            <button onclick="logSavedRecipe(${JSON.stringify(r.id)})" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" style="font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px;">Log</button>

            <button onclick="deleteSavedRecipe(${JSON.stringify(r.id)})" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--red2);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;">×</button>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).join('');

}

// --- Suggestions ---

function logSuggestion(idx) {

  const all = suggestRecipes(50);

  const r = all[idx];

  if (!r) return;

  openAddMealFromRecipe(r, 'extra');

}

function saveSuggestionToLibrary(idx) {

  const all = suggestRecipes(50);

  const r = all[idx];

  if (!r) return;

  state.savedRecipes = state.savedRecipes || [];

  if (state.savedRecipes.some(x => x.label === r.label)) {

    showNotif('Already in My Recipes'); return;

  }

  state.savedRecipes.push({

    id: Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),

    label: r.label, ingredients: r.ingredients.slice(),

    cals: r.cals, prot: r.prot, carbs: r.carbs, fat: r.fat,

    notes: '', createdAt: todayStr()

  });

  save(); renderSavedRecipes(); showNotif(`${r.label} saved to My Recipes`);

}

function renderRecipeSuggestions() {

  const list = document.getElementById('recipe-suggestions-list');

  const hint = document.getElementById('suggestions-hint');

  if (!list) return;

  const rem = remainingMacrosToday();

  if (hint) hint.textContent = rem.cals > 0 ? `${rem.cals} kcal · ${rem.prot}g P left` : 'targets met';

  const picks = suggestRecipes(6);

  if (!picks.length) {

    list.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;">No suggestions — your avoid list filtered everything out.</div>';

    return;

  }

  list.innerHTML = picks.map((r, i) => {

    const ingList = `<ul style="margin:6px 0 4px 0;padding-left:14px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.45;">${r.ingredients.map(it => `<li>${it}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`;

    return `

      <div class="meal-entry" style="align-items:flex-start;">

        <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">

          <div class="meal-entry-name">${r.label}</div>

          ${ingList}

          <div class="meal-entry-macros">P:${r.prot}g · C:${r.carbs}g · F:${r.fat}g</div>

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;">

          <div class="meal-entry-cal">${r.cals}</div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">

            <button onclick="logSuggestion(${i})" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" style="font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px;">Log</button>

            <button onclick="saveSuggestionToLibrary(${i})" class="btn btn-sm" style="font-size:10px;padding:3px 6px;" title="Save to My Recipes">☆</button>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).join('');

}

// ===== NUTRITION =====

function renderNutrition() {

  applyMealPrepVisibility();

  renderDailyNutrition();

  renderWeeklyNutrition();

  renderMealPrep();

  renderBlocklist();

  renderSavedRecipes();

  renderRecipeSuggestions();

}

// Hides/shows meal-prep surfaces (tab button, swap-meal CTA, prep pane) based on

// state.settings.mealPrepEnabled. Idempotent — safe to call on every render.

function applyMealPrepVisibility() {

  const enabled = !state.settings || state.settings.mealPrepEnabled !== false;

  const tabBtn = document.getElementById('nut-tab-prep');

  if (tabBtn) tabBtn.style.display = enabled ? '' : 'none';

  // The second button in the daily "meals" block is the meal-prep swap action

  const swapBtn = document.querySelector('#nut-daily button[onclick*="openAddMealModal(\'swap\')"]');

  if (swapBtn) swapBtn.style.display = enabled ? '' : 'none';

  // If meal prep is off and the user was on the prep tab, bounce them to daily.

  const prepPane = document.getElementById('nut-prep');

  if (!enabled && prepPane && prepPane.style.display !== 'none') {

    if (typeof switchNutTab === 'function') switchNutTab('daily');

  }

  // Keep the settings toggle visually in sync if it exists on screen.

  const mpToggle = document.getElementById('mealprep-toggle');

  if (mpToggle) mpToggle.classList.toggle('on', enabled);

}

function renderDailyNutrition() {

  const meals = state.todayMeals.filter(m => m.date === todayStr());

  const totals = meals.reduce((a, m) => ({

    cals: a.cals + (m.cals||0), prot: a.prot + (m.prot||0), carbs: a.carbs + (m.carbs||0), fat: a.fat + (m.fat||0)

  }), { cals: 0, prot: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 });

  // Add meal prep meals for today (only when the meal-prep dashboard is enabled)

  const mealPrepEnabled = !state.settings || state.settings.mealPrepEnabled !== false;

  if (mealPrepEnabled) {

    const dow = dayOfWeek();

    state.mealPrep.forEach(mp => {

      if ((mp.days || '').toLowerCase().includes(dow.toLowerCase().slice(0,3)) || (mp.days || '').toLowerCase().includes('all')) {

        totals.cals += mp.cals||0; totals.prot += mp.prot||0; totals.carbs += mp.carbs||0; totals.fat += mp.fat||0;

      }

    });

  }

  const tgt = state.macros;

  const calPct = Math.min(100, Math.round(totals.cals / tgt.calories * 100));

  if (document.getElementById('today-cals')) {

    document.getElementById('today-cals').textContent = totals.cals;

    document.getElementById('target-cals-display').textContent = tgt.calories;

    document.getElementById('cals-remaining-display').textContent = Math.max(0, tgt.calories - totals.cals) + ' kcal left';

    document.getElementById('cal-bar').style.width = calPct + '%';

    document.getElementById('cal-bar').style.background = calPct > 105 ? 'var(--red)' : calPct > 90 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--green)';

  }

  // Macro mini bars

  const macroWrap = document.getElementById('daily-macro-bars');

  if (macroWrap) {

    const macroItems = [

      { name: 'Protein', curr: totals.prot, tgt: tgt.protein, color: 'var(--red2)', unit: 'g' },

      { name: 'Carbs', curr: totals.carbs, tgt: tgt.carbs, color: 'var(--accent2)', unit: 'g' },

      { name: 'Fat', curr: totals.fat, tgt: tgt.fat, color: 'var(--gold)', unit: 'g' },

    ];

    macroWrap.innerHTML = macroItems.map(m => `

      <div style="flex:1;text-align:center;">

        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${m.name}</div>

        <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;color:${m.color};">${m.curr}<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">/${m.tgt}${m.unit}</span></div>

        <div class="bar-wrap" style="height:3px;margin-top:3px;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.min(100,Math.round(m.curr/m.tgt*100))}%;background:${m.color};"></div></div>

      </div>

    `).join('');

  }

  // Meals list

  const mealList = document.getElementById('today-meals-list');

  if (mealList) {

    const allMeals = [];

    // Meal prep for today

    state.mealPrep.forEach(mp => {

      if ((mp.days||'').toLowerCase().includes(dow.toLowerCase().slice(0,3)) || (mp.days||'').toLowerCase().includes('all')) {

        allMeals.push({ ...mp, isPrep: true });

      }

    });

    // Extra logged meals

    meals.forEach(m => allMeals.push(m));

    if (allMeals.length === 0) {

      mealList.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;">No meals logged yet today.</div>';

    } else {

      mealList.innerHTML = allMeals.map((m, i) => `

        <div class="meal-entry">

          <div>

            <div class="meal-entry-name">${m.name || m.type || 'Meal'} ${m.isPrep ? '<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--accent2);padding:1px 6px;background:rgba(79,142,255,0.1);border-radius:4px;">PREP</span>' : m.swap ? '<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);padding:1px 6px;background:rgba(240,165,0,0.1);border-radius:4px;">SWAP</span>' : ''}</div>

            <div class="meal-entry-macros">P:${m.prot||0}g · C:${m.carbs||0}g · F:${m.fat||0}g${m.portion ? ' · '+m.portion : ''}</div>

          </div>

          <div class="meal-entry-cal">${m.cals||0}</div>

        </div>

      `).join('');

    }

  }

  // Water

  const w = document.getElementById('water-display');

  const wb = document.getElementById('water-bar');

  if (w) w.textContent = state.todayWater;

  if (wb) wb.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.round(state.todayWater / 128 * 100)) + '%';

  // Micronutrients

  renderMicrosCard();

}

// Sum all Core 8 micros across today's logged meals + active meal-prep entries.

// Meals without a `micros` field contribute zero — that's intentional, since manual

// log entries without a library pick have unknown micros and shouldn't be guessed.

function computeTodayMicros() {

  const totals = emptyMicros();

  const today = todayStr();

  const meals = (state.todayMeals || []).filter(m => m.date === today);

  meals.forEach(m => {

    if (m.micros) MICRO_KEYS.forEach(k => { totals[k] += m.micros[k] || 0; });

  });

  // Include meal prep entries scheduled for today (mirrors macro accounting)

  const mealPrepEnabled = !state.settings || state.settings.mealPrepEnabled !== false;

  if (mealPrepEnabled) {

    const dow = dayOfWeek().toLowerCase().slice(0, 3);

    (state.mealPrep || []).forEach(mp => {

      const days = (mp.days || '').toLowerCase();

      if (mp.micros && (days.includes(dow) || days.includes('all'))) {

        MICRO_KEYS.forEach(k => { totals[k] += mp.micros[k] || 0; });

      }

    });

  }

  return totals;

}

// Render the daily micronutrient progress card. Each row shows current vs target

// with a bar; sodium uses an inverted color scale (under = good, over = warn).

function renderMicrosCard() {

  const card = document.getElementById('micros-card');

  if (!card) return;

  const totals = computeTodayMicros();

  // Detect whether any meals logged today have a micro profile. If none, surface

  // a hint instead of a wall of zeros.

  const today = todayStr();

  const hasAnyMicros = (state.todayMeals || [])

    .filter(m => m.date === today)

    .some(m => m.micros && Object.keys(m.micros).length);

  if (!hasAnyMicros) {

    card.innerHTML = `

      <div style="text-align:center;padding:12px;color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;">

        Log a meal using the <strong style="color:var(--accent2);">food library</strong> to start tracking micros.<br>

        <span style="font-size:10px;">Manual entries don't auto-fill micronutrient data.</span>

      </div>

    `;

    return;

  }

  const rows = MICRO_KEYS.map(k => {

    const meta = MICRO_RDA[k];

    const curr = Math.round((totals[k] || 0) * 10) / 10;

    const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((curr / meta.target) * 100));

    let color, label;

    if (meta.ceiling) {

      // Ceiling micros (sodium, sat fat, added sugar): under = green, near = gold, over = red

      color = curr > meta.target ? 'var(--red2)' : curr > meta.target * 0.8 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--green)';

      label = `${curr} / ${meta.target} ${meta.unit} max`;

    } else {

      color = pct >= 100 ? 'var(--green)' : pct >= 50 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--red2)';

      label = `${curr} / ${meta.target} ${meta.unit}`;

    }

    // Dietary flag badge — small "vegan: critical" / "vegetarian: watch" indicator

    const flag = getDietaryFlag(k);

    let flagBadge = '';

    if (flag) {

      const badgeColor = flag.critical ? 'var(--red2)' : 'var(--gold)';

      flagBadge = `<span title="${flag.note.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.06em;color:${badgeColor};border:1px solid ${badgeColor};border-radius:3px;padding:1px 4px;margin-left:4px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:help;">${flag.pref}${flag.critical ? '·!' : ''}</span>`;

    }

    return `

      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">

        <div style="width:90px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;">${meta.label}${flagBadge}</div>

        <div class="bar-wrap" style="flex:1;height:6px;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${color};"></div></div>

        <div style="width:110px;text-align:right;font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;">${label}</div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).join('');

  card.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">${rows}</div>`;

}

function renderWeeklyNutrition() {

  const wrap = document.getElementById('weekly-macro-summary');

  if (!wrap) return;

        ${days.map(d => `

          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">

            <div style="width:32px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;">${d}</div>

            <div class="bar-wrap" style="flex:1;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.floor(Math.random()*40+40)}%;background:var(--green);"></div></div>

            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);width:60px;text-align:right;">${Math.floor(Math.random()*400+1600)} kcal</div>

          </div>

        `).join('')}

      </div>

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:10px;">Weekly averages update as you log daily entries.</div>

    </div>

  `;

}

function renderMealPrep() {

function switchNutTab(tab) {

  // Respect the meal-prep toggle: if disabled, redirect prep requests to daily.

  if (tab === 'prep' && state.settings && state.settings.mealPrepEnabled === false) tab = 'daily';

  ['daily','weekly','prep'].forEach(t => {

    document.getElementById('nut-' + t).style.display = t === tab ? 'flex' : 'none';

    document.getElementById('nut-tab-' + t).classList.toggle('active', t === tab);

  });

  if (tab === 'weekly') renderWeeklyNutrition();

}

function logWater(oz) {

  state.todayWater += oz;

function saveMealEntry() {

  const type = document.getElementById('meal-modal-type').value;

  const name = document.getElementById('add-meal-name').value || 'Food item';

  const cals = parseInt(document.getElementById('add-meal-cals').value) || 0;

  const prot = parseInt(document.getElementById('add-meal-prot').value) || 0;

  const carbs = parseInt(document.getElementById('add-meal-carbs').value) || 0;

  const fat = parseInt(document.getElementById('add-meal-fat').value) || 0;

  const ingrRaw = (document.getElementById('add-meal-ingredients') || {}).value || '';

  const ingredients = ingrRaw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  // Blocklist warning — log proceeds either way, but user gets a heads-up

  if (ingredients.length) {

    const blocked = recipeBlockedBy({ ingredients });

    if (blocked) {

      showNotif(`Heads-up: contains ${blocked.matched} (on your avoid list)`, 'var(--amber)');

    }

  }

  // Pull micros from hidden buffer (populated by food-library picks). Empty/missing

  // means this meal has no micro data — it'll just contribute zero to the daily sum.

  let micros;

  try {

    const raw = (document.getElementById('add-meal-micros-data') || {}).value || '';

    if (raw) micros = JSON.parse(raw);

  } catch(e) { micros = undefined; }

  state.todayMeals.push({

    date: todayStr(),

    name, cals, prot, carbs, fat,

    ingredients: ingredients.length ? ingredients : undefined,

    micros: micros || undefined,

    swap: type === 'swap'

  });

  // Optionally save as a reusable recipe

  const saveBox = document.getElementById('add-meal-save-recipe');

  if (saveBox && saveBox.checked) {

    state.savedRecipes = state.savedRecipes || [];

    state.savedRecipes.push({

      id: Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),

      label: name,

      ingredients, cals, prot, carbs, fat,

      micros: micros || undefined,

      notes: '',

      createdAt: todayStr()

    });

    showNotif('Saved to My Recipes');

  }

  // Macro-hit streak check (Macro Monk title)

  if (typeof checkMacroHit === 'function') checkMacroHit();

  save(); closeModal('modal-add-meal'); renderDailyNutrition();

  if (typeof renderSavedRecipes === 'function') renderSavedRecipes();

  if (typeof renderRecipeSuggestions === 'function') renderRecipeSuggestions();

  showNotif('Meal logged!');

}

// Detect whether today's logged macros meet the daily targets (within tolerance)

// and update state.stats.macroStreak accordingly. Called whenever a meal is logged.

function checkMacroHit() {

  if (!state.stats) state.stats = { totalQuestsCompleted: 0, anyFullDayCompleted: false, macroStreak: 0, lastMacroHitDate: null };

  const today = todayStr();

  // Already credited today — nothing to do.

  if (state.stats.lastMacroHitDate === today) return;

  const meals = (state.todayMeals || []).filter(m => m.date === today);

  if (!meals.length) return;

  const tot = meals.reduce((a, m) => ({

    cals:  a.cals  + (m.cals  || 0),

    prot:  a.prot  + (m.prot  || 0),

    carbs: a.carbs + (m.carbs || 0),

    fat:   a.fat   + (m.fat   || 0),

  }), { cals: 0, prot: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 });

  const tgt = state.macros || {};

  // "Hit" = protein within -10%/+∞ AND calories within ±10% of target.

  // Protein floor only (over is fine); calories a two-sided window so we don't

  // reward massive surpluses on a cut.

  const protTgt = tgt.protein || 0;

  const calTgt  = tgt.calories || 0;

  const protOk = protTgt ? (tot.prot >= protTgt * 0.9) : true;

  const calOk  = calTgt  ? (tot.cals >= calTgt * 0.9 && tot.cals <= calTgt * 1.1) : true;

  if (!(protOk && calOk)) return;

  // Streak continuity: increment if yesterday hit, otherwise reset to 1.

  const last = state.stats.lastMacroHitDate;

  const yesterday = (() => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); })();

  if (last === yesterday) state.stats.macroStreak = (state.stats.macroStreak || 0) + 1;

  else state.stats.macroStreak = 1;

  state.stats.lastMacroHitDate = today;

  if (typeof evaluateTitles === 'function') evaluateTitles();

}

function saveMealPrep() {

  state.mealPrep.push({

    name: document.getElementById('prep-name').value || 'Meal',

    type: document.getElementById('prep-type').value,

    portion: document.getElementById('prep-portion').value,

    cals: parseInt(document.getElementById('prep-cals').value) || 0,

    prot: parseInt(document.getElementById('prep-prot').value) || 0,

    carbs: parseInt(document.getElementById('prep-carbs').value) || 0,

    fat: parseInt(document.getElementById('prep-fat').value) || 0,

    days: document.getElementById('prep-days').value || 'Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri'

  });

  save(); closeModal('modal-meal-prep'); renderMealPrep(); renderDailyNutrition(); showNotif('Meal prep saved!');

}

function removeMealPrep(idx) { state.mealPrep.splice(idx, 1); save(); renderMealPrep(); renderDailyNutrition(); }

// ===== TRAINING LOG =====

// Common lifts — seeded in the datalist so users aren't staring at an empty suggest

// box. Duplicates with their past exercises are deduped in buildExerciseSuggestList().

const COMMON_LIFTS = [

  'Bench Press', 'Incline Bench Press', 'Dumbbell Bench Press', 'Overhead Press',

  'Squat', 'Front Squat', 'Deadlift', 'Romanian Deadlift', 'Barbell Row', 'Pull-Up',

  'Chin-Up', 'Lat Pulldown', 'Bicep Curl', 'Tricep Pushdown', 'Dumbbell Lunge',

  'Leg Press', 'Leg Curl', 'Leg Extension', 'Calf Raise', 'Farmers Carry',

  'Plank', 'Dead Hang',

];

function openLogExerciseModal(prefillExercise) {

  const sets = document.getElementById('log-ex-sets');

  if (sets) sets.innerHTML = '';

  document.getElementById('log-ex-name').value = prefillExercise || '';

  document.getElementById('log-ex-notes').value = '';

  document.getElementById('log-ex-suggest').textContent = '';

  // Build the datalist of previously-logged + common exercises

  const dl = document.getElementById('log-ex-list');

  if (dl) {

    const seen = new Set();

    const names = [];

    (state.workoutLog || []).slice().reverse().forEach(e => {

      if (e.exercise && !seen.has(e.exercise.toLowerCase())) { seen.add(e.exercise.toLowerCase()); names.push(e.exercise); }

    });

    COMMON_LIFTS.forEach(n => { if (!seen.has(n.toLowerCase())) { seen.add(n.toLowerCase()); names.push(n); } });

    dl.innerHTML = names.map(n => `<option value="${n.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}">`).join('');

  }

  // Seed with one blank set; if we have history for this exercise, prefill weight/reps from the last session

  addSetRow();

  if (prefillExercise) onLogExerciseNameChange();

  openModal('modal-log-exercise');

}

function toggleRpeHelp(e) {

  if (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }

  const pop = document.getElementById('rpe-help-popover');

  if (!pop) return;

  const isOpen = pop.style.display === 'block';

  pop.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';

  if (!isOpen) {

    // Close on outside click

    setTimeout(() => {

      const onDoc = (ev) => {

        if (!pop.contains(ev.target) && ev.target.id !== 'rpe-help-btn') {

          pop.style.display = 'none';

          document.removeEventListener('click', onDoc);

        }

      };

      document.addEventListener('click', onDoc);

    }, 0);

  }

}

function addSetRow(prefill) {

  const wrap = document.getElementById('log-ex-sets');

  if (!wrap) return;

  const n = wrap.children.length + 1;

  const reps = (prefill && prefill.reps) || '';

  const weight = (prefill && prefill.weight) || '';

  const rpe = (prefill && prefill.rpe) || '';

  const row = document.createElement('div');

  row.className = 'log-set-row';

  row.style.cssText = 'display:grid;grid-template-columns:26px 1fr 1fr 70px 26px;gap:6px;align-items:center;';

  row.innerHTML = `

    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;">${n}</div>

    <input type="number" inputmode="numeric" class="set-reps" placeholder="reps" value="${reps}" style="padding:6px;">

    <input type="number" inputmode="decimal" class="set-weight" placeholder="lbs" value="${weight}" style="padding:6px;">

    <select class="set-rpe" style="padding:6px;">

      <option value="">RPE</option>

      ${[5,6,7,8,9,10].map(v => `<option value="${v}"${v==rpe?' selected':''}">${v}</option>`).join('')}

    </select>

    <button onclick="this.parentElement.remove();renumberSetRows();" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--red2);font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;">×</button>

  `;

  wrap.appendChild(row);

  renumberSetRows();

}

function renumberSetRows() {

  const wrap = document.getElementById('log-ex-sets');

  if (!wrap) return;

  [...wrap.children].forEach((row, i) => {

    const label = row.children[0];

    if (label) label.textContent = String(i + 1);

  });

}

// Given the last session for an exercise, suggest the next target based on RPE.

// Rules: avg RPE ≤ 7 → +5 lb; RPE 8 → same weight + 1 rep; RPE ≥ 9 → deload 10%.

function suggestNextLift(exercise) {

  const prior = (state.workoutLog || []).filter(e => (e.exercise || '').toLowerCase() === (exercise || '').toLowerCase());

  if (!prior.length) return null;

  const last = prior[prior.length - 1];

  const sets = last.sets || [];

  if (!sets.length) return null;

  const weights = sets.map(s => +s.weight || 0).filter(w => w > 0);

  const rpes = sets.map(s => +s.rpe || 0).filter(r => r > 0);

  const topWeight = weights.length ? Math.max(...weights) : 0;

  const topSet = sets.find(s => +s.weight === topWeight) || sets[sets.length - 1];

  const avgRpe = rpes.length ? rpes.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / rpes.length : 0;

  const reps = +topSet.reps || 0;

  let nextWeight = topWeight;

  let nextReps = reps;

  let reason;

  if (!avgRpe) { reason = 'No RPE on your last session — try the same weight × reps and grade yourself this time.'; }

  else if (avgRpe <= 7) { nextWeight = snapToPlate(topWeight + 5); reason = `Last set felt RPE ${avgRpe.toFixed(1)} — add weight.`; }

  else if (avgRpe <= 8.5) { nextReps = reps + 1; reason = `RPE ${avgRpe.toFixed(1)} — hold weight, add a rep.`; }

  else { nextWeight = snapToPlate(Math.max(45, topWeight * 0.9)); reason = `RPE ${avgRpe.toFixed(1)} — deload ~10% and rebuild.`; }

  return { last: `${reps} × ${topWeight} lbs`, lastDate: last.date, nextWeight, nextReps, reason, avgRpe: avgRpe ? +avgRpe.toFixed(1) : null };

}

function onLogExerciseNameChange() {

  const name = document.getElementById('log-ex-name').value.trim();

  const suggestEl = document.getElementById('log-ex-suggest');

  if (!name) { suggestEl.textContent = ''; return; }

  const sug = suggestNextLift(name);

  if (!sug) { suggestEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--text3);">New exercise — log your first session to build a progression.</span>`; return; }

  suggestEl.innerHTML = `Last: <strong>${sug.last}</strong> on ${sug.lastDate}. <span style="color:var(--accent2);">Next target: ${sug.nextReps} × ${sug.nextWeight} lbs</span>. <span style="color:var(--text3);">${sug.reason}</span>`;

}

function saveExerciseLog() {

  const name = document.getElementById('log-ex-name').value.trim();

  if (!name) { showNotif('Enter an exercise name'); return; }

  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#log-ex-sets > .log-set-row')];

  const sets = rows.map(r => ({

    reps: parseInt(r.querySelector('.set-reps').value) || 0,

    weight: parseFloat(r.querySelector('.set-weight').value) || 0,

    rpe: parseInt(r.querySelector('.set-rpe').value) || null,

  })).filter(s => s.reps > 0 || s.weight > 0);

  if (!sets.length) { showNotif('Add at least one set'); return; }

  const entry = {

    id: Date.now(),

    date: todayStr(),

    exercise: name,

    sets,

    notes: document.getElementById('log-ex-notes').value.trim(),

  };

  if (!Array.isArray(state.workoutLog)) state.workoutLog = [];

  state.workoutLog.push(entry);

  // XP reward scales with volume

  const volume = sets.reduce((a,s)=>a + (s.reps*s.weight || s.reps || 0), 0);

  const xp = Math.max(30, Math.min(150, Math.round(volume / 80)));

  state.xp += xp;

  save();

  closeModal('modal-log-exercise');

  renderTrainingLog();

  renderExerciseProgression();

  renderStats();

  showNotif(`Session logged · +${xp} XP`);

}

// Delete one session entry. Confirmed via native prompt to keep chrome light.

function deleteWorkoutEntry(id) {

  if (!confirm('Delete this session?')) return;

  state.workoutLog = (state.workoutLog || []).filter(e => e.id !== id);

  save();

  renderTrainingLog();

  renderExerciseProgression();

}

function renderTrainingLog() {

  const el = document.getElementById('training-log-today');

  if (!el) return;

  const today = todayStr();

  const entries = (state.workoutLog || []).filter(e => e.date === today);

  if (!entries.length) {

    el.innerHTML = `<div class="card" style="padding:14px;text-align:center;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;">No exercises logged today.<br><span style="font-size:11px;">Tap <em>+ Log Exercise</em> to record sets, weight, and RPE.</span></div>`;

    return;

  }

  el.innerHTML = entries.map(e => {

    const topSet = (e.sets || []).reduce((m, s) => (s.weight || 0) > (m?.weight || 0) ? s : m, null);

    const volume = (e.sets || []).reduce((a,s)=>a + (s.reps*s.weight || 0), 0);

    const questBadge = e.source === 'quest'

      ? `<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;background:rgba(79,142,255,0.15);color:var(--accent2);border:1px solid var(--accent2);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">QUEST</span>`

      : '';

    return `<div class="card" style="padding:10px;">

      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:8px;">

        <div>

          <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;">${e.exercise}${questBadge}</div>

          <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${(e.sets||[]).length} sets · ${volume ? volume.toLocaleString() + ' lb total' : 'bodyweight'}${topSet && topSet.weight ? ' · top ' + topSet.reps + '×' + topSet.weight + ' lbs' : ''}</div>

        </div>

        <button onclick="deleteWorkoutEntry(${e.id})" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text3);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;">Delete</button>

      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:6px;">

        ${(e.sets||[]).map((s,i) => `<span style="font-size:11px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;">${s.reps || '—'}×${s.weight || 'bw'}${s.rpe?` <span style="color:var(--accent2);">@${s.rpe}</span>`:''}</span>`).join('')}

      </div>

      ${e.notes ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:6px;font-style:italic;">${e.notes}</div>` : ''}

    </div>`;

  }).join('');

}

// ===== CONCEPT TOOLTIPS — plain-language definitions of common fitness terms =====

// Each entry is keyed by a short slug (used in conceptHelpButton + showConceptHelp).

// Definitions are 2–3 sentences max — enough to ground a beginner without overwhelming.

const CONCEPT_DEFINITIONS = {

  rpe: {

    title: 'RPE — Rate of Perceived Exertion',

    body: 'A 1–10 score for how hard a set felt. RPE 7 means "I had 3 reps in the tank"; RPE 9 is "1 more rep maybe"; RPE 10 is true failure. Most working sets should land at RPE 7–8 for sustainable progress.',

  },

  tdee: {

    title: 'TDEE — Total Daily Energy Expenditure',

    body: 'The total calories your body burns in a day, including BMR + activity + movement + digestion. Eating below TDEE creates a deficit (fat loss); eating above creates a surplus (muscle/weight gain).',

  },

  bmr: {

    title: 'BMR — Basal Metabolic Rate',

    body: 'The calories your body burns at complete rest (just keeping the lights on). It\'s ~60–70% of your TDEE. We compute it from height, weight, age, and sex via the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.',

  },

  bf_pct: {

    title: 'Body Fat %',

    body: 'The percentage of your total body weight that is fat tissue. Men typically range 8–25%, women 15–35%. We can auto-estimate it from your waist measurement using the RFM formula (within ~3% of DEXA).',

  },

  lbm: {

    title: 'LBM — Lean Body Mass',

    body: 'Everything in your body that isn\'t fat: muscle, bone, organs, water. Calculated as weight × (1 − BF%). Protein targets are based on LBM, not total weight, so accurate BF% matters here.',

  },

  deficit: {

    title: 'Calorie Deficit',

    body: 'Eating fewer calories than your TDEE so the body burns stored fat for energy. Sustainable rate is ~300–500 kcal/day, yielding 0.5–1 lb/week of fat loss. Larger deficits accelerate loss but increase muscle loss and adherence risk.',

  },

  surplus: {

    title: 'Calorie Surplus',

    body: 'Eating more than your TDEE to support muscle growth. A modest surplus (200–300 kcal/day) optimizes muscle gain while minimizing fat gain. "Bulking" beyond that mostly adds fat, not muscle.',

  },

  protein_target: {

    title: 'Protein Target',

    body: 'Aim for ~0.8–1.0 g protein per lb of bodyweight (or per lb LBM if known). It\'s the single most-impactful macro for muscle gain *and* fat loss — without enough, neither progresses well.',

  },

  one_rm: {

    title: 'Estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM)',

    body: 'Your theoretical max weight for a single rep, calculated from any working set via Epley: weight × (1 + reps/30). Lets you target intensity (e.g., 80% of 1RM) without ever maxing out — safer and a better progress signal.',

  },

  progressive_overload: {

    title: 'Progressive Overload',

    body: 'The single most important principle of strength training: gradually increase the demand over time. Each week, try to add weight, add reps, add sets, or improve form on at least one lift.',

  },

  deload: {

    title: 'Deload Week',

    body: 'A planned week of reduced training intensity (~60% of your usual weights, RPE 5–6) every 4–8 weeks. Lets connective tissue catch up to muscle and almost always leads to PRs the following week.',

  },

};

// Render the small "?" help button as inline HTML. Pass the concept key.

function conceptHelpButton(key, label) {

  const aria = label || (CONCEPT_DEFINITIONS[key] && CONCEPT_DEFINITIONS[key].title) || key;

  return `<button type="button" class="concept-help-btn" onclick="showConceptHelp('${key}', event)" aria-label="What is ${aria.replace(/'/g, '\\\'')}?" title="What is this?" style="width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text3);font-size:9px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle;">?</button>`;

}

// Open the concept help popover anchored near the click target.

function showConceptHelp(key, evt) {

  const def = CONCEPT_DEFINITIONS[key];

  if (!def) return;

  if (evt) { evt.preventDefault(); evt.stopPropagation(); }

  let pop = document.getElementById('concept-help-popover');

  if (!pop) {

    pop = document.createElement('div');

    pop.id = 'concept-help-popover';

    pop.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;display:none;z-index:200;width:260px;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);background:#0a0c10;border:1px solid var(--accent2);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;';

    document.body.appendChild(pop);

    // Click-outside to dismiss

    document.addEventListener('click', function(ev) {

      const p = document.getElementById('concept-help-popover');

      if (!p || p.style.display === 'none') return;

      if (!p.contains(ev.target) && !ev.target.classList?.contains('concept-help-btn')) {

        p.style.display = 'none';

      }

    });

  }

  pop.innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">

      <strong style="color:var(--accent2);font-size:12px;">${def.title}</strong>

      <button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('concept-help-popover').style.display='none'" style="border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text3);font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;padding:0;line-height:1;" aria-label="Close">×</button>

    </div>

    <div>${def.body}</div>

  `;

  // Position near the trigger element

  pop.style.display = 'block';

  if (evt && evt.target) {

    const r = evt.target.getBoundingClientRect();

    const popW = 260;

    const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - popW - 8, r.left + window.scrollX));

    const top = r.bottom + window.scrollY + 6;

    pop.style.left = left + 'px';

    pop.style.top = top + 'px';

  }

}

// ===== EXERCISE DESCRIPTIONS LIBRARY =====

// Plain-language "what muscles + key form cue" entry per common lift. Surfaced via

// the ⓘ icon on the Exercise History modal (Stats > Progression > tap an exercise).

// Lookup is case-insensitive against the canonical exercise name; free-typed lifts

// without an entry get a generic fallback.

//

// Each entry: { muscles: '...', cue: '...', tip?: '...' } where:

//   - muscles: short list of primary muscles worked (matches MUSCLE_GROUPS terms)

//   - cue:     one-sentence key form cue (the single most important thing to get right)

//   - tip:     optional second sentence with progression or safety advice

const EXERCISE_DESCRIPTIONS = {

  // --- Squat family

  'squat':              { muscles: 'Quads, Glutes, Core', cue: 'Sit between your heels — knees tracking over toes, chest up, depth at or below parallel.', tip: 'Brace your core like you\'re about to take a punch before unracking.' },

  'front squat':        { muscles: 'Quads, Glutes, Upper Back', cue: 'Elbows up high, bar resting on front delts; stay upright through the descent.' },

  'goblet squat':       { muscles: 'Quads, Glutes, Core', cue: 'Hold a single dumbbell at your chest; elbows brush your thighs at the bottom.' },

  // --- Hinge family

  'deadlift':           { muscles: 'Glutes, Hamstrings, Back', cue: 'Bar over mid-foot, lats engaged, push the floor away — don\'t pull with your back.', tip: 'If the bar drifts away from your shins, you\'re leaning forward; reset and re-tighten lats.' },

  'romanian deadlift':  { muscles: 'Hamstrings, Glutes, Lower Back', cue: 'Soft knee bend; push hips back until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward.' },

  'conventional deadlift': { muscles: 'Glutes, Hamstrings, Back', cue: 'Bar over mid-foot, lats engaged, push the floor away — don\'t pull with your back.' },

  'hip thrust':         { muscles: 'Glutes, Hamstrings', cue: 'Shoulders on bench, drive through heels until your body forms a straight line — squeeze glutes hard at the top.' },

  // --- Press family

  'bench press':        { muscles: 'Chest, Shoulders, Triceps', cue: 'Slight arch, feet planted, bar to lower-chest with elbows ~45° from body. Drive feet through the floor.', tip: 'Keep your shoulder blades pinched the whole time — they\'re your platform.' },

  'incline bench press':{ muscles: 'Upper Chest, Shoulders', cue: '30–45° incline, bar to upper chest. Don\'t flare elbows past 60°.' },

  'dumbbell bench press': { muscles: 'Chest, Shoulders, Triceps', cue: 'Dumbbells start at chest height; press up and slightly together at the top without clanging.' },

  'overhead press':     { muscles: 'Shoulders, Triceps, Upper Chest', cue: 'Bar starts at front delts; press straight up, head pulls back briefly to let bar pass, then ribcage moves under bar.', tip: 'Glutes and abs tight — this is a full-body lift, not just shoulders.' },

  'dumbbell shoulder press': { muscles: 'Shoulders, Triceps', cue: 'Dumbbells at ear height, palms forward. Press up and slightly in.' },

  'push-up':            { muscles: 'Chest, Shoulders, Triceps, Core', cue: 'Body in a straight line from head to heels; chest grazes the floor, elbows ~45° from torso.' },

  'dip':                { muscles: 'Chest, Triceps, Shoulders', cue: 'Lean slightly forward for chest emphasis or stay upright for triceps. Stop when shoulders dip below elbows.' },

  // --- Pull family

  'pull-up':            { muscles: 'Lats, Upper Back, Biceps', cue: 'Dead hang at the bottom, chin clears the bar at the top. No kipping until you can do 10+ strict.' },

  'chin-up':            { muscles: 'Lats, Biceps, Upper Back', cue: 'Underhand grip, shoulder-width. Pull chest to the bar, not chin to the bar.' },

  'lat pulldown':       { muscles: 'Lats, Upper Back, Biceps', cue: 'Pull bar to upper chest, not behind the neck. Drive elbows down and back.' },

  'barbell row':        { muscles: 'Back, Lats, Rear Delts, Biceps', cue: 'Hinge to ~45°, bar at hips, pull to lower ribs. Keep torso angle steady — don\'t cheat with momentum.' },

  'cable row':          { muscles: 'Mid-Back, Lats, Biceps', cue: 'Sit tall, pull handle to belly button, squeeze shoulder blades — pause briefly at the contraction.' },

  'face pull':          { muscles: 'Rear Delts, Upper Back', cue: 'Rope to face; aim for "double biceps" position with elbows high and wide.', tip: 'Underrated for shoulder health. Do these every back day.' },

  // --- Arm isolation

  'bicep curl':         { muscles: 'Biceps', cue: 'Elbows pinned to your sides; don\'t let them drift forward at the top.' },

  'hammer curl':        { muscles: 'Biceps, Forearms (Brachialis)', cue: 'Neutral grip (palms facing each other) — same control rules as a standard curl.' },

  'tricep pushdown':    { muscles: 'Triceps', cue: 'Elbows pinned to torso, forearms travel through the full range — don\'t let elbows flare.' },

  'skullcrusher':       { muscles: 'Triceps', cue: 'Lower bar to forehead/just past it, elbows stay pointed at the ceiling — don\'t flare them outward.' },

  'overhead tricep extension': { muscles: 'Triceps (long head)', cue: 'Keep upper arms vertical; lower the weight behind your head with elbows tucked.' },

  // --- Leg accessories

  'walking lunge':      { muscles: 'Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings', cue: 'Step long; back knee gently kisses floor. Push through the front heel to drive forward.' },

  'leg press':          { muscles: 'Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings', cue: 'Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Lower until knees hit ~90°; never lock out at the top.' },

  'leg curl':           { muscles: 'Hamstrings', cue: 'Squeeze hamstrings at the top, lower under control.' },

  'leg extension':      { muscles: 'Quads', cue: 'Pause briefly at full extension; control the descent.' },

  'calf raise':         { muscles: 'Calves (Gastrocnemius, Soleus)', cue: 'Pause at the top AND the bottom — calves love long range of motion.' },

  // --- Core

  'plank':              { muscles: 'Core, Shoulders', cue: 'Body in a straight line; squeeze glutes and brace abs. Quality over time.' },

  'side plank':         { muscles: 'Obliques, Core', cue: 'Stack feet, hips up — body forms one straight line from ankle to shoulder.' },

  'russian twist':      { muscles: 'Obliques', cue: 'Lean back ~45°, rotate from your torso (not arms). Heels can stay light on floor for beginners.' },

  // --- Olympic / athletic

  'kettlebell swing':   { muscles: 'Glutes, Hamstrings, Core', cue: 'Hip hinge — the bell is propelled by hip drive, not arms. Bell tops out at chest height (not overhead).' },

  'burpee':             { muscles: 'Full Body, Conditioning', cue: 'Quality reps over speed: full plank position, full hip extension on the jump.' },

  // --- Mobility / new split types from T3.1

  'sun salutation a':   { muscles: 'Full Body Mobility', cue: 'Linked breath to movement — inhale up, exhale fold. 5 rounds is a great warm-up.' },

  'world\'s greatest stretch': { muscles: 'Hips, T-Spine, Hamstrings', cue: 'Lunge → hand inside front foot → reach overhead twist. The MVP of warm-ups.' },

  'foam rolling':       { muscles: 'Soft tissue / fascia', cue: '60–90 sec per muscle group. Roll slowly, breathe deeply when you find a tender spot.' },

};

// Lookup that handles case insensitivity + a few common alternate names.

function describeExercise(name) {

  const key = (name || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!key) return null;

  if (EXERCISE_DESCRIPTIONS[key]) return EXERCISE_DESCRIPTIONS[key];

  // Aliases — common alternate spellings/abbreviations

  const aliases = {

    'db bench': 'dumbbell bench press',

    'db bench press': 'dumbbell bench press',

    'db press': 'dumbbell shoulder press',

    'ohp': 'overhead press',

    'rdl': 'romanian deadlift',

    'pulldown': 'lat pulldown',

    'bb row': 'barbell row',

    'crunches': 'russian twist',

    'kb swing': 'kettlebell swing',

    'curl': 'bicep curl',

    'tricep extension': 'overhead tricep extension',

  };

  if (aliases[key] && EXERCISE_DESCRIPTIONS[aliases[key]]) return EXERCISE_DESCRIPTIONS[aliases[key]];

  return null;

}

// ===== ESTIMATED 1-REP MAX (Epley formula) =====

// 1RM ≈ weight × (1 + reps / 30). Validated for rep ranges 1–10. We cap reps at 10

// in the calc to avoid wildly inflated estimates from very-light, very-high-rep work

// (e.g., a 50×30 set isn't a meaningful 1RM signal). Returns 0 if weight or reps is

// missing — caller decides whether to show "—" or hide the badge.

function estimate1RM(weight, reps) {

  const w = parseFloat(weight) || 0;

  const r = parseFloat(reps) || 0;

  if (w <= 0 || r <= 0) return 0;

  const cappedReps = Math.min(r, 10);

  return Math.round(w * (1 + cappedReps / 30));

}

// Pulls the highest estimated 1RM across all sets in a single session entry.

// Used by the progression view + history modal so users see today's "potential"

// even when their top working set wasn't a 1RM attempt.

function bestSession1RM(sessionEntry) {

  const sets = (sessionEntry && sessionEntry.sets) || [];

  let best = 0;

  for (const s of sets) {

    const e = estimate1RM(s.weight, s.reps);

    if (e > best) best = e;

  }

  return best;

}

// ===== WEEKLY VOLUME ROLLUP (sets per muscle group, last 7 days) =====

// Built from MUSCLE_GROUPS at module load — reverse map from canonical exercise

// names to their primary muscle group. Free-typed exercises that don't match the

// canonical list map to "Other" so we don't lose them entirely.

const EXERCISE_TO_MUSCLE = (() => {

  const m = {};

  Object.entries(MUSCLE_GROUPS).forEach(([group, list]) => {

    list.forEach(ex => { m[ex.toLowerCase()] = group; });

  });

  return m;

})();

// Best-effort group lookup. Tries exact match first, then a substring match against

// the canonical names (so "DB Bench" still maps to Chest because "Bench Press" does).

function muscleGroupForExercise(exerciseName) {

  const key = (exerciseName || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!key) return 'Other';

  if (EXERCISE_TO_MUSCLE[key]) return EXERCISE_TO_MUSCLE[key];

  // Fallback: keyword sniff. Order matters — more specific keywords first.

  const sniff = [

    ['squat', 'Legs'], ['lunge', 'Legs'], ['deadlift', 'Legs'], ['leg ', 'Legs'], ['glute', 'Legs'], ['calf', 'Legs'], ['hip thrust', 'Legs'],

    ['bench', 'Chest'], ['chest', 'Chest'], ['fly', 'Chest'], ['push-up', 'Chest'], ['dip', 'Chest'],

    ['row', 'Back'], ['pulldown', 'Back'], ['pull-up', 'Back'], ['chin-up', 'Back'], ['lat ', 'Back'], ['back', 'Back'],

    ['press', 'Shoulders'], ['raise', 'Shoulders'], ['shoulder', 'Shoulders'], ['delt', 'Shoulders'],

    ['curl', 'Arms'], ['tricep', 'Arms'], ['bicep', 'Arms'], ['skull', 'Arms'],

    ['plank', 'Core'], ['crunch', 'Core'], ['ab ', 'Core'], ['core', 'Core'], ['russian', 'Core'], ['hollow', 'Core'],

    ['burpee', 'Full Body'], ['thruster', 'Full Body'], ['clean', 'Full Body'], ['snatch', 'Full Body'], ['kettlebell swing', 'Full Body'],

  ];

  for (const [needle, group] of sniff) {

    if (key.includes(needle)) return group;

  }

  return 'Other';

}

// Render the weekly volume card. Aggregates working sets (any set with reps > 0)

// from state.workoutLog over the last 7 days, grouped by muscle group.

function renderWeeklyVolume() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('volume-rollup');

  if (!slot) return;

  const log = state.workoutLog || [];

  const cutoff = new Date();

  cutoff.setDate(cutoff.getDate() - 7);

  const cutoffStr = cutoff.toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const recent = log.filter(e => (e.date || '') >= cutoffStr);

  // Aggregate sets per muscle group. A "working set" = any set with reps > 0

  // (even bodyweight is counted — reps drive hypertrophy regardless of load).

  const counts = {};

  recent.forEach(e => {

    const group = muscleGroupForExercise(e.exercise);

    const sets = (e.sets || []).filter(s => (parseFloat(s.reps) || 0) > 0).length;

    counts[group] = (counts[group] || 0) + sets;

  });

  // Display order — primary movers first, then accessories, then catch-all.

  const order = ['Chest','Back','Legs','Shoulders','Arms','Core','Full Body','Other'];

  const total = Object.values(counts).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0);

  if (total === 0) {

    slot.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--text3);padding:8px 0;">No working sets logged in the last 7 days. Volume = sets × reps; log a session from the Tracker or Quests tab.</div>`;

    return;

  }

  // Per-muscle minimum effective volume — typical hypertrophy minimums (Schoenfeld 2017+).

  // Used to color-code: dim if under, bright if hitting/exceeding. Numbers err on the

  // conservative side so beginners aren't pushed to over-train.

  const MEV = { Chest: 8, Back: 10, Legs: 8, Shoulders: 6, Arms: 6, Core: 0, 'Full Body': 0, Other: 0 };

  const max = Math.max(...Object.values(counts), 1);

  slot.innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">

      ${order.filter(g => counts[g] !== undefined && counts[g] > 0).map(g => {

        const n = counts[g];

        const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((n / max) * 100));

        const target = MEV[g] || 0;

        const meetsTarget = target === 0 || n >= target;

        const color = meetsTarget ? 'var(--green2)' : 'var(--gold)';

        const targetNote = target > 0

          ? (meetsTarget ? '' : `<span style="color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;margin-left:4px;">need ${target}+/wk</span>`)

          : '';

        return `

          <div>

            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px;">

              <span style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;">${g.toUpperCase()}</span>

              <span><strong style="color:${color};">${n}</strong> <span style="color:var(--text3);">sets</span>${targetNote}</span>

            </div>

            <div class="bar-wrap" style="height:5px;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${color};"></div></div>

          </div>

        `;

      }).join('')}

    </div>

    <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.4;">

      <strong style="color:var(--text2);">Total:</strong> ${total} working sets across ${recent.length} session${recent.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}.

      Targets are minimum effective volumes for hypertrophy — yellow means you have room to add a set or two; green means you're in the sweet spot.

    </div>

  `;

}

// Build a dedupe-by-exercise progression list sorted by most recent activity.

function renderExerciseProgression() {

  const el = document.getElementById('exercise-progression-list');

  if (!el) return;

  const log = state.workoutLog || [];

  if (!log.length) {

    el.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--text3);padding:8px 0;">No exercises logged yet. Log a session from the Quests tab to start tracking progression.</div>`;

    return;

  }

  // Group by exercise (case-insensitive) and find the latest session for each

  const groups = new Map();

  log.forEach(e => {

    const key = (e.exercise || '').toLowerCase();

    const arr = groups.get(key) || [];

    arr.push(e);

    groups.set(key, arr);

  });

  const summaries = [...groups.entries()].map(([_, sessions]) => {

    sessions.sort((a,b) => (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || ''));

    const last = sessions[sessions.length - 1];

    const prior = sessions.length > 1 ? sessions[sessions.length - 2] : null;

    const topOf = s => (s.sets || []).reduce((m, x) => (x.weight || 0) > (m?.weight || 0) ? x : m, null);

    const lastTop = topOf(last);

    const priorTop = prior ? topOf(prior) : null;

    const delta = lastTop && priorTop && priorTop.weight ? (lastTop.weight - priorTop.weight) : 0;

    const sug = suggestNextLift(last.exercise);

    // Estimated 1RM trend — pull best 1RM across all sets, not just top by weight.

    // This catches rep-PR sessions that didn't beat top weight.

    const last1RM = bestSession1RM(last);

    const prior1RM = prior ? bestSession1RM(prior) : 0;

    const delta1RM = (last1RM && prior1RM) ? last1RM - prior1RM : 0;

    return { exercise: last.exercise, sessions: sessions.length, lastDate: last.date, lastTop, delta, sug, last1RM, delta1RM };

  }).sort((a,b) => (b.lastDate || '').localeCompare(a.lastDate || ''));

  el.innerHTML = summaries.map(s => {

    const d = s.lastTop ? `${s.lastTop.reps}×${s.lastTop.weight} lbs` : 'bodyweight';

    const deltaStr = s.delta > 0 ? `<span style="color:var(--green2);">+${s.delta} lb</span>` : s.delta < 0 ? `<span style="color:var(--red2);">${s.delta} lb</span>` : '<span style="color:var(--text3);">no change</span>';

    // 1RM badge — only render when we have a meaningful number (>0). Color the trend:

    // green for gain, red for regression, gold for first-session (no comparison yet).

    let oneRmBadge = '';

    if (s.last1RM > 0) {

      let trendColor = 'var(--gold)';

      let trendText = '';

      if (s.delta1RM > 0) { trendColor = 'var(--green2)'; trendText = ` <span style="color:${trendColor};">↑${s.delta1RM}</span>`; }

      else if (s.delta1RM < 0) { trendColor = 'var(--red2)'; trendText = ` <span style="color:${trendColor};">↓${Math.abs(s.delta1RM)}</span>`; }

      oneRmBadge = `<span style="display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.06em;background:rgba(244,182,63,0.10);color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">~1RM ${s.last1RM} lb${trendText}</span>`;

    }

    return `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="openExerciseHistory(${JSON.stringify(s.exercise)})">

      <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">

        <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">${s.exercise}${oneRmBadge}</div>

        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${s.sessions} session${s.sessions!==1?'s':''} · last ${s.lastDate} · ${d} · ${deltaStr}</div>

        ${s.sug ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--accent2);">Next: ${s.sug.nextReps} × ${s.sug.nextWeight} lbs</div>` : ''}

      </div>

      <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();openLogExerciseModal(${JSON.stringify(s.exercise)})" class="btn btn-sm" style="padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;">Log</button>

    </div>`;

  }).join('');

}

function openExerciseHistory(exercise) {

  const sessions = (state.workoutLog || []).filter(e => (e.exercise || '').toLowerCase() === (exercise || '').toLowerCase())

                                             .sort((a,b) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''));

  document.getElementById('ex-history-title').innerHTML = `<span class="icon-title-slot" data-icon="barchart"></span>${exercise}`;

  const body = document.getElementById('ex-history-body');

  // Plain-language description for the lift, when we have one. Renders as a sticky-feel

  // info card at the top of the modal so beginners get cues without leaving the screen.

  const desc = describeExercise(exercise);

  const descCard = desc ? `

    <div style="padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(79,142,255,0.06);border:1px solid var(--accent2);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px;">

      <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:var(--accent2);margin-bottom:4px;">FORM CUE · ${desc.muscles}</div>

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text);line-height:1.5;">${desc.cue}</div>

      ${desc.tip ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px;font-style:italic;">${desc.tip}</div>` : ''}

    </div>

  ` : '';

  body.innerHTML = descCard + sessions.map(s => {

    const volume = (s.sets || []).reduce((a,x)=>a + (x.reps*x.weight || 0), 0);

    const sessionMax = bestSession1RM(s);

    // Per-session header: total tonnage on the right, est. 1RM next to the date.

    // Skip 1RM badge for bodyweight-only sessions (sessionMax will be 0).

    const oneRmHdr = sessionMax > 0

      ? `<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);background:rgba(244,182,63,0.10);border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;margin-left:6px;">~1RM ${sessionMax}</span>`

      : '';

    return `<div style="padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">

      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;"><span><strong>${s.date}</strong>${oneRmHdr}</span><span style="color:var(--text3);">${volume ? volume.toLocaleString()+' lb' : 'bw'}</span></div>

      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:4px;">

        ${(s.sets||[]).map(x => {

          const setMax = estimate1RM(x.weight, x.reps);

          const setMaxBadge = setMax > 0 ? ` <span style="color:var(--gold);font-size:9px;">≈${setMax}</span>` : '';

          return `<span style="font-size:11px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;">${x.reps || '—'}×${x.weight || 'bw'}${x.rpe?` <span style="color:var(--accent2);">@${x.rpe}</span>`:''}${setMaxBadge}</span>`;

        }).join('')}

      </div>

      ${s.notes ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px;font-style:italic;">${s.notes}</div>` : ''}

    </div>`;

  }).join('') || '<div style="color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:16px;">No sessions yet.</div>';

  openModal('modal-exercise-history');

  hydrateIcons();

}

// ===== PROFILE =====

function renderProfile() {

  const p = state.profile;

  if (!p) return;

  // Hunter status card (replaces avatar)

  const statusEl = document.getElementById('profile-hunter-status');

  if (statusEl) {

    const rank = state.rank || 'E';

    const rankColor = (typeof RANK_COLORS !== 'undefined' && RANK_COLORS[rank]) || '#4f8eff';

    const rankLabel = (typeof RANK_LABELS !== 'undefined' && RANK_LABELS[rank]) || ('Rank ' + rank);

    const latest = state.logs[state.logs.length - 1] || {};

    const w = latest.weight || p.weight;

    const bf = latest.bf || p.bf;

    statusEl.innerHTML = `

      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;">

          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;">${p.name}</div>

          <div style="font-size:11px;color:${rankColor};font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:600;">${rankLabel.toUpperCase()} · LVL ${state.level || 1}</div>

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;">

          <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${state.xp || 0} XP</div>

          <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">🔥 ${state.streak || 0}-day streak</div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;">

        ${w ? `<div class="avatar-chip"><strong>${w}</strong> lbs</div>` : ''}

        ${bf ? `<div class="avatar-chip"><strong>${bf}%</strong> BF</div>` : ''}

        <div class="avatar-chip" style="color:${rankColor};border-color:${rankColor};">${rankLabel}</div>

      </div>

    `;

  }

  // Coin pill

  const coinPill = document.getElementById('profile-coin-pill');

  if (coinPill) coinPill.innerHTML = `${iconSvg('coin', 16)} ${(state.coins || 0).toLocaleString()}`;

  // Attribute allocator UI removed — see HTML comment in <div id="screen-profile">.

  // Biometrics

  const latest = state.logs[state.logs.length - 1] || {};

  const mealPrepLabel = { none: 'Minimal', partial: 'Partial (2-3/wk)', weekdays: 'Weekdays only', full: 'Full weekly' }[p.mealPrep] || p.mealPrep;

  const goalTypeLabel = { cut: 'Cut (deficit)', recomp: 'Recomp (maintenance + high protein)', maintain: 'Maintain', bulk: 'Bulk (surplus)' }[p.goalType] || p.goalType;

  document.getElementById('profile-bio-display').innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;font-size:13px;">

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Name: </span>${p.name}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Age: </span>${p.age}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Height: </span>${p.height}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Current weight: </span>${latest.weight || p.weight} lbs</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Current BF%: </span>${latest.bf || p.bf}%</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Activity: </span>${p.activity}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Body goal: </span>${p.bodyGoal}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Goal type: </span>${goalTypeLabel}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Meal prep: </span>${mealPrepLabel}</div>

      <div><span style="color:var(--text3);">Meals/day: </span>${p.mealsPerDay || 3}</div>

    </div>

  `;

  // Dietary prefs

  const dietEl = document.getElementById('profile-diet-display');

  if (dietEl) {

    const diets = p.dietaryPrefs && p.dietaryPrefs.length ? p.dietaryPrefs : ['none'];

    dietEl.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;">

      ${diets.map(d => `<span class="diet-chip on" style="cursor:default;">${({'none':'No restrictions','vegetarian':'Vegetarian','vegan':'Vegan','pescatarian':'Pescatarian','keto':'Keto','paleo':'Paleo','mediterranean':'Mediterranean','high-protein':'High protein','gluten-free':'Gluten-free','dairy-free':'Dairy-free','halal':'Halal','kosher':'Kosher'})[d] || d}</span>`).join('')}

    </div>`;

  }

  const splitTable = document.getElementById('split-table-display');

  const days = ['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'];

  // Editable split table — each day's cell is now a select that mutates state on change.

  // SPLIT_DAY_OPTIONS includes every workoutType label the rest of the app understands.

  splitTable.innerHTML = `<thead><tr><th style="width:90px;">Day</th><th>Workout</th></tr></thead><tbody>

    ${days.map(d => {

      const val = state.workoutSplit[d] || 'Rest';

      return `<tr><td>${d}</td><td>

        <select onchange="setSplitDay('${d}', this.value)" style="width:100%;padding:4px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;">

          ${SPLIT_DAY_OPTIONS.map(opt => `<option value="${opt}" ${opt === val ? 'selected' : ''}>${opt}</option>`).join('')}

        </select>

      </td></tr>`;

    }).join('')}

  </tbody>`;

  // Recommender slot — auto-show on first run (no split yet); otherwise the user

  // opens it manually via the "Get a recommendation" button. The button calls

  // showRecommenderCard() which sets a session flag, then re-renders.

  const recSlot = document.getElementById('split-recommender-slot');

  const showRec = !hasUserSplit() || _profileShowRec;

  if (recSlot) {

    if (showRec) {

      const rec = recommendSplit(state.profile, state.goals);

      const previewRows = days.map(d =>

        `<tr><td style="padding:3px 6px;">${d.slice(0,3)}</td><td style="padding:3px 6px;color:var(--accent2);">${rec.split[d]}</td></tr>`

      ).join('');

      const recTips = analyzeSplit(rec.split, state.profile, state.goals);

      const recTipsHtml = recTips.length

        ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:6px;">Notes: ${recTips.map(t => t.message).join(' · ')}</div>`

        : '';

      recSlot.innerHTML = `

        <div class="card" style="padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;border:1px solid var(--accent);background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,182,212,0.08), transparent);">

          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">

            <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent2);">SUGGESTED SPLIT</div>

            <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">based on your goals</div>

          </div>

          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:8px;">${rec.reason}</div>

          <table style="width:100%;font-size:11px;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:10px;">${previewRows}</table>

          ${recTipsHtml}

          <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px;">

            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="applyRecommendedSplit()" style="font-size:12px;flex:1;min-width:120px;">Apply</button>

            <button class="btn" onclick="saveRecommendedSplit()" style="font-size:12px;flex:1;min-width:120px;">Save as preset</button>

            <button class="btn" onclick="hideRecommenderCard()" style="font-size:12px;flex:1;min-width:80px;">Dismiss</button>

          </div>

        </div>`;

    } else {

      recSlot.innerHTML = '';

    }

  }

  // Tips card — analyzes the currently-active split and surfaces clear mismatches.

  const tipsSlot = document.getElementById('split-tips-slot');

  if (tipsSlot) {

    const tips = analyzeSplit(state.workoutSplit, state.profile, state.goals);

    if (tips.length === 0) {

      tipsSlot.innerHTML = `

        <div class="card" style="padding:10px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.3);background:rgba(34,197,94,0.05);">

          <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:12px;color:var(--green2);margin-bottom:4px;">SPLIT ANALYSIS</div>

          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);">Looks well-aligned with your goals.</div>

        </div>`;

    } else {

      const items = tips.map(t => {

        const colors = t.level === 'warn'

          ? { bar: 'var(--gold)', icon: 'alert' }

          : { bar: 'var(--accent2)', icon: 'sparkles' };

        return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">

          <div style="color:${colors.bar};flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;">${iconSvg(colors.icon, 14)}</div>

          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);">${t.message}</div>

        </div>`;

      }).join('');

      tipsSlot.innerHTML = `

        <div class="card" style="padding:10px;margin-top:8px;">

          <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent2);margin-bottom:6px;">SPLIT ANALYSIS — ${tips.length} note${tips.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>

          ${items}

        </div>`;

    }

  }

  // Saved splits library — list of presets with Activate / Delete.

  const libSlot = document.getElementById('saved-splits-slot');

  if (libSlot) {

    const list = state.savedSplits || [];

    if (list.length === 0) {

      libSlot.innerHTML = `

        <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:12px;">SAVED SPLIT PRESETS</div>

        <div class="card" style="padding:12px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);">No presets saved yet. Tap "Save current as preset…" above to start your library.</div>`;

    } else {

      // Active match — highlight the preset whose days match the current workoutSplit

      const sameDays = (a, b) => days.every(d => (a[d] || 'Rest') === (b[d] || 'Rest'));

      const rows = list.map(sp => {

        const isActive = sameDays(sp.days, state.workoutSplit);

        const summary = days.map(d => sp.days[d] || 'Rest').map(v => {

          const short = { 'Upper Push': 'Push', 'Upper Pull': 'Pull', 'Lower Body': 'Legs', 'Full Body': 'Full', 'Flexibility / Cardio': 'Cardio', 'Rest': '·' }[v] || v;

          return `<span style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;font-size:10px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:3px;color:${v === 'Rest' ? 'var(--text3)' : 'var(--accent2)'};">${short}</span>`;

        }).join(' ');

        return `<div class="card" style="padding:10px;margin-bottom:6px;${isActive ? 'border-color:var(--green2);' : ''}">

          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">

            <div>

              <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">${sp.name}${isActive ? ' <span style="color:var(--green2);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;">· ACTIVE</span>' : ''}</div>

              <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">${sp.source === 'recommended' ? 'From recommender' : 'Manual'} · saved ${new Date(sp.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</div>

            </div>

            <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0;">

              ${!isActive ? `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="activateSavedSplit('${sp.id}')" style="font-size:10px;">Activate</button>` : ''}

              <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="deleteSavedSplit('${sp.id}')" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--red2);" title="Delete preset">×</button>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;">${summary}</div>

        </div>`;

      }).join('');

      libSlot.innerHTML = `<div class="section-label" style="margin-top:12px;">SAVED SPLIT PRESETS — ${list.length}</div>${rows}`;

    }

  }

  // Concept tooltips on macros — protein gets a help icon (most common confusion),

  // and the TDEE / Deficit/Surplus line below gets help icons on the technical terms.

  const balanceLabel = p.goalType === 'cut' ? 'Deficit' : p.goalType === 'bulk' ? 'Surplus' : p.goalType === 'recomp' ? 'Recomp' : 'Maintenance';

  const balanceKey = p.goalType === 'cut' ? 'deficit' : p.goalType === 'bulk' ? 'surplus' : null;

  document.getElementById('profile-macro-display').innerHTML = `

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;text-align:center;">

      <div><div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);">${state.macros.calories}</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">kcal</div></div>

      <div><div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--red2);">${state.macros.protein}g</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">protein${conceptHelpButton('protein_target', 'Protein Target')}</div></div>

      <div><div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent2);">${state.macros.carbs}g</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">carbs</div></div>

      <div><div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);">${state.macros.fat}g</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">fat</div></div>

    </div>

    ${state.tdee ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:8px;text-align:center;">TDEE${conceptHelpButton('tdee', 'TDEE')}: ${state.tdee.toLocaleString()} kcal · ${balanceLabel}${balanceKey ? conceptHelpButton(balanceKey, balanceLabel) : ''}: ${Math.abs(state.tdee - state.macros.calories)} kcal</div>` : ''}

  `;

  // Sync status

  const syncEl = document.getElementById('sync-status');

  if (syncEl) {

    const last = state.settings?.lastSync ? new Date(state.settings.lastSync).toLocaleString() : 'never';

    syncEl.textContent = `Last local save: ${last}`;

  }

  // Initialize setting toggles from state.

  // Most toggles default to ON (so missing keys read as enabled). Vacation mode is the

  // exception — it MUST default OFF so a stale localStorage doesn't trap the user with

  // bodyweight quests on day one.

  ['adaptive-toggle-main','penalty-toggle','notify-toggle','mealprep-toggle'].forEach((id, i) => {

    const keys = ['adaptiveMacros','penaltyMode','notify','mealPrepEnabled'];

    const el = document.getElementById(id);

    if (el) {

      const v = state.settings?.[keys[i]] !== false;

      el.classList.toggle('on', v);

    }

  });

  const vacEl = document.getElementById('vacation-toggle');

  if (vacEl) vacEl.classList.toggle('on', state.settings?.vacationMode === true);

  // Sync the vacation-mode select to current state (3-state: off / travel / rest)

  const vacSel = document.getElementById('vacation-select');

  if (vacSel) {

    if (!state.settings?.vacationMode) vacSel.value = 'off';

    else vacSel.value = state.settings.vacationVariant || 'travel';

  }

  // Beginner-mode toggle defaults to OFF (false) unless explicitly set true via beginner onboarding.

  const begEl = document.getElementById('beginner-mode-toggle');

  if (begEl) begEl.classList.toggle('on', state.settings?.beginnerMode === true);

  // Plain-mode toggle (themed↔plain labels)

  const plainEl = document.getElementById('plain-mode-toggle');
