  if (plainEl) plainEl.classList.toggle('on', state.settings?.plainMode === true);

  // Beginner-only learning content. The wrappers themselves are CSS-gated (.beginner-only),

  // so we always render — visibility is purely a display:none toggle on the parent.

  try { renderCoachTips(); } catch(e) { console.warn('coach tips render failed', e); }

  try { renderGraduationPrompt(); } catch(e) { console.warn('graduation prompt render failed', e); }

  // Cloud account card — shows different states based on Supabase config + sign-in status

  try { renderCloudAccountCard(); } catch(e) { console.warn('cloud account render failed', e); }

  try { ensureCloudAccountRefreshTimer(); } catch(e) {}

  // Reminder alerts panel — meal times list + water interval. Shows the current

  // notification permission so the user knows whether toggles will use the OS

  // channel or fall back to in-app toast.

  const remSlot = document.getElementById('reminder-settings');

  if (remSlot) {

    const meal = state.settings?.mealReminders || { enabled: false, times: [] };

    const water = state.settings?.waterReminders || { enabled: false, intervalMinutes: 120 };

    const permLabel = (() => {

      if (!('Notification' in window)) return 'unsupported in this browser';

      if (Notification.permission === 'granted') return '<span style="color:var(--green2);">granted</span>';

      if (Notification.permission === 'denied') return '<span style="color:var(--red2);">blocked — using in-app toast only</span>';

      return '<span style="color:var(--text3);">not yet asked — in-app toast only</span>';

    })();

    const timeChips = (meal.times || []).map((t, i) =>

      `<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 8px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;">

        ${t}

        <button onclick="removeMealReminderTime(${i})" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;padding:0;line-height:1;" title="Remove">×</button>

      </span>`

    ).join(' ');

    remSlot.innerHTML = `

      <div style="padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;">

        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);">Browser permission: ${permLabel}</div>

        <div>

          <div class="toggle-wrap" style="margin-bottom:6px;">

            <div class="toggle ${meal.enabled ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="toggleMealReminders()"></div>

            <div class="toggle-label">Meal reminders</div>

          </div>

          <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:6px;">Fires at each saved time. Defaults to 8:00 / 12:30 / 18:30.</div>

          <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;">

            ${timeChips || '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">No times scheduled.</span>'}

            <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="addMealReminderTime()" style="font-size:10px;">+ Add time</button>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div>

          <div class="toggle-wrap" style="margin-bottom:6px;">

            <div class="toggle ${water.enabled ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="toggleWaterReminders()"></div>

            <div class="toggle-label">Water reminders</div>

          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">

            Every

            <input type="number" min="15" max="240" step="15" value="${water.intervalMinutes || 120}" oninput="setWaterInterval(this.value)" style="width:60px;padding:4px 6px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:12px;">

            minutes while active

          </div>

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">

          <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="testReminderNotification()" style="font-size:11px;">Test notification</button>

        </div>

      </div>`;

  }

}

// ===== AI QUEST =====

async function generateAIQuest() {

  if (!state.profile) return;

  const indicator = document.getElementById('ai-loading-indicator');

  const content = document.getElementById('ai-quest-content');

  if (!indicator || !content) return;

  indicator.style.display = 'flex'; content.style.display = 'none';

  const focus = document.getElementById('gen-focus')?.value || '';

  const difficulty = document.getElementById('gen-difficulty')?.value || '';

  const todayWorkout = state.workoutSplit[dayOfWeek()] || 'Rest';

  const goals = state.goals.map(g => `${g.name} (${g.progress||0}% complete, current: ${g.current}, target: ${g.target})`).join('; ');

  const prompt = `You are the ARISE System from Solo Leveling, a powerful fitness AI. Generate a brutally specific daily challenge quest for this hunter.

Hunter Profile:

- Name: ${state.profile.name}

- Weight: ${state.profile.weight} lbs, Body Fat: ${state.profile.bf}%

- Today's scheduled workout: ${todayWorkout}

- Active goals: ${goals || 'General fitness'}

- XP rank: ${state.rank}, Streak: ${state.streak} days

- Difficulty override: ${difficulty || 'adaptive'}

- Focus: ${focus || 'auto based on goals'}

Output a JSON object with these EXACT fields (no other text):

{

  "questName": "short dramatic name",

  "description": "2-3 sentence specific challenge with exact numbers, sets, reps, distances, times",

  "xpReward": number between 80-200,

  "systemMessage": "one sentence in the dramatic voice of the Solo Leveling system narrator",

  "type": "strength|cardio|challenge|nutrition|habit"

}`;

  try {

    const res = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {

      method: 'POST',

      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

      body: JSON.stringify({

        model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens: 400,

        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]

      })

    });

    const data = await res.json();

    const text = data.content?.map(c => c.text || '').join('') || '';

    const clean = text.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim();

    const quest = JSON.parse(clean);

    state.aiQuestGenerated = true;

    state.questsDate = todayStr();

    indicator.style.display = 'none';

    content.style.display = 'block';

    content.innerHTML = `

      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:6px;">${quest.questName} <span style="font-size:13px;color:var(--gold);">+${quest.xpReward} XP</span></div>

      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px;">${quest.description}</div>

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--accent2);font-style:italic;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding-left:8px;">"${quest.systemMessage}"</div>

      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-gold btn-with-icon" style="margin-top:10px;" onclick="acceptAIQuest(${JSON.stringify(quest).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')})">${iconSvg('zap', 14)}Accept Quest</button>

    `;

    save();

  } catch(e) {

    // Offline / CORS fallback — pull from today's split rather than a hardcoded push+pull session

    indicator.style.display = 'none';

    content.style.display = 'block';

    const fb = splitFallbackQuest(todayWorkout);

    content.innerHTML = `

      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:6px;">${fb.questName} <span style="font-size:13px;color:var(--gold);">+${fb.xpReward} XP</span></div>

      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px;">${fb.description}</div>

      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--accent2);font-style:italic;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding-left:8px;">"${fb.systemMessage}"</div>

      <button class="btn btn-sm btn-gold btn-with-icon" style="margin-top:10px;" onclick="acceptAIQuest(${JSON.stringify(fb).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')})">${iconSvg('zap', 14)}Accept Quest</button>

    `;

  }

}

// Split-aware offline fallback. Picks 3 exercises from today's pool and frames a quest.

function splitFallbackQuest(split) {

  const pool = poolForSplit(split);

  if (split === 'Rest') {

    return {

      questName: 'Rest Day Discipline',

      description: 'Rest is the move today. Hydrate to bodyweight × 0.6 oz, get 8h of sleep, and 10 minutes of mobility before bed. No lifts.',

      systemMessage: 'The strong recover with as much intent as they train.',

      xpReward: 60, type: 'habit'

    };

  }

  if (split === 'Flexibility / Cardio') {

    return {

      questName: 'Recovery Engine',

      description: '20 min Zone 2 cardio of your choice, then 10 min full-body mobility (focus shoulders, hips, ankles). Log distance + how you feel.',

      systemMessage: 'A still hunter sharpens slow.',

      xpReward: 90, type: 'cardio'

    };

  }

  // Resistance days: pick 3 from the pool deterministically by date so the same day = same fallback

  const seedDate = new Date(); const seed = seedDate.getDate() + seedDate.getMonth();

  const picks = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(3, pool.length); i++) {

    picks.push(pool[(seed + i * 3) % pool.length]);

  }

  const desc = picks.map((ex, i) => {

    const sets = i === 0 ? '4×8' : i === 1 ? '3×10' : '3×12';

    return `${ex} ${sets}`;

  }).join(', ');

  const labelMap = { 'Upper Push': 'pressing', 'Upper Pull': 'pulling', 'Lower Body': 'lower body', 'Full Body': 'compound' };

  const focus = labelMap[split] || split.toLowerCase();

  return {

    questName: `${split} Onslaught`,

    description: `${desc}. Progressive overload — beat last session by a rep or 5 lb where you can.`,

    systemMessage: `Today the system demands ${focus} dominance.`,

    xpReward: 100, type: 'strength'

  };

}

function acceptAIQuest(quest) {

  state.quests.push({ id: Date.now(), name: quest.questName, desc: quest.description, icon: 'zap', type: quest.type, xp: quest.xpReward, done: false, date: todayStr() });

  save(); renderQuests(); closeModal('modal-generate'); showNotif('Quest added to today\'s list!');

}

async function generateQuests() {

  closeModal('modal-generate');

  await generateAIQuest();

}

function handleSplitUpload(input) { showNotif('Split file noted — paste details below'); }

function handlePrepUpload(input) { showNotif('Use the + button to enter prep details manually'); }

// ===== EXPORT / IMPORT =====

function exportData() {

  const logs = state.logs.map(l => `${l.date},${l.weight||''},${l.bf||''},${l.waist||''},${l.sleep||''},${(l.notes||'').replace(/,/g,' ')}`);

  const csv = 'date,weight,body_fat_pct,waist_in,hours_sleep,notes\n' + logs.join('\n');

  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });

  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  a.download = `arise_tracker_${todayStr()}.csv`; a.click();

  showNotif('CSV exported!');

}

function exportJSON() {

  const json = JSON.stringify(state, null, 2);

  const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });

  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  a.download = `arise_backup_${todayStr()}.json`; a.click();

  showNotif('Full backup exported!');

}

function importData(input) {

  const file = input.files[0];

  if (!file) return;

  const reader = new FileReader();

  reader.onload = e => {

    try {

      if (file.name.endsWith('.json')) {

        const imported = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

        state = { ...state, ...imported };

        save(); initApp(); showNotif('Data imported!');

      } else {

        // CSV import - parse logs

        const lines = e.target.result.split('\n').slice(1);

        lines.forEach(line => {

          const parts = line.split(',');

          if (parts[0]) {

            state.logs.push({ date: parts[0], weight: parseFloat(parts[1])||null, bf: parseFloat(parts[2])||null, waist: parseFloat(parts[3])||null, sleep: parseFloat(parts[4])||null, notes: parts[5]||'' });

          }

        });

        save(); renderStats(); showNotif('CSV data imported!');

      }

    } catch(err) { showNotif('Import error — check file format', 'var(--red2)'); }

  };

  reader.readAsText(file);

}

function resetAll() {

  localStorage.removeItem('arise_state');

  location.reload();

}

// ===== RESET ALL DATA — TWO-STAGE CONFIRMATION =====

// Click flow: Settings button -> openResetConfirmModal() -> user types RESET ->

// updateResetConfirmState() enables the destructive button -> confirmResetAll()

// wipes localStorage and reloads. Boot logic shows ob0 path-picker when state is

// empty, so the user lands back at onboarding without us doing anything special.

function openResetConfirmModal() {

  const input = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-input');

  const btn = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-btn');

  const hint = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-hint');

  if (input) input.value = '';

  if (btn) {

    btn.disabled = true;

    btn.style.opacity = '0.5';

    btn.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';

  }

  if (hint) {

    hint.textContent = 'Confirm phrase must match exactly.';

    hint.style.color = 'var(--text3)';

  }

  openModal('modal-reset-all');

  // Focus the input shortly after open animation

  setTimeout(() => { if (input) input.focus(); }, 80);

}

function updateResetConfirmState() {

  const input = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-input');

  const btn = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-btn');

  const hint = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-hint');

  if (!input || !btn) return;

  const matches = input.value.trim().toUpperCase() === 'RESET';

  btn.disabled = !matches;

  btn.style.opacity = matches ? '1' : '0.5';

  btn.style.cursor = matches ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';

  if (hint) {

    if (matches) {

      hint.textContent = 'Ready. Click Delete Everything to proceed.';

      hint.style.color = 'var(--red2)';

    } else if (input.value.length > 0) {

      hint.textContent = 'Doesn\'t match — type RESET in capital letters.';

      hint.style.color = 'var(--text3)';

    } else {

      hint.textContent = 'Confirm phrase must match exactly.';

      hint.style.color = 'var(--text3)';

    }

  }

}

function confirmResetAll() {

  const input = document.getElementById('reset-confirm-input');

  if (!input || input.value.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'RESET') return;

  // Wipe known persistence keys (defensive — covers both current key and any legacy variants)

  try { localStorage.removeItem('arise_state'); } catch(e) {}

  try { localStorage.removeItem('arise_avatar'); } catch(e) {}

  // Force a full reload — boot logic will see no saved state and route to ob0.

  location.reload();

}

// ===== ADAPTIVE MILESTONES + GOAL FEASIBILITY =====

// Parse a goal value string into { value, unit, format }.

// Handles: "9:30" (pace), "135 lbs", "25 kg", "8 reps", "5K", "3.1 miles", "45 min", "18%", bare numbers.

function parseGoalValue(str) {

  const s = String(str || '').trim();

  if (!s) return null;

  // Pace format MM:SS (optionally with /mi or /km suffix)

  const pace = s.match(/^(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})/);

  if (pace) return { value: parseInt(pace[1]) * 60 + parseInt(pace[2]), unit: '', format: 'pace', raw: s };

  // 5K / 10K distance shorthand

  const kmShort = s.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*k\b/i);

  if (kmShort) return { value: parseFloat(kmShort[1]), unit: 'km', format: 'distance', raw: s };

  // Combo carry format: "80lbs for 10m" / "195lbs for 50m"

  // Primary metric is the weight; secondary distance is stashed for later use.

  const carry = s.match(/^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(lbs?|kg|pounds?)\s*(?:for|over|@)?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(m|meters?|ft|yards?|yd)?/i);

  if (carry) {

    const wUnit = /kg|kilo/i.test(carry[2]) ? 'kg' : 'lbs';

    return { value: parseFloat(carry[1]), unit: wUnit, format: 'loaded_carry', distance: parseFloat(carry[3]), distanceUnit: (carry[4] || 'm').toLowerCase(), raw: s };

  }

  // Leading number with optional unit text

  const m = s.match(/^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(.*)$/);

  if (!m) return null;

  const val = parseFloat(m[1]);

  const rest = m[2].toLowerCase().trim();

  if (/%|percent/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: '%', format: 'percent', raw: s };

  if (/lbs?|pound/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: 'lbs', format: 'weight', raw: s };

  if (/kgs?|kilogram/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: 'kg', format: 'weight', raw: s };

  if (/reps?|^x$/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: 'reps', format: 'reps', raw: s };

  if (/miles?|^mi$/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: 'mi', format: 'distance', raw: s };

  if (/kilometers?|^km$/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: 'km', format: 'distance', raw: s };

  // Duration: seconds, minutes, hours — normalize everything to seconds internally.

  if (/^secs?$|seconds?/.test(rest)) return { value: val, unit: 's', format: 'duration', raw: s };

  if (/minutes?|^mins?$/.test(rest)) return { value: val * 60, unit: 's', format: 'duration', displayUnit: 'min', raw: s };

  if (/^hrs?$|hours?/.test(rest)) return { value: val * 3600, unit: 's', format: 'duration', displayUnit: 'hr', raw: s };

  return { value: val, unit: rest || '', format: 'plain', raw: s };

}

// Infer the kind of goal so we can generate correctly-unitized milestones.

function detectGoalKind(goal, curParsed, tgtParsed) {

  const name = (goal.name || '').toLowerCase();

  const valHint = (goal.current || '') + ' ' + (goal.target || '');

  const p = curParsed || tgtParsed;

  // Loaded carry (e.g. farmers carry) keeps its own kind.

  if (p && p.format === 'loaded_carry') return 'loaded_carry';

  // Isometric holds / hangs / planks — force duration even if target was written as "1 minute"

  // without a duration-flavored current (e.g. "18 seconds" / "1 minutes" combo).

  if (/\bhang\b|\bhold\b|\bplank\b|dead\s*hang|wall\s*sit/.test(name)) return 'duration';

  if (p && p.format === 'pace') return 'pace';

  if (p && p.format === 'percent') return 'bodyfat';

  if (p && p.format === 'distance') return 'distance';

  if (p && p.format === 'duration') return 'duration';

  if (p && p.format === 'reps') return 'reps';

  // Bodyweight exercises — rep-based by default

  const isBodyweightEx = /pull.?up|chin.?up|push.?up|sit.?up|dip\b|burpee|muscle.?up|squat\s*jump|jumping\s*jack/.test(name);

  const hasWeightUnit = /lbs?|kg|pound|kilo/.test(valHint.toLowerCase());

  if (isBodyweightEx && !hasWeightUnit) return 'reps';

  // If both sides parsed to bare numbers and the name sounds rep-countable, treat as reps.

  const bothPlain = curParsed && tgtParsed && curParsed.format === 'plain' && tgtParsed.format === 'plain';

  if (bothPlain && isBodyweightEx) return 'reps';

  if (goal.cat === 'strength') {

    // Strength but no weight unit and a small integer target usually means reps.

    if (!hasWeightUnit && isBodyweightEx) return 'reps';

    return 'weightlift';

  }

  if (goal.cat === 'body') {

    if (/body.?fat|\bbf\b|\b%/.test(name + ' ' + valHint.toLowerCase())) return 'bodyfat';

    return 'bodyweight';

  }

  if (goal.cat === 'endurance') {

    if (/\brun|\bjog|\bmile|marathon|sprint/.test(name)) return 'pace';

    return 'duration';

  }

  return 'numeric';

}

// Snap a lift target to a standard bar-plus-plates weight.

// Olympic bar = 45 lb. Pairs of plates add 2×plate. We snap to the nearest 5 lb

// total (a pair of 2.5 plates), which matches how most lifters progress.

function snapToPlate(lbs) {

  if (!isFinite(lbs)) return lbs;

  if (lbs < 45) return 45;

  return Math.round(lbs / 5) * 5;

}

function formatMilestoneValue(val, kind, unit) {

  switch (kind) {

    case 'pace': {

      const v = Math.max(0, Math.round(val));

      const mm = Math.floor(v / 60);

      const ss = v % 60;

      return `${mm}:${String(ss).padStart(2, '0')}/mi`;

    }

    case 'reps': return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(val))} reps`;

    case 'weightlift': return `${snapToPlate(val)} ${unit || 'lbs'}`;

    case 'bodyweight': return `${val.toFixed(1)} ${unit || 'lbs'}`;

    case 'bodyfat': return `${val.toFixed(1)}%`;

    case 'distance': return `${(+val.toFixed(2))} ${unit || 'mi'}`;

    case 'duration': {

      // val is always in seconds. Pick the best display unit.

      const v = Math.max(0, Math.round(val));

      if (v < 90) return `${v} sec`;

      if (v < 3600) {

        const mm = Math.floor(v / 60);

        const ss = v % 60;

        return ss === 0 ? `${mm} min` : `${mm}:${String(ss).padStart(2, '0')} min`;

      }

      return `${(v / 3600).toFixed(1)} hr`;

    }

    default: return `${+val.toFixed(2)}${unit ? ' ' + unit : ''}`;

  }

}

function exerciseShortName(name) {

  // Strip "max", "1RM", "test", etc. for a cleaner milestone sentence

  return String(name || 'goal').replace(/\b(max|maximum|1\s?rm|goal|test|target|pr)\b/gi, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || 'goal';

}

// Schema version — bump this when the milestone format changes so stale auto milestones

// get regenerated on next render instead of silently persisting.

const MILESTONE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3;

// Generate sensible unit-aware milestones from a goal's current/target/date window.

function generateMilestonesForGoal(goal) {

  if (!goal || !goal.date) return [];

  const daysOut = Math.max(7, Math.round((new Date(goal.date) - new Date()) / 86400000));

  const weeksOut = Math.max(1, Math.round(daysOut / 7));

  const out = [];

  const cur = parseGoalValue(goal.current);

  const tgt = parseGoalValue(goal.target);

  const kind = detectGoalKind(goal, cur, tgt);

  const unit = (tgt && tgt.unit) || (cur && cur.unit) || '';

  const checkpoints = Math.min(5, Math.max(3, Math.floor(weeksOut / 3)));

  // Loaded carry is a two-dimensional goal — both weight and distance scale together.

  if (kind === 'loaded_carry' && cur && tgt) {

    const wDelta = tgt.value - cur.value;

    const dDelta = (tgt.distance || 0) - (cur.distance || 0);

    const dUnit = tgt.distanceUnit || cur.distanceUnit || 'm';

    const ex = exerciseShortName(goal.name);

    for (let i = 1; i <= checkpoints; i++) {

      const pctAlong = i / checkpoints;

      const w = snapToPlate(cur.value + wDelta * pctAlong);

      const d = Math.round(((cur.distance || 0) + dDelta * pctAlong) * 10) / 10;

      const daysAt = Math.round(daysOut * pctAlong);

      const dateAt = new Date(Date.now() + daysAt * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

      const text = `Carry ${w} ${unit || 'lbs'} for ${d}${dUnit} on ${ex} by ${dateAt}`;

      out.push({ text, done: false, target: w, unit, kind, date: dateAt, auto: true, schemaVersion: MILESTONE_SCHEMA_VERSION });

    }

    return out;

  }

  if (cur && tgt) {

    const totalDelta = tgt.value - cur.value;

    for (let i = 1; i <= checkpoints; i++) {

      const pctAlong = i / checkpoints;

      let interim = cur.value + totalDelta * pctAlong;

      // Plate-snap intermediate lifts so we don't ask for 137.5 lbs

      if (kind === 'weightlift') interim = snapToPlate(interim);

      const daysAt = Math.round(daysOut * pctAlong);

      const dateAt = new Date(Date.now() + daysAt * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

      const valStr = formatMilestoneValue(interim, kind, unit);

      const ex = exerciseShortName(goal.name);

      let text;

      switch (kind) {

        case 'pace':       text = `Run a ${valStr} pace by ${dateAt}`; break;

        case 'reps':       text = `Hit ${valStr} on ${ex} by ${dateAt}`; break;

        case 'weightlift': text = `Lift ${valStr} on ${ex} by ${dateAt}`; break;

        case 'bodyweight': text = `Reach ${valStr} body weight by ${dateAt}`; break;

        case 'bodyfat':    text = `Reach ${valStr} body fat by ${dateAt}`; break;

        case 'distance':   text = `Cover ${valStr} by ${dateAt}`; break;

        case 'duration':   text = `Hold ${valStr} on ${ex} by ${dateAt}`; break;

        default:           text = `Checkpoint: ${valStr} by ${dateAt}`;

      }

      out.push({ text, done: false, target: interim, unit, kind, date: dateAt, auto: true, schemaVersion: MILESTONE_SCHEMA_VERSION });

    }

  } else {

    // No numeric parse — seed with habit-style checkpoints

    const fracs = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];

    fracs.forEach(f => {

      const daysAt = Math.round(daysOut * f);

      const dateAt = new Date(Date.now() + daysAt * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

      out.push({ text: `${Math.round(f * 100)}% milestone toward "${goal.name}" by ${dateAt}`, done: false, auto: true, date: dateAt, schemaVersion: MILESTONE_SCHEMA_VERSION });

    });

  }

  return out;

}

// Replace any stale auto-generated milestones on a goal. Keeps user-added

// (non-auto) milestones plus any auto milestones that have already been completed

// (history). Returns true if anything changed.

function refreshAutoMilestones(goal) {

  if (!goal) return false;

  const kept = (goal.milestones || []).filter(m => !m.auto || m.done);

  const fresh = generateMilestonesForGoal(goal);

  goal.milestones = kept.concat(fresh);

  return true;

}

// Assess whether a goal's pace is realistic. Returns { level: 'ok'|'warn'|'danger', message }

function checkGoalFeasibility(goal) {

  if (!goal.date) return { level: 'ok', message: '' };

  const daysOut = Math.max(1, Math.round((new Date(goal.date) - new Date()) / 86400000));

  const weeksOut = daysOut / 7;

  const parseNum = s => { const m = String(s||'').match(/[\d.]+/); return m ? parseFloat(m[0]) : null; };

  const cur = parseNum(goal.current);

  const tgt = parseNum(goal.target);

  if (cur === null || tgt === null) return { level: 'ok', message: '' };

  const delta = Math.abs(tgt - cur);

  if (goal.cat === 'body') {

    // Body fat or weight. Assume lbs for weight goals >25, body fat % for others.

    const isBfPct = cur < 40 && tgt < 40 && (goal.name||'').toLowerCase().includes('fat');

    if (isBfPct) {

      const perMonth = (delta / weeksOut) * 4;

      if (perMonth > 2) return { level: 'danger', message: `Target pace: ~${perMonth.toFixed(1)}% body fat/month. Safe sustainable loss is ≤1%/month. Consider extending the deadline by ${Math.ceil((delta/1) * 4 - daysOut/7)} weeks or relaxing the target.` };

      if (perMonth > 1) return { level: 'warn', message: `Target pace: ~${perMonth.toFixed(1)}% body fat/month. Aggressive but possible with strict adherence.` };

    } else {

      const lbsPerWeek = delta / weeksOut;

      if (lbsPerWeek > 1.5) return { level: 'danger', message: `Target pace: ~${lbsPerWeek.toFixed(2)} lbs/week. That's dangerously fast — expect muscle loss and rebound. Aim for ≤1 lb/week.` };

      if (lbsPerWeek > 1.0) return { level: 'warn', message: `Target pace: ~${lbsPerWeek.toFixed(2)} lbs/week. On the aggressive end. Sustainable target is 0.5–0.75 lbs/week.` };

    }

  }

  if (goal.cat === 'strength') {

    const pctGain = (delta / cur) * 100;

    const monthsOut = daysOut / 30;

    const pctPerMonth = pctGain / monthsOut;

    if (pctPerMonth > 10) return { level: 'danger', message: `Target: +${pctPerMonth.toFixed(1)}% strength/month. Beyond beginner gains — realistic is 2-5%/month for intermediates.` };

    if (pctPerMonth > 5) return { level: 'warn', message: `Aggressive strength pace. Make sure progressive overload + recovery are on point.` };

  }

  return { level: 'ok', message: '' };

}

function refreshGoalFeasibility() {

  state.goals.forEach(g => { g.feasibility = checkGoalFeasibility(g); });

}

// Called when weigh-in is logged — adapts body-composition milestones

function adaptMilestonesFromLog(log) {

  if (!log || !log.weight) return;

  state.goals.forEach(g => {

    if (g.cat !== 'body' || !g.milestones) return;

    // Re-evaluate feasibility

    g.feasibility = checkGoalFeasibility(g);

    // If user is falling behind pace on auto milestones, inject a "recovery" note

    const today = new Date();

    const overdue = g.milestones.filter(m => m.auto && !m.done && m.date && new Date(m.date) < today);

    if (overdue.length && !g.milestones.some(m => m.recovery)) {

      g.milestones.push({ text: `Behind pace — regroup week: nail 100% quest completion + daily weigh-in`, done: false, auto: true, recovery: true });

    }

  });

}

// ===== SVG AVATAR — LAYERED PRESET SYSTEM (v2 — toy stylization) =====

// Heroic-chibi proportions inspired by collectible figure art: oversized

// expressive head, chunky limbs, layered shading via gradients, detailed

// accessories (belt buckle, gloves, boots with treads). Layers stack

// back-to-front:

//   1. Body silhouette + boots (body type + skin tone + gradient shading)

//   2. Face features (face shape, big toy eyes, brows, nose shadow, mouth)

//   3. Hair (style + color, layered volume + highlight streak)

//   4. Base outfit (casual/athletic/professional/hunter, multi-panel + belt)

//   5. Accessories (glasses, accent)

//   6. Module overlay (gear/markers tied to active progression module)

//   7. Rank effects (aura/particles intensifying with state.rank)

// Layers 1-5 are pure user identity. Layers 6-7 are module-driven so a future

// learning/mental module can swap in different gear and rank flavor without

// touching the avatar's identity layers.

// Lighten/darken a hex color by pct (-100..100). Used to derive consistent

// highlight + shadow shades from each base color.

function _shiftColor(hex, pct) {

  if (!hex || hex[0] !== '#') return hex;

  const num = parseInt(hex.replace('#',''), 16);

  let r = (num >> 16) & 0xff, g = (num >> 8) & 0xff, b = num & 0xff;

  const adj = (v) => {

    if (pct >= 0) return Math.round(v + (pct/100) * (255 - v));

    return Math.round(v + (pct/100) * v);

  };

  r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, adj(r)));

  g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, adj(g)));

  b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, adj(b)));

  return '#' + ((r<<16)|(g<<8)|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0');

}

// --- Outfits: torso + pants drawn ABOVE the body silhouette. Each outfit has

// a darker side-panel for depth + a brighter top highlight, plus a belt with

// metal buckle to anchor the silhouette. Body metrics scale the outfit.

// Coordinate system uses the v2 layout: shoulders y=100, waist y=180, hip y=200.

function outfitSvg(style, bm) {

  const sw = bm.shoulderW, cw = bm.chestW, ww = bm.waistW, hw = bm.hipW;

  const cx = 100;

  // Belt is shared across all outfits (except where the outfit overrides it)

  const belt = (mainHex, buckleHex) => `

    <rect x="${cx - hw/2 - 1}" y="196" width="${hw + 2}" height="8" fill="${mainHex}" rx="1"/>

    <rect x="${cx - 6}" y="196" width="12" height="8" fill="${buckleHex}" rx="1"/>

    <rect x="${cx - 4.5}" y="197.5" width="9" height="5" fill="none" stroke="${_shiftColor(buckleHex, -30)}" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  `;

  if (style === 'casual') {

    // Hooded vest over t-shirt + relaxed pants — match the toy reference vibe

    const top = '#4a90c9';     // shirt blue

    const topDk = _shiftColor(top, -25);

    const topLt = _shiftColor(top, 18);

    const pant = '#2f3a52';

    const pantDk = _shiftColor(pant, -22);

    return `

      <!-- Shirt body -->

      <path d="M${cx - sw/2},100 L${cx + sw/2},100 Q${cx + cw/2 + 6},135 ${cx + ww/2},${190} L${cx + ww/2},196 L${cx - ww/2},196 Q${cx - cw/2 - 6},135 ${cx - sw/2},100 Z" fill="${top}"/>

      <!-- Right side shadow -->

      <path d="M${cx + sw/2 - 8},100 Q${cx + cw/2},135 ${cx + ww/2 - 4},190 L${cx + ww/2},196 L${cx + ww/2 - 8},196 Q${cx + cw/2 - 8},135 ${cx + sw/2 - 16},100 Z" fill="${topDk}" opacity="0.55"/>

      <!-- Top-of-shoulder highlight -->

      <path d="M${cx - sw/2 + 6},102 Q${cx},116 ${cx + sw/2 - 6},102" stroke="${topLt}" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.85"/>

      <!-- Vest panels (sleeveless layered look) -->

      <path d="M${cx - cw/2 + 4},108 L${cx - 14},108 L${cx - 12},190 L${cx - cw/2 + 8},190 Z" fill="${topDk}"/>

      <path d="M${cx + cw/2 - 4},108 L${cx + 14},108 L${cx + 12},190 L${cx + cw/2 - 8},190 Z" fill="${topDk}"/>

      <!-- Vest collar / V-neck -->

      <path d="M${cx - 12},108 L${cx},124 L${cx + 12},108 L${cx + 8},108 L${cx},118 L${cx - 8},108 Z" fill="${topLt}"/>

      <!-- Pants -->

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw}" height="68" fill="${pant}" rx="2"/>

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw/2}" height="68" fill="${_shiftColor(pant, 12)}" opacity="0.4"/>

      <line x1="${cx}" y1="204" x2="${cx}" y2="266" stroke="${pantDk}" stroke-width="0.8"/>

      <line x1="${cx - hw/2 + 4}" y1="206" x2="${cx - hw/2 + 4}" y2="264" stroke="${_shiftColor(pant, 18)}" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.5"/>

      ${belt('#5a3a22', '#c9a55a')}

    `;

  if (style === 'athletic') {

    // Tank top + athletic shorts

    const top = '#1f2937', topDk = _shiftColor(top, -30), accent = '#4f8eff';

    const short = accent, shortDk = _shiftColor(accent, -25);
