      <!-- Right side shadow -->

      <path d="M${cx + cw/2 - 12},100 Q${cx + cw/2 - 4},140 ${cx + ww/2 - 4},190 L${cx + ww/2},196 L${cx + ww/2 - 8},196 Q${cx + cw/2 - 12},140 ${cx + cw/2 - 18},100 Z" fill="${topDk}" opacity="0.55"/>

      <!-- Chest accent stripe -->

      <path d="M${cx - cw/2 + 12},106 L${cx + cw/2 - 12},106 L${cx + cw/2 - 12},112 L${cx - cw/2 + 12},112 Z" fill="${accent}" opacity="0.85"/>

      <!-- Logo dot -->

      <circle cx="${cx}" cy="124" r="2.5" fill="${accent}" opacity="0.9"/>

      <!-- Shorts -->

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw}" height="38" fill="${short}" rx="2"/>

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw/2}" height="38" fill="${_shiftColor(short, 15)}" opacity="0.5"/>

      <line x1="${cx}" y1="204" x2="${cx}" y2="236" stroke="${shortDk}" stroke-width="1"/>

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2 + 2}" y="234" width="${hw - 4}" height="4" fill="${shortDk}" rx="1"/>

      ${belt('#2a2f3a', '#4f8eff')}

    `;

  }

  if (style === 'professional') {

    // Button-up shirt + necktie + slacks

    const shirt = '#e8e9ec', shirtDk = _shiftColor(shirt, -18);

    const tie = '#a44a2a', tieDk = _shiftColor(tie, -25);

    const pant = '#1f2937', pantDk = _shiftColor(pant, -25);

    return `

      <!-- Shirt body -->

      <path d="M${cx - sw/2 + 2},100 L${cx + sw/2 - 2},100 Q${cx + cw/2 + 2},135 ${cx + ww/2},190 L${cx + ww/2},196 L${cx - ww/2},196 Q${cx - cw/2 - 2},135 ${cx - sw/2 + 2},100 Z" fill="${shirt}"/>

      <!-- Side shadow -->

      <path d="M${cx + sw/2 - 10},100 Q${cx + cw/2 - 2},140 ${cx + ww/2 - 4},190 L${cx + ww/2},196 L${cx + ww/2 - 8},196 Q${cx + cw/2 - 8},140 ${cx + sw/2 - 18},100 Z" fill="${shirtDk}" opacity="0.6"/>

      <!-- Lapel/collar -->

      <path d="M${cx - sw/2 + 2},100 L${cx - cw/2 + 4},120 L${cx - 8},122 L${cx},116 L${cx + 8},122 L${cx + cw/2 - 4},120 L${cx + sw/2 - 2},100 Z" fill="${pant}"/>

      <!-- Tie -->

      <path d="M${cx - 4},120 L${cx + 4},120 L${cx + 6},190 L${cx - 6},190 Z" fill="${tie}"/>

      <path d="M${cx - 2},120 L${cx + 2},120 L${cx + 2},190 L${cx - 2},190 Z" fill="${tieDk}" opacity="0.5"/>

      <path d="M${cx - 4},120 L${cx + 4},120 L${cx + 4},126 L${cx - 4},126 Z" fill="${_shiftColor(tie, 18)}"/>

      <!-- Button line -->

      <circle cx="${cx + cw/2 - 8}" cy="146" r="1.2" fill="${shirtDk}"/>

      <circle cx="${cx + cw/2 - 8}" cy="166" r="1.2" fill="${shirtDk}"/>

      <circle cx="${cx + cw/2 - 8}" cy="186" r="1.2" fill="${shirtDk}"/>

      <!-- Pants -->

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw}" height="68" fill="${pant}" rx="2"/>

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw/2}" height="68" fill="${_shiftColor(pant, 18)}" opacity="0.4"/>

      <line x1="${cx}" y1="204" x2="${cx}" y2="266" stroke="${pantDk}" stroke-width="0.6"/>

      ${belt('#1a1413', '#c0c0c8')}

    `;

  }

  if (style === 'hunter') {

    // Solo Leveling — fitted jacket with mana glow seams + tactical pants

    const main = '#181420', mainDk = '#0a070f', glow = '#4f8eff', accent = '#7c3aed';

    return `

      <!-- Jacket body -->

      <path d="M${cx - sw/2},100 L${cx + sw/2},100 Q${cx + cw/2 + 4},135 ${cx + ww/2 + 2},190 L${cx + ww/2},196 L${cx - ww/2},196 Q${cx - cw/2 - 4},135 ${cx - sw/2},100 Z" fill="${main}"/>

      <!-- Right side shadow -->

      <path d="M${cx + sw/2 - 10},100 Q${cx + cw/2 - 2},140 ${cx + ww/2 - 4},190 L${cx + ww/2 + 2},196 L${cx + ww/2 - 8},196 Q${cx + cw/2 - 8},140 ${cx + sw/2 - 18},100 Z" fill="${mainDk}" opacity="0.7"/>

      <!-- Center seam (mana glow) -->

      <line x1="${cx}" y1="100" x2="${cx}" y2="196" stroke="${glow}" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.85"/>

      <line x1="${cx}" y1="100" x2="${cx}" y2="196" stroke="${glow}" stroke-width="0.4" opacity="1"/>

      <!-- Pectoral chevron -->

      <path d="M${cx - sw/2 + 6},104 Q${cx},122 ${cx + sw/2 - 6},104" stroke="${glow}" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>

      <!-- Diagonal sash -->

      <path d="M${cx - cw/2 + 4},112 L${cx + cw/2 - 8},150 L${cx + cw/2 - 4},156 L${cx - cw/2 + 8},118 Z" fill="${accent}" opacity="0.7"/>

      <!-- Sash highlight -->

      <path d="M${cx - cw/2 + 6},114 L${cx + cw/2 - 10},150" stroke="${_shiftColor(accent, 25)}" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.8"/>

      <!-- Tactical pants -->

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw}" height="68" fill="#0f0d18" rx="2"/>

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2}" y="200" width="${hw/2}" height="68" fill="${main}" opacity="0.6"/>

      <line x1="${cx - hw/3}" y1="206" x2="${cx - hw/3}" y2="264" stroke="${glow}" stroke-width="0.4" opacity="0.5"/>

      <line x1="${cx + hw/3}" y1="206" x2="${cx + hw/3}" y2="264" stroke="${glow}" stroke-width="0.4" opacity="0.5"/>

      <!-- Hunter belt with rune buckle -->

      <rect x="${cx - hw/2 - 1}" y="196" width="${hw + 2}" height="8" fill="#0a070f" rx="1"/>

      <rect x="${cx - 7}" y="195" width="14" height="10" fill="${accent}" rx="1"/>

      <path d="M${cx - 4},198 L${cx + 4},198 L${cx + 4},203 L${cx - 4},203 Z" fill="none" stroke="${glow}" stroke-width="0.8"/>

      <circle cx="${cx}" cy="200" r="1.2" fill="${glow}" opacity="0.95"/>

    `;

  }

  return '';

}

const OUTFIT_META = {

  casual:       { name: 'Casual' },

  athletic:     { name: 'Athletic' },

  professional: { name: 'Professional' },

  hunter:       { name: 'Hunter' },

};

// --- Accessories: glasses, small face accents

const ACCESSORY_META = {

  glasses: {

    none:   { name: 'None' },

    round:  { name: 'Round' },

    square: { name: 'Square' },

  },

  accent: {

    none:     { name: 'None' },

    scar:     { name: 'Scar' },

    freckles: { name: 'Freckles' },

  }

};

// Glasses positioned over the new bigger eyes (centered at y=62, x=88/112).

function glassesSvg(style) {

  if (style === 'round')  return `

    <circle cx="88" cy="62" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <circle cx="112" cy="62" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <line x1="96" y1="62" x2="104" y2="62" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.4"/>

    <ellipse cx="86" cy="60" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.4"/>

    <ellipse cx="110" cy="60" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.4"/>

  `;

  if (style === 'square') return `

    <rect x="80" y="56" width="16" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.8" rx="1.5"/>

    <rect x="104" y="56" width="16" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.8" rx="1.5"/>

    <line x1="96" y1="62" x2="104" y2="62" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1.4"/>

    <rect x="82" y="58" width="4" height="2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.4"/>

    <rect x="106" y="58" width="4" height="2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.4"/>

  `;

  return '';

}

function accentSvg(accent) {

  if (accent === 'scar')     return `<path d="M118,52 L122,66" stroke="#9c5040" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M119.5,55 L121,55" stroke="#7a3a30" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.6"/>`;

  if (accent === 'freckles') return `<circle cx="86" cy="70" r="0.9" fill="#7a4a30" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="90" cy="73" r="0.8" fill="#7a4a30" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="94" cy="71" r="0.7" fill="#7a4a30" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="106" cy="71" r="0.7" fill="#7a4a30" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="110" cy="73" r="0.8" fill="#7a4a30" opacity="0.55"/><circle cx="114" cy="70" r="0.9" fill="#7a4a30" opacity="0.55"/>`;

  return '';

}

// --- Module-driven progression layers (6 + 7) ---

// Each module exposes `gearOverlay(rank)` for layer 6 and `rankEffect(rank)` for layer 7.

// New modules just register here. The fitness module is the only one shipped at v1.

const PROGRESSION_MODULES = {

  fitness: {

    label: 'Fitness',

    gearOverlay: (rank) => {

      // Strength markers (bicep glow C+, chest line A/S). Coords match v2 body

      // (shoulders at y=100, biceps at y=120, chest center at y=130).

      const i = ['E','D','C','B','A','S'].indexOf(rank);

      if (i < 2) return '';

      const op = (0.3 + i * 0.1).toFixed(2);

      const strength = `

        <path d="M62,118 Q56,134 60,148" stroke="#4f8eff" stroke-width="1.1" fill="none" opacity="${op}"/>

        <path d="M138,118 Q144,134 140,148" stroke="#4f8eff" stroke-width="1.1" fill="none" opacity="${op}"/>

      `;

      const chest = i >= 3 ? `<path d="M82,128 Q100,134 118,128" stroke="#4f8eff" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>` : '';

      return strength + chest;

    },

    rankEffect: (rank, ids) => {

      // Aura behind the figure — intensifies with rank. Centered at body midline (cy=170).

      if (rank === 'E' || rank === 'D') return '';

      if (rank === 'C') return `<circle cx="100" cy="170" r="115" fill="none" stroke="#4f8eff" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.2" stroke-dasharray="3,5"/>`;

      if (rank === 'B') return `<circle cx="100" cy="170" r="120" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.32" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/><circle cx="100" cy="170" r="105" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.22"/>`;

      if (rank === 'A') return `<circle cx="100" cy="170" r="125" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.42"/><circle cx="50" cy="120" r="2.5" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.8"/><circle cx="150" cy="140" r="2" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.8"/><circle cx="42" cy="220" r="1.8" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.7"/><circle cx="158" cy="210" r="2.2" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.8"/>`;

      // S — Shadow Monarch flavor (radial gradient + dashed ring + sparks)

      // Use a unique aura ID so multiple S-rank avatars in the DOM don't share a gradient.

      const auraId = (ids && ids.auraId) || 'sAura';

      return `

        <radialGradient id="${auraId}"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7c3aed" stop-opacity="0.32"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7c3aed" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>

        <circle cx="100" cy="170" r="135" fill="url(#${auraId})"/>

        <circle cx="100" cy="170" r="125" fill="none" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.6" opacity="0.65" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>

        <path d="M100,30 L94,16 M100,30 L106,16 M60,80 L50,68 M140,80 L150,68" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

        <circle cx="44" cy="150" r="3" fill="#7c3aed" opacity="0.9"/><circle cx="156" cy="170" r="3" fill="#7c3aed" opacity="0.9"/><circle cx="55" cy="240" r="2.4" fill="#7c3aed" opacity="0.8"/><circle cx="145" cy="230" r="2.4" fill="#7c3aed" opacity="0.8"/>

      `;

    }

  },

  // Future module example (not active at v1) — kept here as a reference for the

  // shape new modules should take. When the learning module ships, gearOverlay

  // could draw open books / multilingual symbols, and rankEffect could be a

  // sage glow with floating glyphs instead of a Hunter aura.

  learning: {

    label: 'Learning',

    gearOverlay: (rank) => '',

    rankEffect: (rank, ids) => '',

  }

};

// --- Compose full avatar SVG from state.avatar + state.rank + active module ---

// v2 layout (heroic-chibi proportions):

//   Head circle: cx=100, cy=58, rx=30, ry=32 (slightly oval)

//   Eyes: cx=88 / cx=112, cy=62 — large toy eyes

//   Mouth: y=78

//   Chin/jaw: y=82-94 morphed by face shape

//   Neck: y=86-100

//   Shoulders: y=100, body-type widths

//   Waist: y=180-190

//   Hip: y=200

//   Pants: y=200-268

//   Boots: y=264-292

//   Floor shadow: y=298

// Counter for unique gradient IDs across multiple avatars in the same DOM

let _avatarGradId = 0;

function composeAvatarSvg(av, rank) {

  const skin = SKIN_TONES[av.skinTone] || SKIN_TONES.tone3;

  const skinLt = _shiftColor(skin.hex, 14);

  const skinDk = skin.shade;

  const skinShdw = _shiftColor(skin.hex, -22);

  // Unique IDs so multiple avatars on the same page don't share gradients

  const gid = `_av${++_avatarGradId}`;

  const skinGradId = `skinGrad${gid}`;

  const ambientId = `ambientGlow${gid}`;

  const sAuraId = `sAura${gid}`;

  const bm = BODY_TYPES[av.bodyType] || BODY_TYPES.average;

  const fs = FACE_SHAPES[av.face?.shape] || FACE_SHAPES.oval;

  const eye = EYE_COLORS[av.face?.eyes] || EYE_COLORS.brown;

  const hairColor = (HAIR_COLORS[av.hair?.color] || HAIR_COLORS.brown).hex;

  const hairColorDk = _shiftColor(hairColor, -35);

  const hairFn = (HAIR_STYLES[av.hair?.style] || HAIR_STYLES.short).svg;

  const mod = PROGRESSION_MODULES[av.module] || PROGRESSION_MODULES.fitness;

  const cx = 100;

  // Floor shadow — anchors the figure on its "ground"

  const floor = `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="298" rx="${Math.max(50, bm.hipW * 0.75)}" ry="6" fill="#000" opacity="0.28"/>`;

  // Layer 1a — Head: oval shape with side shadow + rim light, then jaw overlay

  // for face-shape variation, then neck.

  const headBase = `

    <ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="58" rx="30" ry="32" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <ellipse cx="${cx + 18}" cy="62" rx="14" ry="22" fill="${skinDk}" opacity="0.32"/>

    <ellipse cx="${cx - 12}" cy="48" rx="6" ry="10" fill="${skinLt}" opacity="0.5"/>

  `;

  // Jaw/chin extension morphs by face shape — a small chin shape under the head

  const chinX = fs.jawW / 2;

  const jawDrop = fs.chinY - 80; // how far the jaw pokes below y=80

  const chin = `

    <path d="M${cx - chinX},78

             Q${cx - chinX + 2},${82 + fs.chinCurve * 4} ${cx},${fs.chinY}

             Q${cx + chinX - 2},${82 + fs.chinCurve * 4} ${cx + chinX},78

             L${cx + chinX - 4},86 L${cx - chinX + 4},86 Z" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <path d="M${cx - 4},${fs.chinY - 2} Q${cx},${fs.chinY + 1} ${cx + 4},${fs.chinY - 2}" stroke="${skinShdw}" stroke-width="0.6" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  `;

  // Neck: chunky trapezoid in shadow tone

  const neck = `

    <path d="M${cx - 11},${fs.chinY - 4} L${cx + 11},${fs.chinY - 4} L${cx + 14},100 L${cx - 14},100 Z" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <path d="M${cx - 11},${fs.chinY - 4} L${cx},${fs.chinY - 1} L${cx + 11},${fs.chinY - 4} L${cx + 8},${fs.chinY + 4} L${cx - 8},${fs.chinY + 4} Z" fill="${skinShdw}" opacity="0.7"/>

  `;

  // Layer 1b — Torso silhouette (drawn under outfit, but visible at neckline)

  const torso = `

    <path d="M${cx - bm.shoulderW/2},100

             Q${cx - bm.chestW/2 - 2},135 ${cx - bm.waistW/2},${180}

             Q${cx - bm.waistW/2 - 2},194 ${cx - bm.hipW/2},200

             L${cx + bm.hipW/2},200

             Q${cx + bm.waistW/2 + 2},194 ${cx + bm.waistW/2},${180}

             Q${cx + bm.chestW/2 + 2},135 ${cx + bm.shoulderW/2},100 Z" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

  `;

  // Layer 1c — Arms: shoulder cap + bicep + forearm + fist. The shoulder

  // capsule sits slightly outside shoulderW to give the toy "ball joint" look.

  const armX_L = cx - bm.shoulderW/2;

  const armX_R = cx + bm.shoulderW/2;

  const armR = bm.armW / 2;

  const arms = `

    <!-- Left shoulder cap -->

    <circle cx="${armX_L}" cy="106" r="${armR + 2}" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <circle cx="${armX_L - 1}" cy="105" r="${armR + 0.5}" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <!-- Left upper arm (bicep) -->

    <path d="M${armX_L - armR},108 Q${armX_L - armR - 2},145 ${armX_L - armR + 2},170 L${armX_L + armR},170 Q${armX_L + armR - 1},140 ${armX_L + armR},108 Z" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <ellipse cx="${armX_L - armR + 4}" cy="135" rx="3" ry="14" fill="${skinShdw}" opacity="0.4"/>

    <!-- Left forearm -->

    <path d="M${armX_L - armR + 1},172 L${armX_L + armR - 1},172 L${armX_L + armR + 1},210 L${armX_L - armR - 1},210 Z" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <path d="M${armX_L - armR + 1},172 L${armX_L + armR - 4},172 L${armX_L + armR - 3},210 L${armX_L - armR - 1},210 Z" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <!-- Left fist (mitten/glove) -->

    <circle cx="${armX_L}" cy="218" r="${armR + 3}" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <circle cx="${armX_L - 1.5}" cy="217" r="${armR + 1.5}" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <path d="M${armX_L - armR - 2},220 Q${armX_L},226 ${armX_L + armR + 2},220" stroke="${skinShdw}" stroke-width="0.6" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- Right shoulder cap -->

    <circle cx="${armX_R}" cy="106" r="${armR + 2}" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <circle cx="${armX_R - 1}" cy="105" r="${armR + 0.5}" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <!-- Right upper arm -->

    <path d="M${armX_R - armR},108 Q${armX_R - armR + 1},140 ${armX_R - armR},170 L${armX_R + armR - 2},170 Q${armX_R + armR + 2},145 ${armX_R + armR},108 Z" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <ellipse cx="${armX_R + armR - 4}" cy="135" rx="3" ry="14" fill="${skinShdw}" opacity="0.4"/>

    <!-- Right forearm -->

    <path d="M${armX_R - armR + 1},172 L${armX_R + armR - 1},172 L${armX_R + armR + 1},210 L${armX_R - armR - 1},210 Z" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <path d="M${armX_R - armR + 4},172 L${armX_R + armR - 1},172 L${armX_R + armR + 1},210 L${armX_R - armR + 3},210 Z" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <!-- Right fist -->

    <circle cx="${armX_R}" cy="218" r="${armR + 3}" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <circle cx="${armX_R - 1.5}" cy="217" r="${armR + 1.5}" fill="url(#${skinGradId})"/>

    <path d="M${armX_R - armR - 2},220 Q${armX_R},226 ${armX_R + armR + 2},220" stroke="${skinShdw}" stroke-width="0.6" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  `;

  // Layer 1d — Legs: chunky thighs + boots. Thighs draw under pants;

  // boots are always visible (pants overlay leaves the boot area exposed).

  const legL_X = cx - bm.hipW/2 + bm.legW/2 + 2;

  const legR_X = cx + bm.hipW/2 - bm.legW/2 - 2;

  const legs = `

    <!-- Thigh shadow (drawn under pants) -->

    <rect x="${legL_X - bm.legW/2}" y="200" width="${bm.legW}" height="68" fill="${skinDk}"/>

    <rect x="${legR_X - bm.legW/2}" y="200" width="${bm.legW}" height="68" fill="${skinDk}"/>

  `;

  // Boots — chunky toe + sole + lace highlights. Drawn ABOVE pants and legs.

  const bootW = bm.legW + 6;

  const boot = (centerX) => `

    <!-- Boot upper -->

    <path d="M${centerX - bootW/2 + 1},262 L${centerX + bootW/2 - 1},262 L${centerX + bootW/2 + 1},284 L${centerX - bootW/2 - 1},284 Z" fill="#3a2718"/>

    <!-- Cuff fold -->

    <rect x="${centerX - bootW/2 + 1}" y="262" width="${bootW - 2}" height="5" fill="#5c3f24"/>

    <!-- Toe extension -->

    <path d="M${centerX - bootW/2 - 1},284 L${centerX + bootW/2 + 4},284 L${centerX + bootW/2 + 4},290 L${centerX - bootW/2 - 1},290 Z" fill="#2c1d10"/>

    <!-- Sole -->

    <rect x="${centerX - bootW/2 - 1}" y="290" width="${bootW + 5}" height="4" fill="#1a1108" rx="1"/>

    <!-- Lace lines -->

    <line x1="${centerX - 2}" y1="270" x2="${centerX + 2}" y2="270" stroke="#c9a55a" stroke-width="0.6"/>

    <line x1="${centerX - 2}" y1="275" x2="${centerX + 2}" y2="275" stroke="#c9a55a" stroke-width="0.6"/>

    <!-- Highlight -->

    <rect x="${centerX - bootW/2 + 2}" y="268" width="2" height="14" fill="#7a5634" opacity="0.6"/>

  `;

  const boots = boot(legL_X) + boot(legR_X);

  const layer1Body = headBase + chin + neck + torso + arms + legs;

  // Layer 2 — Face: big toy eyes (sclera + iris + pupil + highlight),

  // thick angled eyebrows in hair color, nose shadow, smirk mouth.

  const eyeY = 62;

  const eyeColorLt = _shiftColor(eye.hex, 35);

  const layer2Face = `

    <!-- Cheek blush (subtle warmth) -->

    <ellipse cx="${cx - 18}" cy="72" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#e88a7a" opacity="0.15"/>

    <ellipse cx="${cx + 18}" cy="72" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#e88a7a" opacity="0.15"/>

    <!-- Eye whites -->

    <ellipse cx="${cx - 12}" cy="${eyeY}" rx="5.5" ry="6" fill="#fff"/>

    <ellipse cx="${cx + 12}" cy="${eyeY}" rx="5.5" ry="6" fill="#fff"/>

    <!-- Iris -->

    <circle cx="${cx - 12}" cy="${eyeY + 1}" r="4" fill="${eye.hex}"/>

    <circle cx="${cx + 12}" cy="${eyeY + 1}" r="4" fill="${eye.hex}"/>

    <!-- Iris inner gradient ring -->

    <circle cx="${cx - 12}" cy="${eyeY + 1}" r="2.8" fill="${eyeColorLt}" opacity="0.55"/>

    <circle cx="${cx + 12}" cy="${eyeY + 1}" r="2.8" fill="${eyeColorLt}" opacity="0.55"/>

    <!-- Pupil -->

    <circle cx="${cx - 12}" cy="${eyeY + 1}" r="1.8" fill="#0d0a14"/>

    <circle cx="${cx + 12}" cy="${eyeY + 1}" r="1.8" fill="#0d0a14"/>

    <!-- Highlight (top-left of pupil) -->

    <ellipse cx="${cx - 13.5}" cy="${eyeY - 1}" rx="1.2" ry="1.6" fill="#fff"/>

    <ellipse cx="${cx + 10.5}" cy="${eyeY - 1}" rx="1.2" ry="1.6" fill="#fff"/>

    <!-- Eye liner (top edge) -->

    <path d="M${cx - 17.5},${eyeY - 4} Q${cx - 12},${eyeY - 6} ${cx - 6.5},${eyeY - 4}" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <path d="M${cx + 6.5},${eyeY - 4} Q${cx + 12},${eyeY - 6} ${cx + 17.5},${eyeY - 4}" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Eyebrows: thick angled rect-paths in hair color (darker shade) -->

    <path d="M${cx - 19},${eyeY - 10} L${cx - 5},${eyeY - 12} L${cx - 5},${eyeY - 9} L${cx - 19},${eyeY - 7} Z" fill="${hairColorDk}"/>

    <path d="M${cx + 5},${eyeY - 12} L${cx + 19},${eyeY - 10} L${cx + 19},${eyeY - 7} L${cx + 5},${eyeY - 9} Z" fill="${hairColorDk}"/>

    <!-- Nose shadow (subtle right-side shading + bottom hint) -->

    <path d="M${cx + 1},${eyeY + 6} Q${cx + 3},${eyeY + 12} ${cx + 1},${eyeY + 16}" stroke="${skinShdw}" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>

    <ellipse cx="${cx + 0.5}" cy="${eyeY + 17}" rx="2.5" ry="1" fill="${skinShdw}" opacity="0.4"/>

    <!-- Mouth: confident smirk -->

    <path d="M${cx - 5},${eyeY + 22} Q${cx},${eyeY + 25} ${cx + 5},${eyeY + 22}" stroke="#5a2818" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Lower lip highlight -->

    <path d="M${cx - 3},${eyeY + 24.5} Q${cx},${eyeY + 25.5} ${cx + 3},${eyeY + 24.5}" stroke="#c87060" stroke-width="0.6" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  `;

  // Layer 3 — Hair (drawn after face)

  const layer3Hair = hairFn(hairColor);

  // Layer 4 — Outfit (drawn over torso/legs but not boots)

  const layer4Outfit = outfitSvg(av.outfitStyle, bm);

  // Layer 5 — Accessories

  const layer5Accessories = glassesSvg(av.accessories?.glasses) + accentSvg(av.accessories?.accent);

  // Layers 6 + 7 — Module-driven

  const layer6Module = mod.gearOverlay(rank);

  const layer7Effect = mod.rankEffect(rank, { auraId: sAuraId });

  return `

    <svg class="avatar-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

      <defs>

        <linearGradient id="${skinGradId}" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">

          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${skinLt}"/>

          <stop offset="55%" stop-color="${skin.hex}"/>

          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${skinDk}"/>

        </linearGradient>

        <radialGradient id="${ambientId}" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">

          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4f8eff" stop-opacity="0.08"/>

          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4f8eff" stop-opacity="0"/>

        </radialGradient>

      </defs>

      <rect width="200" height="320" fill="url(#${ambientId})"/>

      ${layer7Effect /* aura behind body */}

      ${floor}

      ${layer1Body}

      ${layer4Outfit /* outfit over torso, legs, but NOT boots */}

      ${boots /* boots over pants */}

      ${layer3Hair /* hair AFTER outfit so collars don't cover it */}

      ${layer2Face}

      ${layer6Module /* gear/module markers above outfit */}

      ${layer5Accessories /* glasses on top of face */}

    </svg>

  `;

}

// Thin chip helper used in stats row below the avatar

function _avatarChip(html, color) {

  const colorAttr = color ? `style="color:${color};border-color:${color};"` : '';

  return `<div class="avatar-chip" ${colorAttr}>${html}</div>`;

}

// Public render entry — wraps composed SVG in the existing .avatar-wrap with stats row.

function renderAvatar(targetEl, opts = {}) {

  if (!targetEl) return;

  const av = state.avatar || DEFAULT_STATE.avatar;

  const rank = state.rank || 'E';

  const p = state.profile || {};

  const latest = state.logs[state.logs.length - 1] || {};

  const bf = opts.bf ?? latest.bf ?? p.bf ?? null;

  const w = opts.weight ?? latest.weight ?? p.weight ?? null;

  const svg = composeAvatarSvg(av, rank);

  // Stats row chips (preserved from prior version) — body comp + rank

  const rankColor = (typeof RANK_COLORS !== 'undefined' && RANK_COLORS[rank]) || '#4f8eff';

  const rankLabel = (typeof RANK_LABELS !== 'undefined' && RANK_LABELS[rank]) || ('Rank ' + rank);

  const chips = [

    w ? _avatarChip(`<strong>${w}</strong> lbs`) : '',

    bf ? _avatarChip(`<strong>${bf}%</strong> BF`) : '',

    _avatarChip(rankLabel, rankColor),

  ].filter(Boolean).join('');

  targetEl.innerHTML = `

    <div class="avatar-wrap">

      ${svg}

      <div class="avatar-stats-row">${chips}</div>

    </div>

  `;

}

// ===== AVATAR CUSTOMIZER =====

// Holds the in-progress edits while the customizer is open. Committed to

// state.avatar on Save, discarded on Cancel.

let _pendingAvatar = null;

let _customizerActiveCategory = 'body';

const CUSTOMIZER_CATEGORIES = [

  { id: 'body',       label: 'Body' },

  { id: 'skin',       label: 'Skin' },

  { id: 'hair',       label: 'Hair' },

  { id: 'face',       label: 'Face' },

  { id: 'outfit',     label: 'Outfit' },

  { id: 'accessories',label: 'Extras' },

];

// Open the customizer modal. opts: { onboarding: true } adapts copy and forces save.

function openAvatarCustomizer(opts = {}) {

  // Deep clone current avatar into pending so live preview can mutate without

  // touching state until the user explicitly saves.

  _pendingAvatar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.avatar || DEFAULT_STATE.avatar));

  _customizerActiveCategory = 'body';

  // Adapt title/desc when this is part of onboarding (vs. mid-app edit)

  const titleEl = document.getElementById('avatar-customizer-title');

  const descEl = document.getElementById('avatar-customizer-desc');

  const cancelBtn = document.querySelector('#modal-avatar-customizer button[onclick="cancelAvatarCustomization()"]');

  if (opts.onboarding) {

    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Build Your Character';

    if (descEl) descEl.textContent = 'Choose how you want to look. You can change any of this later from your Profile.';

    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.style.display = 'none'; // No backing out during onboarding

  } else {

    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Customize Your Character';

    if (descEl) descEl.textContent = 'Build a character that looks like you. Your appearance is yours — your stats and rank effects evolve as you progress.';

    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.style.display = '';

  }

  renderCustomizerTabs();

  renderCustomizerOptions();

  renderCustomizerPreview();

  openModal('modal-avatar-customizer');

}

function cancelAvatarCustomization() {

  _pendingAvatar = null;

  closeModal('modal-avatar-customizer');

}

function saveAvatarCustomization() {

  if (!_pendingAvatar) { closeModal('modal-avatar-customizer'); return; }

  _pendingAvatar.customized = true;

  state.avatar = _pendingAvatar;

  _pendingAvatar = null;

  save();

  closeModal('modal-avatar-customizer');

  // Re-render any avatar surface that's currently visible

  const profileSlot = document.getElementById('profile-avatar');

  if (profileSlot) renderAvatar(profileSlot);

  showNotif('Character saved!');

}

// Switch which preset category the user is editing

function setCustomizerCategory(cat) {

  _customizerActiveCategory = cat;

  renderCustomizerTabs();

  renderCustomizerOptions();

}

function renderCustomizerTabs() {

  const wrap = document.getElementById('avatar-customizer-tabs');

  if (!wrap) return;

  wrap.innerHTML = CUSTOMIZER_CATEGORIES.map(c => {

    const active = c.id === _customizerActiveCategory;

    return `<button type="button" onclick="setCustomizerCategory('${c.id}')"

      style="flex:1;min-width:64px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border-radius:6px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;

      ${active ? 'background:var(--accent);color:#fff;' : 'background:transparent;color:var(--text2);'}">${c.label.toUpperCase()}</button>`;

  }).join('');

}

function renderCustomizerPreview() {

  const slot = document.getElementById('avatar-customizer-preview');

  if (!slot || !_pendingAvatar) return;

  // Use a smaller version inside the modal so the preset grid below has room

  const svg = composeAvatarSvg(_pendingAvatar, state.rank || 'E')

    .replace('class="avatar-svg"', 'class="avatar-svg-sm"');

  slot.innerHTML = svg;

}

// Render the option grid for the active category. Each option is a clickable

// tile. Selected tile gets an accent ring. For color-only categories (skin tone,

// hair color, eye color) we show colored swatches; for shape categories we show

// labeled tiles.

function renderCustomizerOptions() {

  const out = document.getElementById('avatar-customizer-options');

  if (!out || !_pendingAvatar) return;

  const cat = _customizerActiveCategory;

  let html = '';

  if (cat === 'body') {

    html = _customizerTileGrid(BODY_TYPES, _pendingAvatar.bodyType, (k) => pickAvatarOption('bodyType', k));

  } else if (cat === 'skin') {

    html = _customizerSwatchGrid(SKIN_TONES, _pendingAvatar.skinTone, (k) => pickAvatarOption('skinTone', k));

  } else if (cat === 'hair') {

    html = `

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:6px;">STYLE</div>

      ${_customizerTileGrid(HAIR_STYLES, _pendingAvatar.hair.style, (k) => pickAvatarOption('hair.style', k))}

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin:10px 0 6px;">COLOR</div>

      ${_customizerSwatchGrid(HAIR_COLORS, _pendingAvatar.hair.color, (k) => pickAvatarOption('hair.color', k))}

    `;

  } else if (cat === 'face') {

    html = `

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:6px;">FACE SHAPE</div>

      ${_customizerTileGrid(FACE_SHAPES, _pendingAvatar.face.shape, (k) => pickAvatarOption('face.shape', k))}

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin:10px 0 6px;">EYE COLOR</div>

      ${_customizerSwatchGrid(EYE_COLORS, _pendingAvatar.face.eyes, (k) => pickAvatarOption('face.eyes', k))}

    `;

  } else if (cat === 'outfit') {

    html = _customizerTileGrid(OUTFIT_META, _pendingAvatar.outfitStyle, (k) => pickAvatarOption('outfitStyle', k));

  } else if (cat === 'accessories') {

    html = `

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:6px;">GLASSES</div>

      ${_customizerTileGrid(ACCESSORY_META.glasses, _pendingAvatar.accessories.glasses, (k) => pickAvatarOption('accessories.glasses', k))}

      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin:10px 0 6px;">FACE ACCENT</div>

      ${_customizerTileGrid(ACCESSORY_META.accent, _pendingAvatar.accessories.accent, (k) => pickAvatarOption('accessories.accent', k))}

    `;

  }

  out.innerHTML = html;

}

// Helper: build a labeled tile grid. `meta` is an object mapping key→{name}.

// Selected key gets the accent ring.

function _customizerTileGrid(meta, selectedKey, _onClickFnUnused) {

  const keys = Object.keys(meta);

  return `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(72px,1fr));gap:6px;">

    ${keys.map(k => {

      const sel = k === selectedKey;

      return `<button type="button" data-tile-key="${k}" onclick="_pickByCat(this)"

        style="padding:8px 4px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.3px;

        background:${sel ? 'rgba(79,142,255,0.15)' : 'var(--bg2)'};

        border:1.5px solid ${sel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'};

        color:${sel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text2)'};">${meta[k].name}</button>`;

    }).join('')}

  </div>`;

}

// Helper: build a color swatch grid. `meta` is an object mapping key→{hex, name}.

function _customizerSwatchGrid(meta, selectedKey, _onClickFnUnused) {

  const keys = Object.keys(meta);

  return `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(60px,1fr));gap:8px;">

    ${keys.map(k => {

      const sel = k === selectedKey;

      const hex = meta[k].hex;

      return `<button type="button" data-tile-key="${k}" onclick="_pickByCat(this)" title="${meta[k].name}"

        style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;

        background:transparent;border:1.5px solid ${sel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'transparent'};">

        <div style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:${hex};border:2px solid ${sel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--border)'};"></div>

        <div style="font-size:9px;color:${sel ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text3)'};font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:600;">${meta[k].name}</div>

      </button>`;

    }).join('')}

  </div>`;

}

// Click delegator — derives the field path from the current category, since each

// category has only one or two fields and the option key is on data-tile-key.

function _pickByCat(buttonEl) {

  if (!buttonEl) return;

  const k = buttonEl.getAttribute('data-tile-key');

  const cat = _customizerActiveCategory;

  // Within a multi-field category (hair, face, accessories) we need to figure out

  // which sub-section the click came from. The simplest signal: walk up to the

  // preceding section header (the "STYLE" / "COLOR" / "EYE COLOR" labels).

  let path;

  if (cat === 'body') path = 'bodyType';

  else if (cat === 'skin') path = 'skinTone';

  else if (cat === 'outfit') path = 'outfitStyle';

  else if (cat === 'hair') {

    path = (k in HAIR_STYLES) ? 'hair.style' : 'hair.color';

  } else if (cat === 'face') {

    path = (k in FACE_SHAPES) ? 'face.shape' : 'face.eyes';

  } else if (cat === 'accessories') {

    path = (k in ACCESSORY_META.glasses && k !== 'none') ? 'accessories.glasses'

         : (k in ACCESSORY_META.accent && k !== 'none') ? 'accessories.accent'

         : null;

    // Both lists have 'none' — disambiguate by walking up to the previous label

    if (k === 'none') {

      const label = buttonEl.parentElement && buttonEl.parentElement.previousElementSibling;

      const labelText = label ? label.textContent.toUpperCase() : '';

      path = labelText.includes('GLASSES') ? 'accessories.glasses' : 'accessories.accent';

    }

  }

  if (path) pickAvatarOption(path, k);

}

// Apply a selection to the pending avatar via dotted-path notation.

function pickAvatarOption(path, value) {

  if (!_pendingAvatar) return;

  const parts = path.split('.');

  let obj = _pendingAvatar;

  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {

    if (!obj[parts[i]] || typeof obj[parts[i]] !== 'object') obj[parts[i]] = {};

    obj = obj[parts[i]];

  }

  obj[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value;

  // Re-render the active option grid (so selection ring updates) + the preview

  renderCustomizerOptions();

  renderCustomizerPreview();

}

// ===== ATTRIBUTE ALLOCATOR =====

const ATTR_META = {

  STR: { label: 'STR', name: 'Strength', desc: 'Raw power for lifts and compound movements.', color: 'var(--red2)' },

  AGI: { label: 'AGI', name: 'Agility', desc: 'Speed, footwork, conditioning, and mobility.', color: 'var(--green2)' },

  VIT: { label: 'VIT', name: 'Vitality', desc: 'Recovery, sleep quality, hormonal baseline.', color: 'var(--gold)' },

  INT: { label: 'INT', name: 'Intelligence', desc: 'Training knowledge, macro adherence, program discipline.', color: 'var(--accent2)' },

  PER: { label: 'PER', name: 'Perception', desc: 'Body awareness, mind-muscle connection, form quality.', color: 'var(--purple2)' }

};

function renderAttributeAllocator(target) {

  if (!target) return;

  const avail = state.attributePointsPending || 0;

  const attrs = state.attributes || { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

  let html = '';

  if (avail > 0) {

    html += `<div class="points-banner" style="margin-bottom:10px;">

      <div class="points-banner-num">${avail}</div>

      <div>

        <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--gold);">POINTS AVAILABLE</div>

        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);">Allocate to shape your hunter's profile.</div>

      </div>

    </div>`;

  }

  html += '<div>';

  Object.keys(ATTR_META).forEach(key => {

    const meta = ATTR_META[key];

    const v = attrs[key] || 0;

    const pct = Math.min(100, v);

    html += `

      <div class="attr-alloc-row">

        <div class="attr-alloc-label" style="color:${meta.color};">${meta.label}</div>

        <button class="attr-alloc-btn" onclick="allocAttr('${key}', -1)" ${v <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>−</button>

        <div class="attr-alloc-bar"><div class="attr-alloc-bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${meta.color};"></div></div>

        <div class="attr-alloc-val">${v}</div>

        <button class="attr-alloc-btn" onclick="allocAttr('${key}', 1)" ${avail <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>+</button>

      </div>

      <div class="field-desc" style="margin:-2px 0 4px 82px;font-style:normal;">${meta.desc}</div>

    `;

  });

  html += '</div>';

  target.innerHTML = html;

}

function allocAttr(key, delta) {

  state.attributes = state.attributes || { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

  if (delta > 0) {

    if ((state.attributePointsPending || 0) <= 0) return;

    state.attributes[key] = (state.attributes[key] || 0) + 1;

    state.attributePointsPending--;

  } else {

    // Allow refund only if we previously added (can't drop below 10 floor which was starting value)

    if ((state.attributes[key] || 0) <= 10) return;

    state.attributes[key]--;

    state.attributePointsPending++;

  }

  save();

  renderAttributeAllocator(document.getElementById('attr-allocator'));

  renderStats();

}

// Award coin bonuses on level-up / rank-up. Attribute-point grants were removed

// when the attributes UI was retired alongside the avatar.

const XP_PER_LEVEL = 500;

function checkLevelUp() {

  const newLevel = Math.floor(state.xp / XP_PER_LEVEL) + 1;

  if (newLevel > (state.level || 1)) {

    const delta = newLevel - (state.level || 1);

    state.level = newLevel;

    state.coins += delta * 25;

    showNotif(`LEVEL UP! Level ${newLevel} — +${delta * 25} ${t('coins').toLowerCase()}`, 'var(--gold)');

  }

  // Rank-up bonus

  const newRank = getRank(state.xp);

  if (state.lastRankUp !== newRank && newRank !== 'E') {

    state.lastRankUp = newRank;

    state.coins += 100;

    showNotif(`${t('rank_up')} You're now Rank ${newRank} — +100 ${t('coins').toLowerCase()}`, 'var(--gold)');

  }

  // Evaluate earn-based titles (Shadow Monarch for L50, The Ascendant for S-Rank)

  if (typeof evaluateTitles === 'function') evaluateTitles();

}

// ===== HUNTER SHOP =====

const SHOP_ITEMS = {

  // Titles live in TITLE_CATALOG (see below) — they are earned, not purchased.

  // Card frames

  frame_gold: { id: 'frame_gold', kind: 'frame', name: 'Gold Frame', icon: 'sparkles', desc: 'A bright gold border for your hunter card.', price: 300 },

  frame_obsidian: { id: 'frame_obsidian', kind: 'frame', name: 'Obsidian Frame', icon: 'moon', desc: 'Dark elegance for your hunter card.', price: 750 },

  // Buffs (functional, consumable)

  buff_2xp: { id: 'buff_2xp', kind: 'buff', name: '2× XP Token', icon: 'zap', desc: 'Doubles XP on your next completed quest.', price: 150, consumable: true },

  buff_shield: { id: 'buff_shield', kind: 'buff', name: 'Streak Shield', icon: 'shield', desc: 'Protects your streak from one missed day.', price: 300, consumable: true },

  buff_rest: { id: 'buff_rest', kind: 'buff', name: 'Rest Day Pass', icon: 'moon', desc: 'Skip today with no penalty. One-time use.', price: 250, consumable: true },

  buff_insight: { id: 'buff_insight', kind: 'buff', name: 'System Insight', icon: 'sparkles', desc: 'Regenerates your AI quest for free (bypass cooldown).', price: 100, consumable: true },

};

// Earned titles — not purchased, awarded by hitting a condition.

// `progress` returns { current, target } for a progress bar; `check` is a boolean.

const TITLE_CATALOG = {

  title_firstlight: {

    id: 'title_firstlight', kind: 'title', name: 'First Light', icon: 'sparkles',

    desc: 'Complete every quest on a single day.',

    condition: 'Complete all quests on one day',

    check: (s) => !!(s.stats && s.stats.anyFullDayCompleted),

  },

  title_iron: {

    id: 'title_iron', kind: 'title', name: 'Iron Will', icon: 'shield',

    desc: 'Discipline forged in thirty days of consecutive effort.',

    condition: '30-day streak',

    check: (s) => (s.streak || 0) >= 30,

    progress: (s) => ({ current: s.streak || 0, target: 30 }),

  },

  title_relentless: {

    id: 'title_relentless', kind: 'title', name: 'Relentless', icon: 'flame',

    desc: 'For those who never skip a day — a hundred quests cleared.',

    condition: '100 quests completed',

    check: (s) => (s.stats && s.stats.totalQuestsCompleted || 0) >= 100,

    progress: (s) => ({ current: s.stats && s.stats.totalQuestsCompleted || 0, target: 100 }),

  },

  title_macromonk: {

    id: 'title_macromonk', kind: 'title', name: 'Macro Monk', icon: 'salad',

    desc: 'Macro targets hit fourteen days in a row.',

    condition: '14-day macro streak',

    check: (s) => (s.stats && s.stats.macroStreak || 0) >= 14,

    progress: (s) => ({ current: s.stats && s.stats.macroStreak || 0, target: 14 }),

  },

  title_ascendant: {

    id: 'title_ascendant', kind: 'title', name: 'The Ascendant', icon: 'zap',

    desc: 'Climbed to the top of the rank ladder.',

    condition: 'Reach S-Rank',

    check: (s) => s.rank === 'S',

  },

  title_monarch: {

    id: 'title_monarch', kind: 'title', name: 'Shadow Monarch', icon: 'crown',

    desc: 'Reserved for hunters who have transcended Level 50.',

    condition: 'Reach Level 50',

    check: (s) => (s.level || 1) >= 50,

    progress: (s) => ({ current: s.level || 1, target: 50 }),

  },

};

// Run after any state change that could unlock a title.

// Awards newly-earned titles and shows a notification.

function evaluateTitles() {

  if (!state.inventory) state.inventory = { gear: [], buffs: {}, titles: [] };

  if (!Array.isArray(state.inventory.titles)) state.inventory.titles = [];

  let awarded = false;

  Object.values(TITLE_CATALOG).forEach(t => {

    if (!state.inventory.titles.includes(t.id) && t.check(state)) {

      state.inventory.titles.push(t.id);

      awarded = true;

      showNotif(`TITLE EARNED — ${t.name}`, 'var(--gold)');

    }

  });

  if (awarded) { save(); if (document.getElementById('shop-pane-titles')) renderShopTab('titles'); }

}

function renderShop() {

  const coinEl = document.getElementById('shop-coin-display');

  if (coinEl) coinEl.textContent = (state.coins || 0).toLocaleString();

  renderShopTab('frames');

  renderInventoryTab();

}

function switchShopTab(tab) {

  ['frames','titles','buffs','inventory'].forEach(t => {

    const pane = document.getElementById('shop-pane-' + t);

    if (pane) pane.style.display = t === tab ? 'block' : 'none';

    const btn = document.getElementById('shop-tab-' + t);

    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);

  });

  if (tab === 'frames' || tab === 'titles' || tab === 'buffs') renderShopTab(tab);

  if (tab === 'inventory') renderInventoryTab();

}

function renderShopTab(tab) {

  const paneId = 'shop-pane-' + tab;

  const pane = document.getElementById(paneId);

  if (!pane) return;

  if (tab === 'titles') { renderTitlesTab(pane); return; }

  const kindMap = { frames: 'frame', buffs: 'buff' };

  const kind = kindMap[tab];

  const items = Object.values(SHOP_ITEMS).filter(i => i.kind === kind);

  pane.innerHTML = `<div class="shop-grid">` + items.map(it => {

    const owned = kind === 'buff' ? (state.inventory.buffs[it.id] || 0) > 0 : state.inventory.gear.includes(it.id);

    const equipped = kind === 'frame' ? state.equipped.frame === it.id

                   : false;

    const cls = equipped ? 'shop-item equipped' : owned ? 'shop-item owned' : 'shop-item';

    const priceNode = equipped

      ? `<span class="shop-item-tag equipped">EQUIPPED</span>`

      : owned && kind !== 'buff'

      ? `<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="equipItem('${it.id}')">Equip</button>`

      : owned && kind === 'buff'

      ? `<span class="shop-item-tag owned">×${state.inventory.buffs[it.id] || 0}</span><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="buyItem('${it.id}')" style="margin-top:4px;">Buy (${it.price})</button>`

      : `<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="buyItem('${it.id}')">Buy <span class="shop-item-price">${it.price}</span></button>`;

    return `

      <div class="${cls}">

        <div class="shop-item-icon">${iconSvg(it.icon, 28)}</div>

        <div class="shop-item-name">${it.name}</div>

        <div class="shop-item-desc">${it.desc}</div>

        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:4px;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

          ${priceNode}

        </div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).join('') + `</div>`;

}

function renderTitlesTab(pane) {

  // Evaluate on render so we catch any conditions that were already met before this pass

  evaluateTitles();

  const earned = state.inventory && Array.isArray(state.inventory.titles) ? state.inventory.titles : [];

  pane.innerHTML = `<div class="shop-grid">` + Object.values(TITLE_CATALOG).map(t => {

    const isEarned = earned.includes(t.id);

    const isEquipped = isEarned && state.equipped.title === t.id;

    const cls = isEquipped ? 'shop-item equipped' : isEarned ? 'shop-item owned' : 'shop-item locked';

    let footer;

    if (isEquipped) {

      footer = `<span class="shop-item-tag equipped">EQUIPPED</span><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="unequipTitle()" style="margin-top:4px;">Unequip</button>`;

    } else if (isEarned) {

      footer = `<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="equipTitle('${t.id}')">Equip Title</button>`;

    } else {

      const prog = typeof t.progress === 'function' ? t.progress(state) : null;

      const bar = prog ? `

        <div style="margin-top:6px;">

          <div class="bar-wrap" style="height:4px;"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.min(100, Math.round(prog.current/prog.target*100))}%;background:var(--text3);"></div></div>

          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:3px;">${prog.current} / ${prog.target}</div>

        </div>` : '';

      footer = `<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;width:100%;">

        <span class="shop-item-tag locked" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;">${iconSvg('shield',12)}LOCKED</span>

        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">${t.condition}</div>

        ${bar}

      </div>`;

    }

    return `

      <div class="${cls}">

        <div class="shop-item-icon" style="${isEarned ? '' : 'opacity:0.45;filter:grayscale(0.6);'}">${iconSvg(t.icon, 28)}</div>

        <div class="shop-item-name" style="${isEarned ? '' : 'color:var(--text3);'}">${displayTitleName(t)}</div>

        <div class="shop-item-desc">${t.desc}</div>

        <div style="margin-top:6px;">${footer}</div>

      </div>

    `;

  }).join('') + `</div>`;

}

function equipTitle(id) {

  if (!state.inventory.titles.includes(id)) return;

  state.equipped.title = id;

  save();

  renderShopTab('titles');

  renderProfile();

}

function unequipTitle() {

  state.equipped.title = null;

  save();

  renderShopTab('titles');

  renderProfile();

}

function renderInventoryTab() {

  const pane = document.getElementById('shop-pane-inventory');

  if (!pane) return;

  const gear = (state.inventory.gear || []).map(id => SHOP_ITEMS[id]).filter(Boolean);

  const buffs = Object.entries(state.inventory.buffs || {}).filter(([,n]) => n > 0).map(([id, n]) => ({ ...SHOP_ITEMS[id], count: n }));

  pane.innerHTML = `

    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:8px;">OWNED GEAR</div>

    ${gear.length === 0 ? `<div style="color:var(--text3);padding:10px;font-size:12px;">No gear yet — grind some quests.</div>` : `<div class="shop-grid">${gear.map(it => {

      const equipped = (it.kind==='frame' && state.equipped.frame === it.id) || (it.kind==='title' && state.equipped.title === it.id);

      return `<div class="shop-item ${equipped ? 'equipped':'owned'}">

        <div class="shop-item-icon">${iconSvg(it.icon, 28)}</div>

        <div class="shop-item-name">${it.name}</div>

        <div class="shop-item-desc">${it.desc}</div>

        ${equipped ? '<span class="shop-item-tag equipped">EQUIPPED</span>' : `<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="equipItem('${it.id}')">Equip</button>`}

      </div>`;

    }).join('')}</div>`}

    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:10px;">BUFFS</div>

    ${buffs.length === 0 ? `<div style="color:var(--text3);padding:10px;font-size:12px;">No buffs stockpiled.</div>` : buffs.map(b => `

      <div class="buff-row">

        <div class="buff-info">

          <span class="buff-icon">${iconSvg(b.icon, 18)}</span>

          <div>

            <div class="buff-name">${b.name}</div>

            <div class="buff-count">${b.desc}</div>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">

          <span class="buff-count">×${b.count}</span>

          <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="useBuff('${b.id}')">Use</button>

        </div>

      </div>

    `).join('')}

    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:10px;">ACTIVE EFFECTS</div>

    ${(state.activeBuffs || []).length === 0 ? `<div style="color:var(--text3);padding:10px;font-size:12px;">None active.</div>` : state.activeBuffs.map(b => {

      const it = SHOP_ITEMS[b.id];

      return `<div class="buff-row"><div class="buff-info"><span class="buff-icon">${iconSvg(it?.icon || 'zap', 18)}</span><div><div class="buff-name">${it?.name||b.id}</div><div class="buff-count">${b.charges ? `${b.charges} charge${b.charges>1?'s':''} left` : 'active'}</div></div></div></div>`;

    }).join('')}

  `;

}

function buyItem(id) {

  const it = SHOP_ITEMS[id];

  if (!it) return;

  if ((state.coins || 0) < it.price) { showNotif('Not enough coins', 'var(--red)'); return; }

  state.coins -= it.price;

  if (it.kind === 'buff') {

    state.inventory.buffs[id] = (state.inventory.buffs[id] || 0) + 1;

  } else {

    if (!state.inventory.gear.includes(id)) state.inventory.gear.push(id);

  }

  showNotif(`Acquired: ${it.name}`, 'var(--gold)');

  save();

  renderShop();

  renderProfile();

}

function equipItem(id) {

  const it = SHOP_ITEMS[id];

  if (!it) return;

  if (it.kind === 'frame') state.equipped.frame = id;

  if (it.kind === 'title') state.equipped.title = id;

  showNotif(`${it.name} equipped`, 'var(--gold)');

  save();

  renderShop();

  renderProfile();

  renderStats();

}

function useBuff(id) {

  if ((state.inventory.buffs[id] || 0) <= 0) return;

  state.inventory.buffs[id]--;

  if (id === 'buff_2xp') {

    state.activeBuffs.push({ id, charges: 1 });

    showNotif('2× XP active — next quest awards double XP', 'var(--gold)');

  }

  if (id === 'buff_shield') {

    state.activeBuffs.push({ id, charges: 1 });

    showNotif('Streak Shield active — one missed day protected', 'var(--accent)');

  }

  if (id === 'buff_rest') {

    state.activeBuffs.push({ id, charges: 1, usedDate: todayStr() });

    // Mark penalty bar hidden for today

    const pb = document.getElementById('penalty-bar'); if (pb) pb.style.display = 'none';

    showNotif('Rest Day Pass applied — no penalty today', 'var(--accent)');

  }

  if (id === 'buff_insight') {

    generateAIQuest();

    showNotif('System Insight used — regenerating challenge', 'var(--accent)');

  }

  save();

  renderShop();

}

function consume2xBuffIfActive(baseXp) {

  const idx = (state.activeBuffs || []).findIndex(b => b.id === 'buff_2xp' && b.charges > 0);

  if (idx < 0) return baseXp;

  state.activeBuffs[idx].charges--;

  if (state.activeBuffs[idx].charges <= 0) state.activeBuffs.splice(idx, 1);

  return baseXp * 2;

}

// ===== PERSISTENCE / SYNC BACKUP =====

// Backup file format:

//   { _format: 'ARISE_BACKUP', _schemaVersion: N, _exportedAt: ISO, _appVersion: 'x.y',

//     state: { ...full state... } }

// Older backups (pre-v3) had state spread at the top level — we still accept those

// via legacy detection in importBackup. The MIGRATIONS chain runs on the inner state

// object to bring older schemas up to CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION.

const CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2;

const APP_VERSION = '1.0';

// Migration chain — keys are FROM-version, value is a function that produces the next version's state.

// Each migrator only needs to handle the delta from version N to N+1.

// When you bump CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, add a new migrator here.

const MIGRATIONS = {

  // 1 -> 2: example (no-op for now since v1 -> v2 was handled by deepMerge backfills in load()).

  1: function(s) {

    // Backfill v1 → v2 fields (mirrors the defensive backfills in load())

    if (!s.attributes) s.attributes = { STR: 10, AGI: 10, VIT: 10, INT: 10, PER: 10 };

    if (typeof s.coins !== 'number') s.coins = 0;

    if (!s.inventory) s.inventory = { gear: [], buffs: {}, titles: [] };

    if (!s.equipped) s.equipped = { outfit: 'recruit', frame: 'default', title: null };

    if (!s.stats) s.stats = { totalQuestsCompleted: 0, anyFullDayCompleted: false, macroStreak: 0, lastMacroHitDate: null };

    if (!Array.isArray(s.workoutLog)) s.workoutLog = [];

    if (!Array.isArray(s.savedSplits)) s.savedSplits = [];

    s.schemaVersion = 2;

    return s;

  },

  // Future: 2: function(s) { /* v2 → v3 */ s.schemaVersion = 3; return s; },

};

// Run migrations from `fromVersion` up to `toVersion`. No-ops if already at target.

function runMigrations(s, fromVersion, toVersion) {

  let v = fromVersion || 1;

  while (v < toVersion) {

    const migrator = MIGRATIONS[v];

    if (!migrator) {

      console.warn(`No migration registered for v${v} → v${v+1}; skipping`);

      v++;

      continue;

    }

    s = migrator(s) || s;

    v++;

  }

  return s;

}

function exportBackup() {

  const payload = {

    _format: 'ARISE_BACKUP',

    _schemaVersion: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    _appVersion: APP_VERSION,

    _exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),

    state: state,

  };

  const json = JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);

  const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });

  const a = document.createElement('a');

  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  a.download = `arise_backup_${todayStr()}.json`;

  a.click();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);

  showNotif('Backup exported — save to cloud for sync', 'var(--gold)');

}

function importBackup(input) {

  const file = input.files[0];

  if (!file) return;

  const reader = new FileReader();

  reader.onload = e => {

    try {

      const imported = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

      if (!imported || typeof imported !== 'object') throw new Error('Invalid JSON');

      // Detect format version. New format has _format === 'ARISE_BACKUP'.

      // Legacy format (pre-v3 file format) had state spread at top level with `_app: 'ARISE'`.

      let incomingState, incomingSchemaVersion;

      if (imported._format === 'ARISE_BACKUP') {

        incomingState = imported.state;

        incomingSchemaVersion = imported._schemaVersion || 1;

        if (!incomingState || typeof incomingState !== 'object') throw new Error('Backup missing state payload');

      } else if (imported._app === 'ARISE' || imported.profile !== undefined || imported.macros !== undefined) {

        // Legacy backup — state was at the top level with `_exported` / `_app` siblings

        incomingState = { ...imported };

        delete incomingState._exported;

        delete incomingState._app;

        incomingSchemaVersion = incomingState.schemaVersion || 1;

      } else {

        throw new Error('Not an ARISE backup file');

      }

      if (incomingSchemaVersion > CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {

        const cont = confirm(`This backup was made with a newer version (v${incomingSchemaVersion}). Some data may not load correctly. Continue anyway?`);

        if (!cont) return;

      }

      if (!confirm('This will overwrite current progress on this device. Continue?')) return;

      // Run migrations to bring the imported state up to current schema version

      let migrated = incomingState;

      if (incomingSchemaVersion < CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {

        migrated = runMigrations(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(incomingState)), incomingSchemaVersion, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION);

      }

      // Deep-merge into a fresh DEFAULT_STATE so any new fields get sensible defaults

      state = deepMerge(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_STATE)), migrated);

      state.schemaVersion = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION;

      save();

      showNotif('Backup restored', 'var(--green)');

      // Reload to ensure every UI surface picks up the new state cleanly

      setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);

    } catch(err) {

      console.error('Import failed:', err);

      showNotif('Import failed — ' + (err.message || 'invalid file'), 'var(--red2)');

    } finally {

      // Clear the file input so re-selecting the same file still triggers onchange

      try { input.value = ''; } catch(e){}

    }

  };

  reader.readAsText(file);

}

// ===== BOOT =====

load();

// Cloud sync — initialize Supabase client if configured. Restoring a session here

// triggers an auto-pull-and-merge from cloud once the session is verified.

try { if (typeof cloudSyncInit === 'function') cloudSyncInit(); } catch(e) { console.warn('cloudSyncInit failed:', e.message); }

// Reveal the cloud sign-in starter card if Supabase is wired up

try {

  if (cloudSyncAvailable()) {

    const cloudCard = document.getElementById('ob0-cloud-signin-card');

    if (cloudCard) cloudCard.style.display = '';

  }

} catch(e) {}

// Apply plainMode labels to the onboarding screen too (in case a returning user

// imported a backup with plainMode=true and is seeing the path picker again).

try { applyPlainModeLabels(); } catch(e) {}

if (state.profile) {

  document.getElementById('onboarding').style.display = 'none';

  document.getElementById('main-app').style.display = 'flex';

  initApp();

} else {

  // Fresh user — Step 0 (path picker) is already the active screen via HTML class.

  // Seed one empty goal entry for the experienced path so Step 2 isn't blank if they navigate to it.

  addGoalEntry();

}

</script>

</body>

</html>
